recipes.title: Baked French Toast
recipes.description: Baked French Toast combines maple syrup, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: Slices of golden French toast
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 loaf French bread (13 to 16 ounces)
- 8 large eggs
- 2 cups half-and-half
- 1 cup milk
- 2 Tbs granulated sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
- Dash salt
- Maple syrup
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 loaf French bread (13 to 16 ounces)
  • 8 large eggs
  • 2 cups half-and-half
  • 1 cup milk
  • 2 Tbs granulated sugar
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
  • 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
  • Dash salt
  • Maple syrup
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Slice French bread into 20 slices, 1-inch each. (Use any extra bread for garlic toast or bread crumbs).
  2. Arrange slices in a generously buttered 9 by 13-inch flat baking dish in 2 rows, overlapping the slices.
  3. In a large bowl, combine the eggs, half-and-half, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt and beat with a rotary beater or whisk until blended but not too bubbly.
  4. Pour mixture over the bread slices, making sure all are covered evenly with the milk-egg mixture.
  5. Spoon some of the mixture in between the slices.
  6. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
  7. The next day, preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
  8. Spread Praline Topping evenly over the bread and bake for 40 minutes, until puffed and lightly golden. Serve with maple syrup.
  9. Praline Topping:
  10. 1/2 pound (2 sticks) butter cup packed light brown sugar cup chopped pecans tablespoons light corn syrup
  11. 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  12. 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
  13. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and blend well. Makes enough for Baked French Toast Casserole.
recipes.notesHtml: Baked French Toast Casserole with Maple Syrup
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1 loaf French bread (13 to 16 ounces) - 8 large eggs - 2 cups half-and-half - 1 cup milk - 2 Tbs granulated sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon - 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg - Dash salt - Maple syrup

recipes.title: Banana Bread I
recipes.description: Banana Bread I combines chocolate, walnuts, and banana in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: A sliced loaf of homemade quick bread
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 cup softened butter or margarine
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 cup mashed ripe bananas (3 medium)
- 2 cups flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips
- 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 cup softened butter or margarine
  • 1 cup granulated sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 cup mashed ripe bananas (3 medium)
  • 2 cups flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 cup chocolate chips
  • 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cream butter and sugar together.
  2. Add one egg at a time, beating till smooth.
  3. Blend in mashed bananas.
  4. In second bowl, stir flour with baking soda, baking powder, salt, chips, and nuts.
  5. Add to banana mixture stirring only to moisten.
  6. Transfer to greased loaf pan.
  7. Bake in 350 degree oven for about 50 minutes until inserted toothpick comes out clean.
  8. Let stand 10 minutes.
  9. Remove from pan and place on cake rack to cool.
  10. Wrap to store.
  11. This banana bread recipe makes 1 loaf.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1/2 cup softened butter or margarine - 1 cup granulated sugar - 2 eggs - 1 cup mashed ripe bananas (3 medium) - 2 cups flour - 1 tsp baking soda - 1/2 tsp baking powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1 cup chocolate chips - 1/2 cup chopped walnuts

recipes.title: Banana Bread II
recipes.description: Banana Bread II combines buttermilk, chocolate, and pecans in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: A sliced loaf of homemade quick bread
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 1/3 cup buttermilk
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 1 cup mashed bananas
- 1 1/2 cups white sugar
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips or chopped pecans (optional)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 eggs, beaten
  • 1/3 cup buttermilk
  • 1/2 cup vegetable oil
  • 1 cup mashed bananas
  • 1 1/2 cups white sugar
  • 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup chocolate chips or chopped pecans (optional)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
  2. Spray one 9x5 inch loaf pan with non-stick spray coating.
  3. Blend together the eggs, buttermilk, oil and bananas.
  4. Sift together the sugar, flour, baking soda and salt.
  5. Add to banana mixture and stir in pecans.
  6. Mix well.
  7. Pour into prepared loaf pan and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Blueberry Muffins combine lemon, blueberries, and buttermilk in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: Freshly baked muffins
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- Lemon-Sugar Topping
- 1/3 cup sugar (2 1/3 ounces)
- 1 1/2 tsp finely grated zest from 1 lemon

- Muffins
- 2 cups fresh blueberries (about 10 ounces), picked over
- 1 1/8cups sugar (8 ounces) plus 1 tsp
- 2 1/2cups unbleached all-purpose flour (12 1/2 ounces)
- 2 1/2teaspoons baking powder
- 1 tsp table salt
- 2 large eggs
- 4 Tbs (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 cup buttermilk (see note)
- 1 1/2teaspoons vanilla extract
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• Lemon-Sugar Topping

  • 1/3 cup sugar (2 1/3 ounces)

  • 1 1/2 tsp finely grated zest from 1 lemon

  • Muffins

  • 2 cups fresh blueberries (about 10 ounces), picked over

  • 1 1/8cups sugar (8 ounces) plus 1 tsp

  • 2 1/2cups unbleached all-purpose flour (12 1/2 ounces)

  • 2 1/2teaspoons baking powder

  • 1 tsp table salt

  • 2 large eggs

  • 4 Tbs (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly

  • 1/4 cup vegetable oil

  • 1 cup buttermilk (see note)

  • 1 1/2teaspoons vanilla extract
recipes.instructionsHtml:
• 1. FOR THE TOPPING: Stir together sugar and lemon zest in small bowl until combined; set aside.

  • 2. FOR THE MUFFINS: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 425 degrees. Spray standard muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. Bring 1 cup blueberries and 1 tsp sugar to simmer in small saucepan over medium heat. Cook, mashing berries with spoon several times and stirring frequently, until berries have broken down and mixture is thickened and reduced to ¼ cup, about 6 minutes. Transfer to small bowl and cool to room temperature, 10 to 15 minutes.

  • 3. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in large bowl. Whisk remaining 1 1/8 cups sugar and eggs together in medium bowl until thick and homogeneous, about 45 seconds. Slowly whisk in butter and oil until combined. Whisk in buttermilk and vanilla until combined. Using rubber spatula, fold egg mixture and remaining cup blueberries into flour mixture until just moistened. (Batter will be very lumpy with few spots of dry flour; do not over-mix.)

  • 4. Following photos below, use ice cream scoop or large spoon to divide batter equally among prepared muffin cups (batter should completely fill cups and mound slightly). Spoon tsp of cooked berry mixture into center of each mound of batter. Using chopstick or skewer, gently swirl berry filling into batter using figure-eight motion. Sprinkle lemon sugar evenly over muffins.

  • 5. Bake until muffin tops are golden and just firm, 17 to 19 minutes, rotating muffin tin from front to back halfway through baking time. Cool muffins in muffin tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack and cool 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.notesHtml:
Blueberry Muffins

Published May 1, 2009. From Cook's Illustrated. – Haven’t made these KN Nov 2014

Why This Recipe Works: We didn’t want the fruit in our blueberry muffin recipe to have the lackluster, watery taste so common in many other recipes. Cooking some of the berries in sugar and adding our cooled homemade jam to the batter along with fresh, uncooked berries gave our muffin recipe the best of both worlds: intense blueberry flavor and the liquid burst that only fresh berries can provide.

Makes 12 Muffins If buttermilk is unavailable, substitute 3/4 cup plain whole-milk or low-fat yogurt thinned with 1/4 cup milk.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Cornbread
recipes.description: Buttermilk gives Buttermilk Cornbread a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden biscuits fresh from the oven
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 cup butter
- 1 1/3 cups white sugar
- 4 eggs
- 2 cups buttermilk
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 2 cups cornmeal
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 cup butter
  • 1 1/3 cups white sugar
  • 4 eggs
  • 2 cups buttermilk
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 2 cups cornmeal
  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease an 8-inch square pan or muffin tin(s).
  2. Melt butter in large skillet.
  3. Remove from heat and stir in sugar.
  4. Quickly add eggs and beat until well blended.
  5. Combine buttermilk with baking soda and stir into mixture in pan.
  6. Stir in cornmeal, flour, and salt until well blended and few lumps remain.
  7. Pour batter into the square pan or use a large ice cream scoop and fill muffin tins.
  8. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes (square pan) or 15 minutes (muffin tin) until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
recipes.notesHtml:
Buttermilk Cornbread

You can make this cornbread as a single loaf in an 8-inch square pan or as 23 individual muffins. The bake time will differ.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1 cup butter - 1 1/3 cups white sugar - 4 eggs - 2 cups buttermilk - 1 tsp baking soda - 2 cups cornmeal - 2 cups all-purpose flour - 1 tsp salt

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash
recipes.description: Cream gives Corned Beef Hash a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: A skillet of breakfast hash
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 Tbs vegetable oil
- 2 onions, chopped
- 4 potatoes, peeled and chopped
- 1 lb cooked corned beef, cut into chunks
- 1 Tbs ground black pepper
- 1/4 cup heavy cream
- 1 Tbs chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley (opt)
- 5 Tbs cider vinegar
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs vegetable oil
  • 2 onions, chopped
  • 4 potatoes, peeled and chopped
  • 1 lb cooked corned beef, cut into chunks
  • 1 Tbs ground black pepper
  • 1/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 Tbs chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley (opt)
  • 5 Tbs cider vinegar
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. This version of corned beef hash cooks the potatoes in a skillet with the onions.
  2. It requires a good lid to use steam to get them cooked.
  3. If doing a large batch with no lid, pre-cook the potatoes in boiling salted water until just tender, about 3 minutes, then drain.
  4. If you cook the potatoes first, continue with the recipe below but sautee onions w/out potatoes and then add them with the corned beef and reduce overall cooking time.
  5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
  6. Saute onions and potatoes until slightly browned, then stir in corned beef.
  7. Season with pepper and add vinegar 1 tablespoon at a time, cooking for 3 to 5 minutes in between each addition.
  8. Partially cover skillet, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
  9. Add cream and cook, stirring, 1 minute.
  10. Stir in parsley just before serving.
  11. Serves 60-80 cups vegetable oil onions, chopped potatoes, peeled and chopped lb cooked corned beef, cut into chunks
  12. 1/2 cup ground black pepper
  13. 1/2 cups heavy cream bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped cups cider vinegar
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 Tbs vegetable oil - 2 onions, chopped - 4 potatoes, peeled and chopped - 1 lb cooked corned beef, cut into chunks - 1 Tbs ground black pepper - 1/4 cup heavy cream - 1 Tbs chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley (opt) - 5 Tbs cider vinegar

recipes.title: Easy Cream Biscuits
recipes.description: Light, tender biscuits made with heavy cream instead of butter or shortening, ready with minimal mixing and no special equipment.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden biscuits fresh from the oven
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups (10 ounces) all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp sugar
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups heavy cream
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups (10 ounces) all-purpose flour
  • 2 tsp sugar
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 1/2 cups heavy cream
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the upper-middle position and heat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a medium bowl.
  3. Stir in the cream with a wooden spoon until a dough forms, about 30 seconds.
  4. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured counter and gather it into a ball. Knead briefly until smooth, about 30 seconds.
  5. Shape the dough into a 3/4-inch-thick circle. Cut it into rounds with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter, or cut it into wedges.
  6. Place the rounds or wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes, rotating the baking sheet halfway through baking. Serve warm.
recipes.variationsHtml:
Cheddar Cheese

  • Add 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, cut into 1/4-inch pieces, to the flour with the sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  • Increase the baking time to 18 minutes.

Crystallized Ginger

  • Add 3 Tbs minced crystallized ginger to the flour with the sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  • Before baking, brush the biscuit tops with 1 Tbs heavy cream and sprinkle with 1 Tbs sugar.
recipes.notesHtml: The dough benefits from approximately 30 seconds of kneading. Put the shaped biscuits into the oven immediately to help prevent spreading.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 cups (10 ounces) all-purpose flour - 2 tsp sugar - 2 tsp baking powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1 1/2 cups heavy cream

recipes.title: Flour Tortillas
recipes.description: A practical, home-style tortilla recipe made for everyday cooking.
recipes.imageAlt: Fresh dough ready for baking
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 c. all purpose flour
- 1 t. salt
- 1 t baking powder
- 2 T. shortening
- 3/4c. warm water
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 c. all purpose flour
  • 1 t. salt
  • 1 t baking powder
  • 2 T. shortening
  • 3/4c. warm water
recipes.instructionsHtml:
• Mix the flour, salt and baking powder together
  • Cut in the shortening
  • Mix in enough warm water to make a dough that isn't too sticky
  • Cover bowl with wet towel and let stand in the refrigerator for at least one hour
  • divide dough into about 10 balls (about the size of a 50 cent piece).
  • Roll out each ball on a floured surface.
  • Fry on each side until slightly browned. If dough bubbles up, burst bubble with side of spatula.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 c. all purpose flour - 1 t. salt - 1 t baking powder - 2 T. shortening - 3/4c. warm water

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Cornbread
recipes.description: Gluten-Free Cornbread combines yogurt, sour cream, and honey in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden biscuits fresh from the oven
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups cornmeal medium ground or coarse ground
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1½ cup yogurt or sour cream
- 1/4 cup honey
- 1/4 cup ghee or butter or coconut oil, melted and cooled
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups cornmeal medium ground or coarse ground
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1½ cup yogurt or sour cream
  • 1/4 cup honey
  • 1/4 cup ghee or butter or coconut oil, melted and cooled
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees, and line an 8×8 baking pan with parchment paper, or grease generously.
  2. In a large mixing bowl, stir together cornmeal, baking soda, baking powder, and sea salt.
  3. In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, honey, ghee, egg, and vanilla extract.
  4. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, and mix until just combined.
  5. Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan. Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown and toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
  6. OPTIONAL: If you want a nice, shiny top to the cornbread, spread some butter or ghee on top when it's fresh out of the oven.
  7. Cool for 10 minutes, then slice into 16 squares. You can serve with butter and more honey.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 cups cornmeal medium ground or coarse ground - 2 tsp baking powder - 1 tsp baking soda - 1/2 tsp salt - 1½ cup yogurt or sour cream - 1/4 cup honey - 1/4 cup ghee or butter or coconut oil, melted and cooled - 1 large egg - 1 tsp vanilla extract

recipes.title: Green Chili Egg Casserole
recipes.description: Cayenne gives Green Chili Egg Casserole a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: A baked egg breakfast casserole
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 bag cubed bread or 1 loaf French bread broken into small pieces
- 2 cups shredded Monterey jack cheese
- 4 eggs
- 1 Tbs dried minced onion
- 1 tsp seasoned salt
- 1/2 tsp cayenne
- 2 small cans diced green chilies
- 2 1/2 cups milk
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 bag cubed bread or 1 loaf French bread broken into small pieces
  • 2 cups shredded Monterey jack cheese
  • 4 eggs
  • 1 Tbs dried minced onion
  • 1 tsp seasoned salt
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne
  • 2 small cans diced green chilies
  • 2 1/2 cups milk
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Grease 12 x 8 inch baking dish.
  2. Arrange 1/2 of bread on bottom.
  3. Sprinkle with cheese.
  4. Top with remaining bread.
  5. Beat eggs, onion, salt, and cayenne together.
  6. Blend in green chilies and milk.
  7. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread.
  8. Cover dish and refrigerate overnight (or at least 2 hours).
  9. Bake in preheated oven at 325 degrees uncovered 45 to 55 minutes, or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
  10. For a ~2” tall (i.e., shallowly filled) hotel pan, DOUBLE this recipe. For a 3-4” tall hotel pan, TRIPLE (i.e., well filled) this recipe.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1 bag cubed bread or 1 loaf French bread broken into small pieces - 2 cups shredded Monterey jack cheese - 4 eggs - 1 Tbs dried minced onion - 1 tsp seasoned salt - 1/2 tsp cayenne - 2 small cans diced green chilies - 2 1/2 cups milk

recipes.title: Kentucky Biscuits
recipes.description: Buttermilk gives Kentucky Biscuits a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden biscuits fresh from the oven
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1 dash salt
- 1 Tbs white sugar
- 1/2 cup butter
- 3/4 cup buttermilk
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 2 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1 dash salt
  • 1 Tbs white sugar
  • 1/2 cup butter
  • 3/4 cup buttermilk
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
  2. In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
  3. Cut in 1/2 cup butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Mix in the buttermilk.
  5. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead 2 minutes.
  6. Transfer to an ungreased baking sheet, roll into a 6x6 inch square, and cut into 12 even sections.
  7. Do not separate.
  8. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until a knife inserted in the center of the square comes out clean. Separate into biscuits, and serve hot.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 cups all-purpose flour - 2 1/2 tsp baking powder - 1/2 tsp baking soda - 1 dash salt - 1 Tbs white sugar - 1/2 cup butter - 3/4 cup buttermilk

recipes.title: Light and Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Buttermilk gives Light and Fluffy Pancakes a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: A stack of light golden pancakes on a plate
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups buttermilk
- 1 cup white flour
- 1 cup whole flour
- 2 Tbs brown sugar
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 3 Tbs melted butter
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups buttermilk
  • 1 cup white flour
  • 1 cup whole flour
  • 2 Tbs brown sugar
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 large egg
  • 3 Tbs melted butter
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl to combine.
  2. Whisk egg and butter into milk until combined.
  3. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients in the bowl; pour in the milk mixture and whisk very gently until just combined.
  4. Do not overmix!
  5. Heat skillet or non-stick pan on medium heat.
  6. Scoop 1/4 cup of pancake batter and "plop" it into the skillet.
  7. The batter will be thick so spread it out into a circle.
  8. Cook until bubbles form in the batter and the sides begin to darken.
  9. Flip and cook until edges are no longer moist.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 cups buttermilk - 1 cup white flour - 1 cup whole flour - 2 Tbs brown sugar - 2 tsp baking powder - 1/2 tsp baking soda - 1/2 tsp salt - 1 large egg - 3 Tbs melted butter

- 2 cups buttermilk

recipes.title: Pancakes (Original)
recipes.description: Pancakes combine buttermilk, banana, and walnuts in a comforting breakfast or baked treat.
recipes.imageAlt: A stack of golden pancakes
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 cup whole wheat flour 
- 1 cup white flour (or Spelt flour) 
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar 
- 1 teaspoon baking powder 
- 1 teaspoon baking soda 
- 1 teaspoon salt 
- 1 egg
- 2 cups buttermilk (approximately)
- 1/2 cup regular milk (approximately)
- 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 cup whole wheat flour
  • 1 cup white flour (or Spelt flour)
  • 2 tablespoons brown sugar
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • 1 egg
  • 2 cups buttermilk (approximately)
  • 1/2 cup regular milk (approximately)
  • 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
recipes.instructionsHtml:
• In large bowl add "Mix," buttermilk, oil, and egg (beaten).
  • Add additional buttermilk or regular milk until batter is smooth and barely pours off spoon (not too thin/easily pouring but not "plopping".)
  • The regular milk is good for thinning out the batter as the buttermilk can be quite thick.
  • Pre-heat your pan or griddle on medium high heat.
  • Pour pancakes onto non-stick pan or griddle. (No other Pam spray or anything should be needed.)
  • Batter should be just thick/thin enough to require light spreading once poured onto pan or griddle.
  • Flip when you see it covered with "those little bubbles".

Notes

Other add-in's (opt.): 1 ripe banana mashed & 1/3 c walnuts, or 1/2 blueberries or 1/2 choc. chips

If you're adding bananas, mush one very ripe banana in a separate bowl and crush some walnuts and gently fold into the mix. For blueberries (or other fruit), we usually use frozen and thaw/drain them before folding them gently in at this point.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1 cup whole wheat flour - 1 cup white flour (or Spelt flour) - 2 tablespoons brown sugar - 1 teaspoon baking powder - 1 teaspoon baking soda - 1 teaspoon salt - 1 egg - 2 cups buttermilk (approximately) - 1/2 cup regular milk (approximately) - 3 tablespoons vegetable oil

recipes.title: Pizza Crust Dough
recipes.description: Pizza Crust Dough is a practical, home-style breakfast or bread recipe made for everyday cooking.
recipes.imageAlt: Fresh dough ready for baking
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1\. Put the following ingredients in your bread maker in this order (to keep the yeast away from the water):
- 1 ' c.water1 T.olive oil4 2/3 c.bread flour (can have up to ' cup of WW flour within here, but no more)2 t.salt2 t.yeast (just about all of a small packet of yeast)
- 2\. Put your bread maker on 'dough' cycle and start it.
- 3\. When it is finished, put a small layer of flour (any kind) on your countertop and dump out the dough onto it. Carefully divide the dough into two parts without smashing it too hard. Roll out each dough into a circle about 15' across (larger or smaller will make pizza thinner or thicker, respectively). It makes the pizza dough a bit 'lighter' if you let it rise again for ' hour or so after you roll it out'but, who can wait that long?
- 4\. Sprinkle a little corn meal on your pizza stone. Move the dough onto the stone.
- 5\. Brush the rolled out pizza dough with a little bit of olive oil (especially around the edges) to keep it from burning when it cooks.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
recipes.description: Pizza Dough is a practical, home-style breakfast or bread recipe made for everyday cooking.
recipes.imageAlt: Fresh dough ready for baking
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 (.25 ounce) package active dry yeast
- 1 Tbs white sugar
- 2 1/2 cups warm water (110 degrees F)
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- 1 Tbs salt
- 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
- 5 1/2 cups bread flour
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 (.25 ounce) package active dry yeast
  • 1 Tbs white sugar
  • 2 1/2 cups warm water (110 degrees F)
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 Tbs salt
  • 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
  • 5 1/2 cups bread flour
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in the warm water. Let sit until creamy; about 10 minutes.
  2. Stir the olive oil, whole wheat flour, salt and 4 cups of the bread flour into the yeast mixture.
  3. Mix in the remaining flour, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring well after each addition.
  4. When the dough has pulled together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes.
  5. Lightly oil a large mixing bowl, place the dough in the bowl and turn to coat with oil.
  6. Cover with a damp cloth and put in a warm place to rise until doubled in volume; about 1 hour.
  7. Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface.
  8. Divide the dough into three equal pieces and form into rounds.
  9. Cover the rounds and let them rest for about 10 minutes.
  10. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
  11. Use a rolling pin to roll the dough into the desired shape, cover it with your favorite toppings and bake at 425 degrees F (220 degrees C) for about 20 minutes or until the crust and cheese are golden brown.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1 (.25 ounce) package active dry yeast - 1 Tbs white sugar - 2 1/2 cups warm water (110 degrees F) - 2 Tbs olive oil - 1 Tbs salt - 1/2 cup whole wheat flour - 5 1/2 cups bread flour

recipes.title: Single Rise Bread
recipes.description: Single Rise Bread is a practical, home-style breakfast or bread recipe made for everyday cooking.
recipes.imageAlt: A sliced loaf of homemade quick bread
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 cups flour (+ more for the kneading)
- 2 tsp salt (or more to taste)
- 1/2 tsp yeast
- ~2 cups water (less, if using spelt flour)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 cups flour (+ more for the kneading)
  • 2 tsp salt (or more to taste)
  • 1/2 tsp yeast
  • ~2 cups water (less, if using spelt flour)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Combine 4 c. flour, 2 t. salt and 1/2 t. yeast. Then slowly add up to 2 c. water, stirring continuously until a ball forms. It can be a little sticky.
  2. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Let rise in the bowl for 12-18 hrs.
  3. About an hour and a half before you want to eat: Put about 1/2 cup flour a baking sheet and dump the bread out on top of it.
  4. Remove all remaining pieces from the bowl and join to the larger ball. (No need to “kneed.”)
  5. Put a Dutch oven pot with a lid into the oven. Turn the oven on to 450 degrees. Wait 30 minutes while the oven and the pot heat up.
  6. Form the dough into a round loaf. Carefully remove the pot and gently place the ball of dough into the pot, cover and return to the oven.
  7. Cook covered for 30 minutes.
  8. Remove lid, reduce the temperature to 400 degrees and cook uncovered for 15-20 minutes until brown.
  9. Remove from oven. Let rest 5-10 minutes in the pan, then move to cooling rack. Let sit 15-20 minutes before cutting.
  10. For a smaller loaf, use: 3 c. flour, more for dusting, 1/4 tsp instant yeast, 1 1/2 t. salt. Reduce final cooking time (without lid) to 10-15 min.
recipes.notesHtml: This amazing bread is easy to do and has a great crunchy crust. It uses less yeast, but must rise for longer.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 4 cups flour (+ more for the kneading) - 2 tsp salt (or more to taste) - 1/2 tsp yeast - ~2 cups water (less, if using spelt flour)

recipes.title: Steel Cut Oatmeal
recipes.description: Coconut milk gives Steel Cut Oatmeal a distinctive twist on everyday breakfast baking.
recipes.imageAlt: A wholesome bowl of oats and granola
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 3 cups water
- 1 cup milk of choice: almond milk, cow’s milk, coconut milk, etc.
- 1 Tbs coconut oil or unsalted butter
- 1 cup steel-cut oats
- ¼ tsp salt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3 cups water
  • 1 cup milk of choice: almond milk, cow’s milk, coconut milk, etc.
  • 1 Tbs coconut oil or unsalted butter
  • 1 cup steel-cut oats
  • ¼ tsp salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large saucepan, combine the water and milk.
  2. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
  3. In the meantime, melt the coconut oil (or butter) in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat.
  4. Once shimmering, add the oats and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and fragrant, around 2 minutes.
  5. This toasting step greatly enhances the flavor of the oats.
  6. Stir the oats into the simmering liquid.
  7. Reduce the heat to medium-low, adjusting as necessary to maintain a gentle simmer.
  8. Cook for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is very thick.
  9. Stir in the salt.
  10. Continue to simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally and reducing heat as necessary to prevent scorching on the bottom, until almost all of the liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. (If you doubled the recipe, your oatmeal might need an extra 5 minutes cooking time here.) The oatmeal will be very creamy when it’s done.
  11. Remove from heat and stir in any mix-ins that you’d like.
  12. Let the oatmeal rest for 5 minutes before serving so it has more time to thicken up and cool down a palatable temperature.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 3 cups water - 1 cup milk of choice: almond milk, cow’s milk, coconut milk, etc. - 1 Tbs coconut oil or unsalted butter - 1 cup steel-cut oats - ¼ tsp salt

- 2 eggs, beaten

- 1/4 t. salt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:

  • 2 eggs, beaten
  • 2 tsp dry parsley
  • 1/4 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/4 t. pepper

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Mix all ingredients - except tater tots - in a small bowl. Let sit 5 min for dry onion to absorb water/rehydrate.
  2. Put tater tots in a food processor with mixing blade. Pour egg mixture over the top and pulse food processor 3-4 times. Note: you can also just mix by hand briefly, breaking some tots up.
  3. Press the mixture into the bottom of the bowl so that you can judge what about ¼ of the mixture is.
  4. Spray waffle iron with oil and preheat at around medium heat (to start.)
  5. When iron is "ready" - scoop about ¼4 of tater tot mixture into the center of the iron. Spread out a little to make a circle that is flat with no holes. Close iron.
  6. Set timer for 7 minutes to check cooking level. If it's not starting to darken in brown color, then leave for a couple more minutes.
  7. Gently remove waffle and place onto a cooling rack.
  8. Place cooling rack on a tray and put into low temp oven to keep warm.
  9. Or, cool at room temperature to reheat later.
  10. Reheat in an oven or put back in the waffle iron to reheat.

recipes.title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Honey gives Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings its defining flavor before being baked.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp chicken wings ready to serve
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 Kg (4 pounds) chicken wings cut into drumettes and flats
- 1 Tbs baking powder (NOT baking soda)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 tsp garlic powder

### Pinch of cracked pepper

### Sauce

- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup Frank's Original Red Hot Sauce
- 1-2 Tbs honey, white sugar or brown sugar (adjust to suit your tastes)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Kg (4 pounds) chicken wings cut into drumettes and flats
  • 1 Tbs baking powder (NOT baking soda)
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 2 tsp garlic powder

Pinch of cracked pepper

Sauce

  • 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
  • 1/2 cup Frank's Original Red Hot Sauce
  • 1-2 Tbs honey, white sugar or brown sugar (adjust to suit your tastes)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminium foil and set a heat-proof wire rack inside.
  2. Pat dry chicken wings liberally with paper towels, squeezing out as much moisture as you can. Transfer them to a large bowl.
  3. In a small bowl, combine the baking powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper together, whisking well to combine, and sprinkle the mixture over the wings.
  4. Toss wings through the baking powder mixture until evenly coated.
  5. Arrange on rack, leaving about 1-inch of space between each wing.
  6. Bake for 30 minutes; flip and continue to cook until crisp and golden brown, (about 20-30 minutes longer), until golden browned and crispy.
  7. While wings are cooking, whisk together hot sauce, butter and sugar. Toss wings through the sauce to evenly coat.
  8. Serve wings immediately with blue cheese dressing or ranch dressing, and celery sticks.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Dumplings
recipes.description: Chinese Chicken Dumplings combine toasted sesame oil, ginger, and soy sauce for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp dumplings and rolls served as appetizers
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
### Filling

- 1 lb ground chicken (uncooked)
- 3/4 lb Chinese Napa cabbage, chopped small
- 3 stalks green onion or chives
- 3T soy sauce
- 1T vinegar (preferably rice, or wine)
- 2T chicken broth
- 2T sesame oil
- 1T ginger root, finely chopped
- 1T garlic, finely chopped
- 1 egg white
- salt & pepper
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
Filling

  • 1 lb ground chicken (uncooked)
  • 3/4 lb Chinese Napa cabbage, chopped small
  • 3 stalks green onion or chives
  • 3T soy sauce
  • 1T vinegar (preferably rice, or wine)
  • 2T chicken broth
  • 2T sesame oil
  • 1T ginger root, finely chopped
  • 1T garlic, finely chopped
  • 1 egg white
  • salt & pepper
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. 2 pkg shui jiao wrappers (or dumpling wrappers; in Chinese food stores; you will probably use about 50 - 60 wrappers)
  2. Combine all filling ingredients and mix well.
  3. Wet edges of wrapper pages with water.
  4. Place a small spoon of filling in a wrapper.
  5. Pleat edges.
  6. Make sure no holes are left in edges because the dumpling will fill with water when boiled.
  7. Place 10 raw dumplings in a very large pot of already boiling water.
  8. Wait until pot returns to a boil, then add 2 cups of cold water and bring to boil.
  9. Again, add 2 cups of cold water. (Two times.) After pot returns to boil, dumplings are ready.
  10. Serve hot with dipping sauce. Leftovers can be re-heated in a microwave for about 2 minutes for 10 dumplings. Also, extra filling can be refrozen or made into hamburger patties!
  11. Variations:
  12. Can easily be made vegetarian by substituting vegetables (tofu, spinach, cabbage, etc.) for chicken and using veggie broth instead of chicken broth.
  13. Serve with Dumpling Dipping Sauce or Thai Chili Garlic Sauce.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 tsp olive oil
- 1/2 cup finely diced onions
- 1/2 cup finely diced celery
- 1 cup finely shredded Napa or white cabbage
- salt

### Freshly ground black pepper

- 2 tsp minced garlic
- 1/2 cup finely grated carrots
- 1/2 lb peeled crawfish tails
- 2 Tbs sesame oil
- 2 tsp untoasted sesame seeds
- 1 tsp finely chopped fresh cilantro
- 2 eggs
- 8 egg roll skins
- 6 cups vegetable oil
- 1/4 cup dry mustard
- 1/4 cup water

• 2 tsp olive oil

Freshly ground black pepper

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Hot Sesame Drizzle (see recipe)
  2. In a saute pan, over medium heat, add the oil.
  3. When the oil is hot, add the onions, celery, cabbage.
  4. Season with salt and pepper.
  5. Saute for 2 minutes.
  6. Add the garlic and carrots, saute for 2 minutes.
  7. Add the crawfish tails.
  8. Season with salt and pepper.
  9. Continue to saute for 2 minutes.
  10. Remove from the heat and turn into a mixing bowl.
  11. Add the sesame oil, sesame seeds, and cilantro.
  12. Mix well.
  13. Season with salt and pepper.
  14. Stir in 1 of the eggs.
  15. In a small mixing bowl, beat the remaining egg.
  16. Lay the egg roll skins on a flat surface and brush them with some of the remaining egg.
  17. Place one eighth of the filling at one end of each skin, leaving a 1/4-inch border at the top and sides, and roll up, tucking in the ends after the first roll.
  18. Heat the oil in a large saucepan.
  19. When the oil is hot, about 370 degrees, fry the egg rolls until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes.
  20. Remove from the fryer and drain on paper towels.
  21. Season with Essence (see recipe).
  22. To serve, slice each egg roll in half, diagonally and place on each serving plate.
  23. Combine dry mustard with water.
  24. Drizzle each egg roll with the hot mustard and Hot Sesame Drizzle.
  25. Garnish with cilantro leaves.

### For rouille

Cakes

  • fresh parsley, chopped fine for garnish

For rouille
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Whisk all ingredients in medium bowl. Season rouille to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. DO AHEAD: Can be made 1 day ahead. Cover and chill.
  2. For cakes:
  3. Cook potatoes in large saucepan of boiling salted water until tender, about 25 minutes.
  4. Drain; return potatoes to same saucepan.
  5. Add milk and butter.
  6. Mash potatoes (with peel) until smooth.
  7. Season with 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
  8. Transfer 3 cups mashed potatoes to large bowl and cool (reserve remaining potatoes for another use).
  9. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil in large deep skillet over medium heat.
  10. Add onion and garlic.
  11. Saut' until onion softens, about 5 minutes.
  12. Increase heat to medium-high.
  13. Add kale, sardines and thyme.
  14. Toss until kale wilts, about 5 minutes.
  15. Add kale mixture, 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and nutmeg to potatoes; blend.
  16. Cool potato mixture 30 minutes.
  17. Shape potato mixture by 1/4 cupfuls into 1/2-inch-thick patties. Arrange on rimmed baking sheet. DO AHEAD: Can be made up to 2 hours ahead. Let stand at room temperature.
  18. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
  19. Add cakes and cook, without moving, until cakes are brown and crispy on bottom, 3 to 4 minutes.
  20. Carefully turn cakes over.
  21. Cook until brown on bottom, 2 to 3 minutes longer.
  22. Transfer to plates.
  23. Spread a dollop of rouille on plate and place a cake on top followed by another dollop of rouille on top of the cake.
  24. Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:

  • 3/4 cup fine dry bread crumbs
  • 1/2 cup shredded Asiago or Parmesan, or crumbled blue cheese

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Wash and drain the mushrooms. Remove and reserve the caps. Chop enough stems to make 1 cup.
  2. In a medium saucepan, cook the chopped stems, green onion, and garlic in the butter until tender.
  3. Turn off the heat and stir in the bread crumbs, cheese, and Italian seasoning.
  4. Spoon the crumb mixture into the mushroom caps. Arrange in a 15 × 10 × 1-inch baking pan and drizzle with the olive oil.
  5. Bake at 400–425°F for 8–10 minutes, until heated through and lightly browned.
recipes.variationsHtml:
• Shrimp-stuffed: Stir 1 cup chopped, cooked popcorn shrimp and 1 beaten egg into the crumb mixture.
  • Sausage-stuffed: Omit the butter and cheese from the main recipe and reduce the bread crumbs to 2 Tbs. Cook bulk Italian sausage with the mushroom stem mixture until browned, then drain the fat. Stir in grated Parmesan and the bread crumbs. The sausage and Parmesan quantities are unreadable in the original.
recipes.notesHtml:
• Makes 24 stuffed mushrooms.
  • Don't skimp on the garlic; 4 to 5 cloves work well.

- 1/2 red onion, diced

- 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
- 1 small handful cilantro, chopped
- Cumin Lime Dressing, to taste

recipes.title: Candied Pecans
recipes.description: Pecans gives Candied Pecans its defining flavor and texture.
recipes.imageAlt: Glazed pecans in a serving bowl
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 1/2 Tbs packed brown sugar
- 1 1/2 tsp water
- 1/8 tsp vanilla
- 1/4 tsp kosher salt
- 1 cup pecan halves
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 1/2 Tbs packed brown sugar
  • 1 1/2 tsp water
  • 1/8 tsp vanilla
  • 1/4 tsp kosher salt
  • 1 cup pecan halves
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, water, vanilla, and kosher salt, stirring to combine (don't worry that the sugar and salt won't all be dissolved).
  2. Set this at-the-ready, next to your stove, as this recipe goes really quickly.
  3. In a medium-large saucepan over medium heat, toast pecans for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning. When you begin to smell a lovely, nutty aroma, they're done.
  4. Quickly drizzle the sugar mixture into the pan, on top of the pecans, stirring the nuts as you drizzle.
  5. Stir constantly for about 15 seconds, until the pecans are thoroughly coated in the sugar mixture.
  6. Immediately remove from heat so they don't burn.
  7. Spread the pecans on a piece of parchment to cool. Once cooled, you can break the nuts apart, if needed.
  8. Enjoy immediately or store in an airtight container. The pecans will be slightly sticky at first, but the coating hardens further within a few hours.

recipes.title: Curried Cashew, Pear, and Grape Salad
recipes.description: Curried Cashew, Pear, and Grape Salad pairs bacon, cayenne, and cashews in a spicy salad.
recipes.imageAlt: A fresh fruit salad
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 3/4 cup cashew halves
- 4 slices bacon, coarsely chopped
- 1 Tbs melted butter
- 1 tsp chopped fresh rosemary
- 1 tsp curry powder
- 1 Tbs brown sugar
- 1/2 tsp kosher salt
- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper

### Dressing

- 3 Tbs white wine vinegar
- 3 Tbs Dijon mustard
- 2 Tbs honey
- 1/2 cup olive oil
- salt and black pepper to taste

### Salad

- 1 (10 ounce) package mixed salad greens
- 1/2 medium Bosc pear, thinly sliced
- 1/2 cup halved seedless red grapes
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3/4 cup cashew halves
  • 4 slices bacon, coarsely chopped
  • 1 Tbs melted butter
  • 1 tsp chopped fresh rosemary
  • 1 tsp curry powder
  • 1 Tbs brown sugar
  • 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper

Dressing

  • 3 Tbs white wine vinegar
  • 3 Tbs Dijon mustard
  • 2 Tbs honey
  • 1/2 cup olive oil
  • salt and black pepper to taste

Salad

  • 1 (10 ounce) package mixed salad greens
  • 1/2 medium Bosc pear, thinly sliced
  • 1/2 cup halved seedless red grapes
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large, dry skillet over medium-high heat, toast cashews until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove cashews to a dish to cool slightly.
  2. Return skillet to medium-high heat, cook bacon strips until crisp on both sides, about 7 minutes.
  3. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon, and soak up grease with a paper towel.
  4. Coarsely chop bacon, and set aside.
  5. In a medium bowl, stir together butter, rosemary, curry powder, brown sugar, salt, cayenne pepper, and toasted cashews. Set aside.
  6. In a small bowl, stir together white wine vinegar, mustard, and honey. Slowly whisk in olive oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
  7. In a large salad bowl, toss dressing with greens, pear slices, grapes, and bacon, and sprinkle with nut mixture.

recipes.source: Salads & Dressings/Curried Cashew, Pear, and Grape Salad.md

recipes.title: Beef Stew
recipes.description: Red wine, thyme, and slow oven cooking build a deeply savory beef stew with tender potatoes, carrots, and peas.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of beef stew
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes
- 2 large onions, chopped coarse
- 9 cloves garlic, minced
- 3 Tbs all-purpose flour
- 3 Tbs olive oil
- 1 c red wine
- 2 c chicken broth
- 2 bay leaves
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 lb yukon gold or red potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 4 large carrots, peeled, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 c frozen peas, thawed
- 1/4 c minced fresh parsley
- 1 Tbs tomato paste
- salt
- pepper
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes
  • 2 large onions, chopped coarse
  • 9 cloves garlic, minced
  • 3 Tbs all-purpose flour
  • 3 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 c red wine
  • 2 c chicken broth
  • 2 bay leaves
  • 1 tsp dried thyme
  • 1 lb yukon gold or red potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
  • 4 large carrots, peeled, cut into 1-inch pieces
  • 1 c frozen peas, thawed
  • 1/4 c minced fresh parsley
  • 1 Tbs tomato paste
  • salt
  • pepper
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat the oven to 300°F. Season the beef with 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper; toss to coat.
  2. Heat 2 Tbs oil over medium-high heat in a Dutch oven. Brown the meat on all sides in 2 batches, about 5 minutes per batch, adding the remaining 1 Tbs oil if necessary. Transfer the browned meat to a plate and set aside.
  3. Add the onions to the empty pot and cook until almost softened, 4 to 5 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium, add the garlic, and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
  4. Stir in the flour and cook until lightly colored, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the wine, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
  5. Add the broth, bay leaves, and thyme and bring to a simmer. Return the meat to the pot and bring back to a simmer. Cover, transfer to the oven, and cook for 1 hour.
  6. Remove the pot from the oven. Add the potatoes and carrots, cover, and return it to the oven. Cook until the meat is just tender, about 1 hour.
  7. Remove the stew from the oven. Stir in the peas and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in the parsley, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve.
recipes.notesHtml: The stew can be cooled to room temperature after step 6 and refrigerated for up to 3 days. To continue, bring it to a simmer, remove it from the heat, and proceed with step 7. Finished stew can be refrigerated for up to 2 days.

recipes.description: Beef and Barley Soup brings red wine, thyme, and bay leaf together in a bright broth.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of beef stew
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 lb ground beef (less is fine)
- 1 cup dry hulled barley
- 8 cups vegetable broth
- 3 Tbs sunflower oil
- 1 large onion, diced
- 1 large carrot, finely diced
- 2 celery stalks, diced
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp thyme
- 2 Tbs all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
- 2 bay leaves
- 2 tsp salt
- 2 tsp black pepper
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 lb ground beef (less is fine)
  • 1 cup dry hulled barley
  • 8 cups vegetable broth
  • 3 Tbs sunflower oil
  • 1 large onion, diced
  • 1 large carrot, finely diced
  • 2 celery stalks, diced
  • 3 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 tsp thyme
  • 2 Tbs all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
  • 2 bay leaves
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 2 tsp black pepper
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cook the barley ahead of time according to its package directions. Soaking it overnight can shorten the cooking time.
  2. Brown the ground beef in a pot. Remove it and set aside.
  3. Add the sunflower oil to the pot. Sauté the onion, carrot, and celery until softened, 7 to 10 minutes.
  4. Stir in the garlic and thyme and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
  5. Whisk in the red wine vinegar, scraping up the browned bits, and cook until nearly evaporated, about 1 minute.
  6. Stir in the vegetable broth, bay leaves, cooked barley, browned beef, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce to a gentle simmer, and cook for 15 to 30 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
recipes.description: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup brings mushrooms, white wine, and thyme together in a savory broth.
recipes.imageAlt: A comforting bowl of chicken soup
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 quarts chicken broth
- 1/2 pound fresh mushrooms, chopped
- 1 cup finely chopped celery
- 1 cup shredded carrots
- 1/2 cup finely chopped onion
- 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules
- 1 tsp dried parsley flakes
- 1/4 tsp garlic powder
- 1/4 tsp dried thyme
- 1/4 cup butter or margarine
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
- 1/2 cup dry white wine or additional chicken broth
- 3 cups cooked wild rice
- 2 cups cubed, cooked chicken
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 quarts chicken broth
  • 1/2 pound fresh mushrooms, chopped
  • 1 cup finely chopped celery
  • 1 cup shredded carrots
  • 1/2 cup finely chopped onion
  • 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules
  • 1 tsp dried parsley flakes
  • 1/4 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/4 tsp dried thyme

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large saucepan, combine the first nine ingredients.
  2. Bring to a boil.
  3. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
  4. In a soup kettle or Dutch oven, melt butter. stir in flour until smooth.
  5. Gradually whisk in broth mixture.
  6. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
  7. Whisk in soup and wine or broth.
  8. Add rice and chicken; heat through.

recipes.title: Curry Pumpkin Soup
recipes.description: Pumpkin, curry, and nutmeg simmer into a velvety soup finished with milk for gentle richness.
recipes.imageAlt: A smooth, creamy soup garnished with herbs
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 large onion, chopped (yellow)
- 1/4 cup butter
- 2 cups fresh pumkin (baked or steamed AND smashed) OR
- 15 oz can of pumpkin

- 4 cups veggie broth
- 1/2 tsp sugar
- 1/2 tsp curry
- 1/8 tsp nutmeg
- 1 Tbs parsley
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 to 2 cups milk (even skim) or Half & Half  OR LESS
- salt & pepper
- green onion garnish
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 large onion, chopped (yellow)

  • 1/4 cup butter

  • 2 cups fresh pumkin (baked or steamed AND smashed) OR

  • 15 oz can of pumpkin

  • 4 cups veggie broth

  • 1/2 tsp sugar

  • 1/2 tsp curry

  • 1/8 tsp nutmeg

  • 1 Tbs parsley

  • 1 bay leaf

  • 1 to 2 cups milk (even skim) or Half & Half OR LESS

  • salt & pepper

  • green onion garnish
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Prep the pumpkin, if needed (or at least start the pumpkin.) Carmalize the onions in the butter until brownish.
  2. Add the broth to the onions and the spices (except bay leaf).
  3. Add the pumpkin.
  4. I usually use my "wand whip" to beat the whole mixture until it's pretty smooth & creamy.
  5. After you're done beating the mixture, add the bay leaf and let it simmer 15 min to 1/2 hour.
  6. Taste for spices (it might still be a little too salty at this point...you're still going to add milk.)
  7. When you're close to serving, add the milk. (Remember to add some soup to the milk to get it warmed up before adding the milk into the pot.) Depending on how creamy you've already gotten it and how creamy you want it, use between 1 & 2 cups milk or 1/2 & 1/2.
  8. The recipe originally called for 2 cups of half & half, but that is a VERY rich soup.
  9. I usally use 1 to 1 1/2 cups of 2% milk.
  10. I've also made it without the milk and it was great, too. (Remove bay leaf.) Serve with green onion garnish on top.
recipes.notesHtml: cooked squash can be added or sub'd. I've used butter nut squash YUM! It's ok not to mash the pumpkin too much if you have a "wand-wisk" (beater) to beat it with later.

recipes.title: Egyptian Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Egyptian Lentil Soup brings cumin, coriander, and ginger together in a spicy broth.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of lentil soup
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 6 quarts of water
- 4 c lentils, washed and rinsed
- 2 T ghee
- 1 T cumin seed
- 1 T black mustard seed
- 6-8 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 T ginger, chopped
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 1 can (14oz) diced tomatoes, drained
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
- 2 T cumin, ground
- 2 t coriander, ground
- 1 T salt, to taste
- 2 lemons
- 1 bunch of cilantro
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 quarts of water
  • 4 c lentils, washed and rinsed
  • 2 T ghee
  • 1 T cumin seed
  • 1 T black mustard seed
  • 6-8 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 T ginger, chopped
  • 1 onion, finely chopped
  • 1 can (14oz) diced tomatoes, drained
  • 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
  • 2 T cumin, ground
  • 2 t coriander, ground
  • 1 T salt, to taste
  • 2 lemons
  • 1 bunch of cilantro
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Bring a pot of 4-6 quarts of water to boil.
  2. Heat ghee in a separate pot on medium high heat. Fry cumin and black mustard seeds for 1 minute. Add onion and cook for 5 mins. Add garlic and ginger and cook until softened.
  3. Add tomatoes and sauté for 5 mins.
  4. Stir in lentils and add ground cumin, coriander and salt, sauté for 2 mins.
  5. Add 4 quarts of the boiling water from the first pot, bring to boil, then reduce heat to low, cover pot, and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
  6. Add more boiling water if needed.
  7. Add cayenne and salt to taste.
  8. Puree soup in blender or with immersion blender.
  9. Cut 2 lemons in half and squeeze juice into the soup, put lemon halves into soup along with chopped cilantro.
  10. Cook for another 10 minutes.
  11. Remove lemon halves.
  12. Adjust salt, pepper and cayenne to taste.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: French Onion Soup brings Parmesan and thyme together in a savory broth.
recipes.imageAlt: French onion soup topped with melted cheese
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- 4 cups sliced onions
- 4 (10.5 ounce) cans beef broth
- 2 Tbs dry sherry
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- salt and pepper to taste
- 4 slices French bread
- 4 slices provolone cheese
- 2 slices Swiss cheese, diced
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 cup unsalted butter
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 4 cups sliced onions
  • 4 (10.5 ounce) cans beef broth
  • 2 Tbs dry sherry
  • 1 tsp dried thyme
  • salt and pepper to taste

  • 4 slices provolone cheese
  • 2 slices Swiss cheese, diced

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Melt butter with olive oil in an 8 quart stock pot on medium heat. Add onions and continually stir until tender and translucent. Do not brown the onions.
  2. Add beef broth, sherry and thyme. Season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 30 minutes.
  3. Heat the oven broiler.
  4. Ladle soup into oven safe serving bowls and place one slice of bread on top of each (bread may be broken into pieces if you prefer).
  5. Layer each slice of bread with a slice of provolone, 1/2 slice diced Swiss and 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese.
  6. Place bowls on cookie sheet and broil in the preheated oven until cheese bubbles and browns slightly.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Lentil Soup brings cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika together in a bright broth.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of lentil soup
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 2 Tbs olive oil
* 1 medium onion, chopped
* 3 cloves garlic, minced
* 2 medium carrots, peeled and chopped
* 2 celery ribs, chopped
* 14- ounce can crushed or diced tomatoes
* 2 cups dry green or brown lentils (makes 5 to 6 cooked)
* 7 cups vegetable broth
* 1 tsp ground cumin
* 1 tsp ground coriander
* 1 tsp smoked paprika
* 1 tsp salt, or to taste
* 3 cups baby spinach, sliced into ribbons or kale
* 1 lemon, juiced (about 2 Tbs)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 medium onion, chopped
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 medium carrots, peeled and chopped
  • 2 celery ribs, chopped
  • 14- ounce can crushed or diced tomatoes
  • 2 cups dry green or brown lentils (makes 5 to 6 cooked)
  • 7 cups vegetable broth
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp ground coriander
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tsp salt, or to taste
  • 3 cups baby spinach, sliced into ribbons or kale
  • 1 lemon, juiced (about 2 Tbs)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions, garlic, carrots and celery. Cook, stirring frequently for about 4-5 minutes.
  2. Now add the can of tomatoes (with juices), lentils, vegetable broth, cumin, coriander and smoked paprika. Stir to incorporate everything.
  3. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to a simmer and cook for at least 30 minutes (large quantities take longer), until the lentils are tender and the soup has thickened.
  4. For a creamier texture, use an immersion blender to blend a few times in the pot.
  5. Stir in the spinach and lemon juice. It will only take a minute for the spinach to wilt. Season with salt to taste. ### Notes
  6. For a thinner soup, simply add more water or vegetable broth until the desired consistency is reached.
  7. Leftover soup will keep for up to 5 days in the refrigerator.
  8. This soup freezes well. Either freeze in individual containers or a large container for quick future meals.
  9. May substitute kale for the spinach, but you will need to cook the kale in the soup about 10 more minutes to get it tender.

- 1/4 cup butter, melted
- 2 stalks celery, diced
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 8 potatoes, peeled and cubed
- 4 cups chicken stock, or enough to cover potatoes
- 3 Tbs butter

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs of olive oil
  • 1/4 cup butter, melted
  • 2 stalks celery, diced
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 8 potatoes, peeled and cubed
  • 4 cups chicken stock, or enough to cover potatoes

  • 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 tsp dried tarragon
  • 3 tsp chopped fresh cilantro
  • salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Over medium heat, saute the celery and onion in olive oil until onion begins to turn clear.
  2. Add the garlic, and continue cooking for 1 to 2 minutes.
  3. Add the cubed potatoes, and toss to coat.
  4. Saute for 3 to 4 minutes.
  5. Add enough chicken stock to just cover the potatoes.
  6. Cover, and simmer until potatoes are tender.
  7. In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
  8. Whisk in the flour.
  9. Cook stirring constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes.
  10. Whisk in the heavy cream, tarragon and cilantro.
  11. Bring the cream mixture to a boil, and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
  12. Stir the cream mixture into the potato mixture.
  13. Puree about 1/2 the soup, and return to the pan.
  14. Adjust seasonings to taste.

recipes.title: Thai Rooster Soup
recipes.description: Thai Rooster Soup brings curry paste, cumin, and coconut milk together in a creamy broth.
recipes.imageAlt: A comforting bowl of chicken soup
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 4-6 whole roosters
* 5 lbs carrots, diced into 1/4"x 1/4" cubes
* 4 lbs greens, chopped
* 6-8 medium onions, finely chopped
* 1-2 bulbs garlic, finely chopped
* 1/2 can Thai panang curry paste
* 3 cans coconut milk
* 8 - 12 cups cooked brown rice
* 1/2 cup cooking oil
* 2 Tbs ground cumin
* salt and black pepper to taste
* 60 cups water/broth
* cilantro (optional)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4-6 whole roosters
  • 5 lbs carrots, diced into 1/4"x 1/4" cubes
  • 4 lbs greens, chopped
  • 6-8 medium onions, finely chopped
  • 1-2 bulbs garlic, finely chopped
  • 1/2 can Thai panang curry paste
  • 3 cans coconut milk
  • 8 - 12 cups cooked brown rice
  • 1/2 cup cooking oil
  • 2 Tbs ground cumin
  • salt and black pepper to taste
  • 60 cups water/broth
  • cilantro (optional)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. The goal of the rooster prep is a large bowl or bag of cooked, chopped meat and a significant amount of stock.
  2. There are a number of ways to get there but I recommend slow cooking the roosters in crock pots and/or large cooking pots with lots of water and some salt for 6+ hours.
  3. Crock pots work well because you can slow cook the meat overnight, which turns tough rooster into tender fowl.
  4. Debone/defat the rooster and chop into bite sized pieces.
  5. Strain the stock to remove debris and set both aside.
  6. Adding cooked rice to the soup at the end is a nice way to use up leftover rice but it also adds hearty bulk to the soup to make it a complete meal.
  7. Using between 8 - 12 cups of cooked rice works well so if you don't have it, now is a good time to start the rice.
  8. Cooking
  9. Combine stock and enough water to make 60 cups in a large pot and put on stove on medium high heat.
  10. Saute onions in 1/2 the oil on medium high heat until they start to caramelize.
  11. Add the garlic, panang curry paste and cumin and saute for 2 minutes mixing constantly.
  12. If your not sure how much Thai paste to add, put less than you think and add more later.
  13. It's spiciness is sneaky.
  14. Add diced carrots, mix well and saute for approximately 5 minutes, stirring frequently to cook evenly.
  15. When carrots begin to brown, add the bell peppers, mix and saute for another 2 minutes and then turn off the heat.
  16. The type and condition of the greens will dictate when and how they are entered into the mix.
  17. If you have greens that were previously chopped, blanched and frozen, they can simply be thawed (or kept frozen) and added to the stock/water as it heats up on the stove.
  18. If you have fresh greens, they should be added to the vegetables being sauted.
  19. Longer cooking greens should be added at the same time the carrots are added.
  20. Quick cooking greens, the kind you'd consider eating raw, can be added at the same time the peppers are added.
  21. Assuming the vegetables, with or without greens, are now complete, add them to the pot along with the rooster and coconut milk.
  22. Add salt and pepper to taste.
  23. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 30 minutes or so.
  24. Add cooked rice at the end of the simmering period just so it gets hot with the soup.
  25. Serve with cilantro if desired.
  26. Enjoy!
recipes.notesHtml: The soup was created during the period of nightly dinner offerings for the Community in Summer of 2010. It uses Dayempur rooster but could be altered to use other meat as desired. Dayempur veggies like carrots, greens and peppers are fantastic in this but other gifts from Allah are always welcome. The Thai panang curry paste gives it a nice kick and should be used in moderation. Serves 50 - 60.

recipes.title: Asiago Mushroom Chicken
recipes.description: Asiago Mushroom Chicken combines mushrooms, white wine, and thyme and is simmered for a creamy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (about 2 large)
- 2 cups mushrooms, cut in half
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 3 springs fresh thyme
- 1 1/2 cups dry white wine
- 1/2 cup seasoned flour
- 2 Tbs butter
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/4-1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese
- 1/2 tsp salt (or to taste)
- 1/4 tsp pepper (or to taste)

### seasoned flour

- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (about 2 large)
  • 2 cups mushrooms, cut in half
  • 1 clove garlic, minced
  • 3 springs fresh thyme
  • 1 1/2 cups dry white wine
  • 1/2 cup seasoned flour
  • 2 Tbs butter
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1/4-1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese

  • 1/4 tsp pepper (or to taste)

seasoned flour

  • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Pound chicken breast with a meat mallet between 2 sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap until meat is uniform thickness; about 1/4-inch.
  2. Cut into serving-sized pieces (2 or 3 pieces per breast)
  3. Heat the butter with *1* tbs of olive oil in deep, heavy skillet or saute pan over medium heat.
  4. Dredge chicken in seasoned flour. Add to hot oil/butter in skillet. Saute until golden on each side, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from pan.
  5. Add remaining olive oil to hot skillet. Saute mushrooms and garlic until mushrooms begin to brown.
  6. Add white wine to skillet, scraping up all the browned bits that are at the bottom of the pan (this is called "deglazing").
  7. Bruise the fresh thyme by twisting it between your fingers or hitting it with the dull side of a knife in a few places.
  8. Add thyme to mushroom/wine mixture in pan.
  9. Add the chicken back to the pan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
  10. Remove chicken from pan.
  11. Add the cream and heat through.
  12. Add the asiago cheese (if you like it strongly flavored, use 1/2 cup; not as strongly flavored, use the 1/4 cup--asiago is a powerful cheese and you can even use less for just a whisper of flavor.
  13. I like it strong so I used 1/2 cup).
  14. Cook, stirring constantly over low heat until cheese melts.
  15. Continue cooking until sauce is reduced by about 1/2.
  16. If you wish to skip the reduction step, you may thicken the sauce slightly with about 1 tbs instant flour or 1 tbs cornstarch mixed with 2 tbs water...however, the reduction will taste better.
  17. Add chicken back to pan and heat through.

recipes.title: BBQ Brisket
recipes.description: Apples gives BBQ Brisket its defining flavor before being grilled.
recipes.imageAlt: Sliced barbecue beef brisket
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 5 - 10lb choice or prime brisket
- 1/2 c salt
- 3/4 c pepper, coarse
- 1/4 c celery seed
- spray bottle with water or apple cider vinegar or apple juice
- butcher paper
- foil (optional)

- Total Time

- Trim
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 5 - 10lb choice or prime brisket

  • 1/2 c salt

  • 3/4 c pepper, coarse

  • 1/4 c celery seed

  • spray bottle with water or apple cider vinegar or apple juice

  • butcher paper

  • foil (optional)

  • Total Time

  • Trim
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Prep will take 1.5 hours for trimming, rubbing and letting the rub set.
  2. Cook time will vary depending on weight and wrapping.
  3. Expect 1.5 hours/lb.
  4. Recent example was a 5.5lb brisket and it took 9 hours with no wrapping.
  5. Rest time will also depend on cook time.
  6. Expect at least 1 - 2 hours to rest.
  7. Take brisket out of fridge.
  8. Dry meat by patting with napkins.
  9. Do not rinse with water.
  10. Trim it while it's still cold.
  11. Trim the fat cap and remove silver lining.
  12. Goal is no more than 1/4 inch of fat.
  13. Rub
  14. Larger smokers that generate more smoke require less complexities in the rub.
  15. A simple salt and pepper rub will do.
  16. Smaller grills or pellet grills, don't generate as much smoke so you may want more flavor.
  17. Be careful of small particles in the rub (e.g. powders) and/or putting too much on.
  18. Use a medium heavy coating because too much rub will prevent smoke from entering the meat.
  19. Pat rub in.
  20. Let rubbed meat sit for 1 hour.
  21. Temperature
  22. Depending on your grill, set the temperature accordingly:
  23. - pellet grill (225)
  24. - ceramic cooker (225)
  25. - Weber smoky or kettle grill (225 - 250)
  26. - giant smoker or offset (275)
  27. Put brisket on grill rack with fat cap side up with point facing the smoker.
  28. After 2 hours with water, apple cider vinegar or apple juice. Spray every 30-60 minutes to keep meat moist. You can also use please a water bowl in the grill to help.
  29. Put one temperature probe in the point and one in the flat.
  30. If you only have or want to use one probe, put it in the point.
  31. The goal is to get the bark from red mahogony to a darker color before wrapping.
  32. Wrap
  33. If you going to use wrap, here's what to look for to know when it's time:
  34. Color. Darker the brisket, more smoke flavor.
  35. Bark. Mixture of smoke, fat and rub.
  36. Evaporation. You want sweat on the outside. Shrunk about 40%. If you don't sweat it enough, the bark will come off during the wrap
  37. Fat render. When fat turns yellow and the brisket allows you to poke it easily
  38. Temperature. Last thing to check. 165 - 175 degrees.
  39. Wrap the meat tightly in butcher paper so there are no leaks. You can optionally wrap it again w/ foil.
  40. Test for Doneness:
  41. 195 - 203 degrees for 30 minutes.
  42. If it feels like a big piece of jello, iet's probably done.
  43. Bamboo skewer. Poke and it should go in and out like peanut butter
  44. Rest and Eat
  45. The longer the cook time, the longer the rest time.
  46. Wrap in towel and let it rest 1 - 2 hours in a cooler.
  47. Serve it at 145 degrees.
  48. Cut between point and flat.
  49. Cut flat against the grain.
  50. Rotate point 90 degrees and cut against the grain.
  51. Use a serated bread knife.

recipes.title: BBQ Burnt Ends
recipes.description: BBQ Burnt Ends is grilled for a sweet-savory, deeply seasoned result.
recipes.imageAlt: Sliced barbecue beef brisket
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 3 pound chuck roast
- 1/2 cup BBQ sauce your favorite brand/recipe
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 2 Tbs brown sugar

- Simple Beef Rub
- 1 Tbs coarse Kosher salt
- 1 Tbs coarse ground black pepper
- 1 Tbs garlic powder
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3 pound chuck roast

  • 1/2 cup BBQ sauce your favorite brand/recipe

  • 1/4 cup brown sugar

  • 2 Tbs brown sugar

  • Simple Beef Rub

  • 1 Tbs coarse Kosher salt

  • 1 Tbs coarse ground black pepper

  • 1 Tbs garlic powder
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat your smoker for indirect grilling at 275 degrees F. Use hickory or oak wood for the most complementary smoke flavor.
  2. In a small bowl, combine the salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
  3. Season your chuck roast liberally on all sides with the rub mixture.
  4. When your smoker is to temperature, place the seasoned roast on the grill and cover.
  5. Smoke the roast until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees F (this took 5 hours on my smoker).
  6. You should have a fairly nice dark bark on the exterior of your roast at this point.
  7. Wrap in either butcher paper or foil and return to the grill until the internal temperature is 195 degrees (this took just over an hour).
  8. Remove the wrapped roast from the grill and allow to rest for 15-20 minutes.
  9. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes and transfer to a foil baking pan.
  10. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup brown sugar and drizzle with most of the BBQ sauce, reserving a couple of tablespoons for later.
  11. Toss gently to coat all of the pieces in a little of the sauce.
  12. Place the pan on the grill, close the lid and cook for an additional 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the sauce is bubbly and the cubed bits of beef are falling apart tender.
  13. Sprinkle with the additional 2 Tablespoons of brown sugar and the remaining BBQ sauce. stir gently and return to the grill for just a few more minutes until everything is well incorporated.
  14. Serve hot as a main course or on white bread/buns with pickles and white onions.

recipes.description: Baked Chicken Breasts combine chile powder, rosemary, and oregano and are baked for a spicy finish.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 large chicken breasts (7oz | 200g each)
- 1 Tbs brown sugar, packed
- 1 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp dried oregano, (or thyme, parsley, rosemary)
- 1 tsp salt, (use seasoned salt, Adobo or chicken salt for extra flavour)
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp onion powder
- 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper, to taste
- 1 tsp chili powder
- 1 Tbs olive oil
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 large chicken breasts (7oz | 200g each)
  • 1 Tbs brown sugar, packed
  • 1 1/2 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp dried oregano, (or thyme, parsley, rosemary)
  • 1 tsp salt, (use seasoned salt, Adobo or chicken salt for extra flavour)

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F | 220°C (standard ovens) or 390°F | 200°C (fan forced or convection ovens).
  2. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound each chicken breast to 0.8-inch | 2cm at the thickest part. Make sure your fillets are all the same thickness to ensure even cooking.
  3. OPTIONAL STEP: Mix 1/2 c salt in 2 c water and brine the chicken for 15 minutes
  4. Combine sugar, paprika, oregano, salt, powders, pepper and chili (if using).
  5. Line a baking pan with parchment (or baking) paper. Transfer chicken to the pan and toss chicken in the seasoning. Drizzle with the oil and rub seasoning all over to evenly coat.
  6. Bake chicken in preheated oven for 16-18 minutes, or until internal temperature is 165°F (75°C) using a meat thermometer. It should be golden with crisp edges.*
  7. Remove pan from oven, transfer chicken to serving plates and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
  8. OPTIONAL STEP: While chicken is in the oven, melt butter in a small skillet.
  9. Sauté garlic until fragrant (30 seconds), and remove pan from heat.
  10. Stir in parsley, then pour butter mixture into pan juices, stirring well to combine all of the flavours together.
  11. To serve, drizzle pan juices over the chicken and garnish with freshly chopped parsley.

recipes.description: Baked Chicken Strips combine buttermilk, Parmesan, and dill and are baked for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp golden fried chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken
- breast halves
- 2 eggs
- 6 Tbs buttermilk
- 1 1/2 cups dried bread crumbs
- 1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 1/2 tsp dried dill weed
- 1/3 cup butter, melted
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken
  • breast halves
  • 2 eggs
  • 6 Tbs buttermilk
  • 1 1/2 cups dried bread crumbs

  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
  • 1 1/2 tsp dried dill weed
  • 1/3 cup butter, melted
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
  2. Remove all fat from chicken breasts and cut into 1 inch by 4 inch strips.
  3. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and buttermilk.
  4. In a plastic resealable bag mix together the bread crumbs, grated cheese, garlic powder, salt, pepper and dill weed.
  5. Dip each chicken strips into buttermilk mixture, then into bread crumb mixture (about 4 strips at a time), and toss to coat well.
  6. Place strips in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish and drizzle with melted butter/margarine.
  7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown, turning once after about 8 minutes of baking time.

recipes.title: Balsamic Onion Beef Roast
recipes.description: Balsamic vinegar gives Balsamic Onion Beef Roast its defining flavor before being slow-cooked.
recipes.imageAlt: A grilled beef steak sliced for serving
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 beef roast (chuck, arm) about 3lbs
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1-2 T olive oil (depends on your pan)
- 2 large onions, peeled and thickly sliced
- 1 cup beef stock
- 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
- 1/2 cup tomato sauce
recipes.ingredientsHtml:

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Rub meat well with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Heat heavy pan with olive oil and brown roast well on all sides. This will take a few minutes; don't rush the browning step.
  2. While roast browns mix beef stock, balsamic vinegar and tomato sauce. Peel onions and cut into thick slices.
  3. Place onions in bottom of slow cooker or dutch oven.
  4. Put meat on top of onions and pour beef stock mixture over.
  5. Cook on low in slow cooker for 6-8 hours or at 325 degrees in oven for 3-4 hours, until beef is tender.
  6. The meat might be partly submerged in liquid after this much time.
  7. Remove meat from slow cooker or dutch oven and cover with foil to keep warm. Drain liquid and cook down by about 1/3, and serve sauce with meat and onions.

recipes.title: Beans and Rice with Andouille Sausage
recipes.description: Beans and Rice with Andouille Sausage combines toasted sesame oil, cayenne, and andouille sausage for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A fragrant rice dish with vegetables and herbs
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 pound of red adzuki beans
- Water to cover the beans
- 6-8 cups of water
- 2 Tbs of sesame oil
- 3 stalks of celery, medium dice
- 1 each red and orange pepper, medium dice
- 1 red onion, medium dice
- 3 cloves of garlic, minced
- 2 bay leaves
- 1 tsp white pepper
- 1/4 tsp of freshly ground black pepper
- 1 tsp of dried Italian herbs
- 1/2 tsp of cayenne pepper
- 1/2 pound of andouille sausage
- salt and Tabasco sauce to taste
- Cooked long grain white rice
- Green onions sliced on a bias for garnish
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 pound of red adzuki beans
  • Water to cover the beans
  • 6-8 cups of water
  • 2 Tbs of sesame oil
  • 3 stalks of celery, medium dice
  • 1 each red and orange pepper, medium dice
  • 1 red onion, medium dice
  • 3 cloves of garlic, minced
  • 2 bay leaves
  • 1 tsp white pepper
  • 1/4 tsp of freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 tsp of dried Italian herbs
  • 1/2 tsp of cayenne pepper
  • 1/2 pound of andouille sausage
  • salt and Tabasco sauce to taste
  • Cooked long grain white rice
  • Green onions sliced on a bias for garnish
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Soak the beans in cold, clean water overnight or for at least for 8 hours. Afterwards rinse, drain and reserve for later in the cooking process.
  2. In a 5-quart Dutch oven on medium heat, add the red palm oil.
  3. When the oil is hot, add the andouille sausage and lightly caramelize.
  4. Remove the sausage with a slotted spoon and reserve until later.
  5. To the pan, add the celery, peppers, onion, and sweat the vegetables for about 5 minutes until the onions are translucent and the celery has brightened.
  6. As the vegetables cook, make sure you work up any of the sausage fragments from the bottom of the pot.
  7. At this point, add the garlic and spices and beans, cover and cook for an hour on low heat.
  8. Add the andouille back to the pan and increase the heat to medium.
  9. Cook the red adzuki beans until they are tender and mixture begins to thicken slightly.
  10. Adjust the seasoning with salt and Tabasco.
  11. To serve, ladle approximately 1 cup of the mixture into a bowl and top with a dallop of white rice and a sprinkling of the bias cup green onions.
  12. Of course, Tabasco should always be close by.
