recipes.title: Beef Brisket with Chimichurri Sauce
recipes.description: Beef Brisket with Chimichurri Sauce combines jalapeño, cilantro, and oregano in a spicy sauce.
recipes.imageAlt: Sliced barbecue beef brisket
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 7 garlic cloves, peeled
- 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and coarsley chopped
- 7 bay leaves
- 1 1/4 cups flat leaf parsley
- 2/3 cup cilantro leaves
- 2 1/2 Tbs dried oregano
- 1 1/4 cups distilled white vinegar
- kosher salt
- 2 cups water

- Brisket
- 3 1/2 lbs beef brisket, soaked in cold water to cover for 1 hour, drained
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 7 garlic cloves, peeled

  • 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and coarsley chopped

  • 7 bay leaves

  • 1 1/4 cups flat leaf parsley

  • 2/3 cup cilantro leaves

  • 2 1/2 Tbs dried oregano

  • 1 1/4 cups distilled white vinegar

  • kosher salt

  • 2 cups water

  • Brisket

  • 3 1/2 lbs beef brisket, soaked in cold water to cover for 1 hour, drained
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a food processor, with the machine running, drop garlic, jalapenos and bay leaves through the feed tube to chop them.
  2. Add parsley, cilantro and oregano.
  3. Pulse to chop.
  4. Then, with the machine running, add the vinegar and oil, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed, and blend until smooth.
  5. Season, to taste, with salt.
  6. Pour 1 cup of the chimichurri into a covered container and refrigerate.
  7. Mix the remaining chimichurri with the water in a large non-reactive (stainless steel, ceramic or glass) baking dish.
  8. Marinate the meat in this for 24 to 48 hours, covered with plastic wrap, in the refrigerator.
  9. When ready to cook, postition rack in center of Preheated 350 degree oven.
  10. Transfer brisket and marinade to a roasting pan or non-reactive dutch oven.
  11. Cover and bake until very tender; around 3 1/2 hours.
  12. Cool slightly before cutting on the diagonal.
  13. Serve with the heated cup of chimichurri sauce that was reserved.
recipes.notesHtml:
Beef Brisket With Chimichurri - Latin Style

Note, this has a 24-48 hour marination

Chimichurri

recipes.description: Mexican-inspired Beef Chimichanga combines cumin and chile powder and is baked for a spicy finish.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 pound lean ground beef
- 3/4 cup chopped onion
- 3/4 cup diced green bell pepper
- 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn
- 2 cups taco sauce
- 2 tsp chili powder
- 1 tsp garlic salt
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 (16 ounce) can refried beans
- 8 (12 inch) flour tortillas
- 1 (16 ounce) package shredded Monterey Jack cheese

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 pound lean ground beef
  • 3/4 cup chopped onion
  • 3/4 cup diced green bell pepper
  • 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn
  • 2 cups taco sauce
  • 2 tsp chili powder
  • 1 tsp garlic salt
  • 1 tsp ground cumin

  • shredded lettuce
  • 1 tomato, diced
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
  2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat.
  3. Drain excess grease, and add the onion, bell pepper, and corn.
  4. Cook for about 5 more minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
  5. Stir in the taco sauce, and season with chili powder, garlic salt and cumin, stirring until blended.
  6. Cook until heated through, then remove from heat, and set aside.
  7. Open the can of beans, and spread a thin layer of beans onto each of the tortillas.
  8. Spoon the beef mixture down the center, and then top with as much shredded cheese as you like.
  9. Roll up the tortillas, and place them seam-side down onto a baking sheet.
  10. Brush the tortillas with melted butter.
  11. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown. Serve with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Beef Fajitas
recipes.description: Beef Fajitas combine cumin, chile powder, and soy sauce and are grilled for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Seasoned Mexican-style beef with peppers
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 cup soy sauce
- 1/2 cup lime juice from 6 to 8 limes
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
- 2 tsp ground cumin
- 2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
- 1 Tbs chili powder (see note above)
- 3 medium cloves garlic, finely minced (about 1 Tbs)
- 2 pounds trimmed skirt steak
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 cup soy sauce
  • 1/2 cup lime juice from 6 to 8 limes
  • 1/2 cup vegetable oil
  • 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
  • 2 tsp ground cumin
  • 2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 Tbs chili powder (see note above)
  • 3 medium cloves garlic, finely minced (about 1 Tbs)
  • 2 pounds trimmed skirt steak
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Combine soy sauce, lime juice, oil, brown sugar, cumin, black pepper, chili powder, and garlic in a medium bowl and whisk to combine.
  2. Place steaks in a gallon-sized zipper-lock bag and add marinade.
  3. Seal bag, squeezing out as much air as possible.
  4. Massage bag until meat is fully coated in marinade.
  5. Lay flat in the refrigerator, turning every couple of hours for at least 3 hours but no more than 10.
  6. When ready to cook, remove steaks from marinade, wipe off excess, and transfer to a large plate.
  7. Clean and oil the grilling grate.
  8. Put steaks on grate, cover and cook for 1 minute.
  9. Flip steaks, cover and cook for another minute.
  10. Continue cooking in this manner—flipping and covering—until steaks are well-charred and an instant-read thermometer inserted into their center registers 125 to 130°F for medium.
  11. Transfer steaks to a large plate, tent with foil, and allow to rest for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 lb beef flank steak
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp pepper

### Argentinian chimichurri sauce

- 1 bulb garlic
- 1 fresh jalepeno
- 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves
- 1 cup fresh parsley leaves
- 2 limes (or lemons)
- 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
- 1/2 cup olive oil

• 1 lb beef flank steak
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp pepper

Argentinian chimichurri sauce

  • 1 tsp salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Rub olive oil, salt and pepper over the steak and let sit for a few minutes while you make the chimichurri sauce.
  2. To make the sauce, roughly chop 10+ cloves of garlic. Use 1 tsp of salt as abrasive to roughly mix w/ garlic using blade and side of knife. Put in bowl.
  3. Chop oregano and parsley leaves fine and add to bowl.
  4. Mince jalepeno w/ or w/out seeds and add to bowl.
  5. Add juice of 2 limes, a splash of red wine vinegar and mix or blend until pieces are small.
  6. Add lots of olive oil and mix well until a runny pesto texture.
  7. Grill steak from medium rare to medium.
  8. You can baste the steak w/ the sauce while cooking and/or serve sauce at the table.
  9. Remove from grill and cut/shave slices across the grain approximately 2 - 4 inches long, 1/4 inch thick.
  10. Serve with sauce.
  11. Chimichurri.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. optional spices (1 Tbs ground coriander, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 Tbs ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper)
  2. Moisten the bread crumbs with the milk in a large bowl, and set aside.
  3. Mince the garlic in a food processor, then add the onion, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper.
  4. Process until the onion is finely chopped.
  5. Add the onion mixture to the bowl with the moist bread crumbs, along with the beef and eggs.
  6. Mix with your hands until thoroughly blended.
  7. Spread mixture onto flat surface and divide into 24 equal-size portions.
  8. Roll each into a ball and then flatten into desired shape.
  9. Make flatter than you'd think as they rise when cooked.
  10. Put some flour on a plate or in a bowl, dip each patty into flour and fry in skillet until well browned and cooked through.
  11. These can also be grilled but oil them well before putting them on.
  12. Tzatziki cups yogurt cucumber unpeeled and seeded lemon, juice only cloves garlic, minced
  13. 1/4 cup olive oil tsp salt tsp dill
  14. Pinch freshly ground black pepper
  15. Place the yogurt in a cheesecloth or paper towel-lined sieve and set it over a bowl.
  16. Grate the cucumber and toss it with 1 tablespoon of kosher salt; place it in another sieve, and set it over another bowl.
  17. Place both bowls in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours so the yogurt and cucumber can drain.
  18. Transfer the thickened yogurt to a large bowl.
  19. Rinse salt off and squeeze as much liquid from the cucumber as you can and add the cucumber to the yogurt.
  20. Mix in the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, dill, salt, and pepper.
  21. You can serve it immediately, but I prefer to allow the tzatziki to sit in the refrigerator for a few hours for the flavors to blend.
  22. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. FOR THE MEATLOAF: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
  2. Heat oil in medium skillet.
  3. Add onion and garlic; saute until softened, about 5 minutes.
  4. Set aside to cool while preparing remaining ingredients.
  5. Mix eggs with thyme, salt, pepper, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pepper sauce, and milk or yogurt.
  6. Add egg mixture to meat in large bowl along with bread crumbs, parsley, and cooked onion and garlic; mix with fork until evenly blended and meat mixture does not stick to bowl. (If mixture sticks, add additional milk or yogurt, a couple tablespoons at a time until mix no longer sticks.)

  11. Bake loaf until loaf registers 160 degrees, about 1 hour.
  12. Cool at least 20 minutes.
  13. Simmer remaining glaze over medium heat until thickened slightly.
  14. Slice meat loaf and serve with extra glaze passed separately.

- 1 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp thyme
- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
- 2 cups vegetable broth
- 1/4 cup white cooking wine
- 2 cups sour cream or plain yogurt
- 4 Tbs of flour

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 lbs ground beef
  • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • 3 - 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1/2 stick of butter
  • 4 (8-oz.) packages sliced mushrooms

  • 1 tsp thyme

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat, saute onion and garlic in butter until softened.
  2. Increase heat to medium-high, add mushrooms, thyme, paprika, cayenne pepper, and some salt and continue to saute until mushrooms begin to brown.
  3. Remove mushroom/onion mixture to bowl and set aside.
  4. In the same skillet, over medium high heat, cook and crumble ground beef.

  6. In the same skillet, over high heat, add broth and wine to pan drippings.
  7. Bring to a boil and reduce by 1/3.
  8. Lower heat to simmer and return mushroom/onion mixture to skillet.
  9. In a small bowl, combine sour cream and flour until smooth.
  10. Stir in sour cream mixture and continue stirring until sauce thickens.
  11. Stir in parsley (optional) and season with salt and pepper.
  12. Serve over hot cooked noodles.

- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
- 1/4 tsp onion powder
- 1/4 tsp cumin
- 1 tsp olive oil
- 2 c chicken stock
- 1 c of quinoa
- Juice and Zest from Two Limes
- A Dash of Salt and Pepper
- 2 Tbs of Cilantro, chopped
- Avocado
- Greek yogurt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts
  • 1/2 tsp paprika
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
  • 1/4 tsp onion powder
  • 1/4 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 2 c chicken stock

  • Juice and Zest from Two Limes

  • Avocado

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Combine all the dry seasonings in a small bowl. Mix them together and then season both sides of each chicken breast.
  2. Add the teaspoon of olive oil to a large pan or skillet.
  3. Heat the olive oil for a minute over medium/high heat.
  4. Add the chicken breasts to the pan.
  5. Cook for seven minutes on each side with the lid on.
  6. Add the chicken stock and quinoa to a medium sauce pan.
  7. Bring to a simmer over medium/low heat.
  8. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for ten to fifteen minutes with the lid on, until all the stock has been absorbed.
  9. After the chicken breasts have cooked all the way through, remove them from the pan and let them rest for seven minutes before slicing them.
  10. Add the warm quinoa to a large bowl. Toss in the lime zest, lime juice, salt and pepper, and chopped cilantro. Mix to combine.
  11. Serve the sliced chicken breast on top of the quinoa. If you find the blackened seasoning too spicy, you can add a quick and easy avocado cream sauce to cool it down.
  12. Just place the flesh from an avocado along with two tablespoons of Greek yogurt in a food processor and puree until smooth

recipes.title: Braised Chicken Thighs with Garlic, Lemon, and Greek Olives
recipes.description: Braised Chicken Thighs with Garlic, Lemon, and Greek Olives combine oregano and lemon and are baked for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
- Salt and black pepper, to taste
- 3 Tbs extra-virgin olive oil
- 12 garlic cloves
- 2 large yellow onions, thinly sliced (about 4 cups)
- 1 lemon, thinly sliced, seeds discarded
- 2 Tbs fresh oregano leaves, plus more for garnish
- 1 cup mixed Greek olives
- Juice of 1 lemon
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
  • Salt and black pepper, to taste
  • 3 Tbs extra-virgin olive oil
  • 12 garlic cloves
  • 2 large yellow onions, thinly sliced (about 4 cups)
  • 1 lemon, thinly sliced, seeds discarded
  • 2 Tbs fresh oregano leaves, plus more for garnish
  • 1 cup mixed Greek olives
  • Juice of 1 lemon
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Remove the chicken from the fridge 20 minutes before cooking to remove the chill. Preheat the oven to 350°. Season the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper.
  2. In a large ovenproof pan or Dutch oven large enough to hold all the thighs in a single layer, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
  3. When the oil is hot, add the chicken, skin-side down, and sear until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes.
  4. Add the garlic cloves to the pan and flip the thighs over.
  5. Cook until the garlic is fragrant and has gotten a little brown, 2 to 3 minutes.
  6. Remove the chicken and garlic from the pan and set aside.
  7. With the pan is still hot, add the onions, lemon slices and oregano, and season with salt and pepper.
  8. Cook, stirring often, until the onions have wilted and the brown bits on the bottom of the pan have loosened, 6 to 8 minutes.
  9. Nestle the thighs skin-side up in the onion mixture and add the garlic and the olives.
  10. Pour the lemon juice over the chicken and transfer the pan to the oven.
  11. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes.
  12. Scatter fresh oregano leaves over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry I
recipes.description: Indian-inspired Chicken Curry I combines tandoori spices, coriander, and ginger and is pan-fried for a creamy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Chicken curry served in a bowl
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs
- 1/4 cup cooking oil
- 2 cups onions, finely chopped
- 6 cloves garlic, finely chopped
- 2 Tbs paprika
- 1 Tbs ginger root, grated
- 1 Tbs coriander, ground
- 2 tsp salt
- 2 Tbs Madras curry powder
- 1 Tbs Tandoori masala
- 2 cups yogurt or buttermilk
- 1 6oz. can tomato paste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs
  • 1/4 cup cooking oil
  • 2 cups onions, finely chopped
  • 6 cloves garlic, finely chopped
  • 2 Tbs paprika
  • 1 Tbs ginger root, grated
  • 1 Tbs coriander, ground
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 2 Tbs Madras curry powder
  • 1 Tbs Tandoori masala
  • 2 cups yogurt or buttermilk
  • 1 6oz. can tomato paste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large skillet, brown chicken in hot oil; remove and set aside.
  2. In same skillet cook onion and garlic in hot oil until tender and slightly browned.
  3. Add spices.
  4. Fry together for a minute or so and then gradually stir in yogurt or buttermilk and tomato paste (easier if blended w/ a little yogurt/milk first).
  5. Return chicken to skillet.
  6. Cover and simmer 35 minutes or until chicken is tender, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Mexican-inspired Chicken Enchiladas combine chile powder, lime, and sour cream and are baked for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into chunks
- 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
- 1 1/4 cups sour cream
- 1/4 tsp chili powder
- 1 Tbs butter
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chilies, drained
- 1 bunch green onions, chopped, divided
- 1 cup water
- 1 tsp lime juice
- 1/2 tsp onion powder
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 5 (12 inch) flour tortillas
- 3 cups Cheddar cheese, shredded, divided
- 1 (10 ounce) can enchilada sauce
- 1 (6 ounce) can sliced black olives
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into chunks
  • 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
  • 1 1/4 cups sour cream
  • 1/4 tsp chili powder
  • 1 Tbs butter
  • 1 small onion, chopped
  • 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chilies, drained
  • 1 bunch green onions, chopped, divided
  • 1 cup water
  • 1 tsp lime juice
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 5 (12 inch) flour tortillas
  • 3 cups Cheddar cheese, shredded, divided
  • 1 (10 ounce) can enchilada sauce
  • 1 (6 ounce) can sliced black olives
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Place the chicken in a large pot and add water to cover.
  2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the chicken pieces are no longer pink, about 10 minutes.
  3. Shred chicken by placing two forks back to back and pulling meat apart.
  4. Set the shredded chicken aside.
  5. Meanwhile, combine the cream of chicken soup, sour cream, and chili powder in a saucepan.
  6. Bring to a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, then turn off the heat and cover to keep warm.
  7. Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
  8. Stir in the onion; cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes.
  9. Add the shredded chicken, chopped green chilies, taco seasoning, half of the bunch of chopped green onion, and water.
  10. Allow to simmer for 10 minutes.
  11. Stir in the lime juice, onion powder, and garlic powder; simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
  12. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
  13. Stir 1 cup of the soup mixture into the skillet with the chicken mixture.
  14. Spread the remaining soup mixture on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
  15. Fill each tortilla with chicken mixture.
  16. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over the chicken filling before folding the tortillas, reserving half of the shredded cheese for topping the enchiladas.
  17. Fold tortillas over the filling and place seam-side down in the prepared pan.
  18. Pour enchilada sauce evenly over the enchiladas.
  19. Cover with the remaining 1 1/2 cups of Cheddar cheese.
  20. Sprinkle the reserved chopped green onions and the sliced olives on top of the cheese.
  21. Bake in the preheated oven until filling is heated through and the cheese is melted and bubbling, about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried with Country Gravy
recipes.description: Chicken Fried with Country Gravy combines cumin and cayenne in a spicy gravy.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp golden fried chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves at room temperature
- 2 eggs
- 1 1/2 cups milk at room temperature
- 2 cups flour
- 2 tsp meat seasoning (see below)
- 2 cups frying oil
- 2 cups milk - at room temperature
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp pepper
- 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce

- Meat seasoning
- 1/2 cup kosher salt
- 4 Tbs black pepper
- 2 Tbs white pepper
- 1 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
- 2 Tbs granulated onion
- 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin
- 4 Tbs granulated garlic

- Pound chicken breasts between sheets of wax paper until thin.
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves at room temperature

  • 2 eggs

  • 1 1/2 cups milk at room temperature

  • 2 cups flour

  • 2 tsp meat seasoning (see below)

  • 2 cups frying oil

  • 2 cups milk - at room temperature

  • 1 tsp salt

  • 1 tsp pepper

  • 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce

  • Meat seasoning

  • 1/2 cup kosher salt

  • 4 Tbs black pepper

  • 2 Tbs white pepper

  • 1 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper

  • 2 Tbs granulated onion

  • 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin

  • 4 Tbs granulated garlic

  • Pound chicken breasts between sheets of wax paper until thin.
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Whisk eggs and milk together in a bowl and set this egg wash aside.
  2. Combine the flour and meat seasoning in another bowl and set aside.
  3. Heat the oil in a heavy 14-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat to 350 degrees F.
  4. Use a 550 degree thermometer to check temperature.
  5. The oil should pop loudly when a drop of egg wash is dropped in.
  6. Dip each of the first 3 breasts in the egg wash mixture.
  7. Dredge them in the flour, then dip them back into the egg wash, and very gently place them in the hot oil.
  8. As you carry them one at a time from the egg wash to the skillet, hold a plate under them to catch the dripping egg wash.
  9. Therell be a regular explosion of noisy oil a-popping.
  10. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until breading is set and golden brown. Gently turn them with a long-handled meat fork or long metal tongs. Be careful. Cook another 3 minutes.
  11. Carefully remove them from the skillet and drain on a platter lined with paper towels. Let oil reheat and repeat process for other 3 breasts.
  12. Country Gravy
  13. Pour off all but 4 tablespoons of the fat.
  14. Sprinkle 4 tablespoons of the dredging flour into oil.
  15. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of skillet.
  16. Gradually whisk in milk.
  17. Cook, stirring frequently, 3 to 4 minutes, or until thickened and bubbly.
  18. Add salt, pepper and Tabasco; gravy should be quite peppery.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
recipes.description: Chicken Marsala combines mushrooms and oregano and is simmered for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour for coating
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 1 Tbs minced garlic
- 2 Tbs finely chopped shallots
- 1 8 oz package sliced mushrooms
- 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded 1/4 inch thick
- 4 Tbs clarified butter (ghee)
- 1 Tbs butter
- 4 Tbs olive oil
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- 1/2 cup Marsala wine
- 1/4 cup cooking sherry
- 2 Tbs half-and-half
- 3/4 cup veggie or chicken broth
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/4 cup all-purpose flour for coating
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
  • 1/2 tsp dried oregano
  • 1 Tbs minced garlic
  • 2 Tbs finely chopped shallots
  • 1 8 oz package sliced mushrooms
  • 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded 1/4 inch thick
  • 4 Tbs clarified butter (ghee)
  • 1 Tbs butter
  • 4 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 cup sliced mushrooms
  • 1/2 cup Marsala wine
  • 1/4 cup cooking sherry
  • 2 Tbs half-and-half
  • 3/4 cup veggie or chicken broth
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a shallow dish or bowl, mix together the flour, salt, pepper and oregano. Coat chicken pieces in flour mixture.
  2. In a large skillet, sauté mushrooms, shallots and garlic in a little oil over medium heat.
  3. Cook 3 minutes or until moisture evaporates; remove mushroom mixture from pan and set aside.
  4. Melt butter in oil over medium heat.
  5. Cook chicken in the pan 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned.
  6. Remove chicken from pan.
  7. Return mushroom mixture to pan, add broth and wines, scraping pan to loosen browned bits.
  8. Bring mixture to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
  9. Add 1 Tbs of butter, half-and-half, salt and pepper, stirring until butter melts.
  10. Return chicken to pan and cook until thoroughly heated.
  11. Serve over angel hair or other thin pasta or rice; if desired garnish with arugula.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Lemon gives italian-inspired Chicken Piccata its defining flavor.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 1-1/4 pounds)
- 2/3 cup flour
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp pepper
- 1/2 tsp Italian herbs, dried (opt)
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- 1 stick salted butter
- 1/2 cup Mirin cooking wine
- 1 fresh lemon for lemon juice
- 2 Tbs capers
- 2 cups stock (veggie or chicken)
- 10 ounces fettuccine, linguini, or angel hair pasta
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 1-1/4 pounds)
  • 2/3 cup flour
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1/2 tsp Italian herbs, dried (opt)
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 stick salted butter
  • 1/2 cup Mirin cooking wine
  • 1 fresh lemon for lemon juice
  • 2 Tbs capers
  • 2 cups stock (veggie or chicken)
  • 10 ounces fettuccine, linguini, or angel hair pasta
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Pound chicken breasts until flat and thin (1/4-inch thick).
  2. Mix flour, salt, pepper, and herbs in a bowl.
  3. Heat olive oil and 3 Tbs of butter in frying pan over medium heat until butter foams.
  4. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and brown chicken in pan.
  5. Remove chicken from pan and turn up heat to medium high briefly and add wine and lemon juice all at once.
  6. Cook while stirring to reduce and thicken - approximately 10 minutes.
  7. Turn heat back down to medium.
  8. Incorporate the broth into the sauce in order to thin it a bit and to yield more sauce.
  9. Remove from heat and stir in capers and remaining butter.
  10. Serve over pasta; if desired garnish with arugula.
recipes.notesHtml: for a thicker sauce, create a basic roux (3 tablespoons butter + 3 tablespoons flour) and whisk it into the sauce with the broth.

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffed with Goat Cheese and Sundried Tomatoes
recipes.description: Chicken Stuffed with Goat Cheese and Sundried Tomatoes combine feta, Parmesan, and spinach and are baked for a creamy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded thin
- 1 (8 ounce) bottle Italian-style salad dressing
- 8 slices of stale wheat bread, torn
- 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme
- 1/8 tsp pepper
- 1 1/2 cups feta cheese, crumbled
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 1 Tbs vegetable oil
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 4 cups chopped fresh spinach
- 1 bunch green onions, chopped
- 1 cup mushrooms, sliced
- 1 (8 ounce) jar oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded thin
  • 1 (8 ounce) bottle Italian-style salad dressing
  • 8 slices of stale wheat bread, torn
  • 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
  • 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme
  • 1/8 tsp pepper
  • 1 1/2 cups feta cheese, crumbled
  • 1/2 cup sour cream
  • 1 Tbs vegetable oil
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 4 cups chopped fresh spinach
  • 1 bunch green onions, chopped
  • 1 cup mushrooms, sliced
  • 1 (8 ounce) jar oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Place chicken breasts in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour in Italian dressing, seal tightly, and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
  2. Place the stale bread, Parmesan, thyme, and pepper into a food processor. Pulse until the bread is processed into crumbs. Seat aside.
  3. In a large bowl, stir together the feta and sour cream. Set aside.
  4. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
  5. Stir in the garlic.
  6. Then add the spinach, and cook until it wilts.
  7. Stir in green onions, cook 2 minutes.
  8. Remove spinach to a plate, and leave any liquid in the pan.
  9. Stir in mushrooms, and saute until soft.
  10. Remove mushrooms to plate with spinach.
  11. Allow to cool briefly, then combine spinach and mushrooms with feta and sour cream mixture.
  12. Stir the sun-dried tomatoes into the mixture, and spread onto a large cookie sheet. Place in the freezer for about 30 minutes.
  13. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
  14. Place chicken breasts on a cookie sheet, and place about 3 tablespoons of the filling mixture in the center of each breast.
  15. Roll the breasts, and secure with a toothpick.
  16. Transfer chicken breasts to a baking dish, and sprinkle breadcrumb mixture over chicken breasts.
  17. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated oven for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken-Fried Tofu
recipes.description: Chicken-Fried Tofu combines cayenne and sage and is baked for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 block of extra/super firm tofu
- ¼ cup plain bread crumbs
- ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs
- 1 tsp salt
- ½ tsp paprika
- ½ tsp parsley
- ½ tsp garlic powder
- ¼ tsp sage
- ⅛ tsp onion powder
- ⅛ tsp cayenne pepper \[optional\]
- a pinch of white pepper
- a few cranks freshly ground black pepper, to taste
- 1 egg, lightly beaten
- ½ cup milk
- 2-3 Tbs all-purpose flour
- cooking oil spray/mister \[olive or coconut oil\]
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 block of extra/super firm tofu
  • ¼ cup plain bread crumbs
  • ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ½ tsp paprika
  • ½ tsp parsley
  • ½ tsp garlic powder
  • ¼ tsp sage
  • ⅛ tsp onion powder
  • ⅛ tsp cayenne pepper [optional]
  • a pinch of white pepper
  • a few cranks freshly ground black pepper, to taste
  • 1 egg, lightly beaten
  • ½ cup milk
  • 2-3 Tbs all-purpose flour
  • cooking oil spray/mister [olive or coconut oil]
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
  2. First drain the water from your package of tofu, gently squeezing/blotting out any excess liquid with a few paper towels.
  3. Turn the block on it's side and cut into two symmetrical sheets.
  4. Cut each sheet in half vertically, then horizontally, then again at each diagonal until you have a total of 16 tofu triangles.
  5. You can also cut the tofu into 8 larger squares for nuggets that have more tofu and less breading!
  6. Set aside.
  7. In a medium sized bowl, mix together both breadcrumbs along with your seasonings.
  8. Next grab a small bowl and mix together your egg and milk.
  9. Fill a third small bowl with the flour and get ready to dip!
  10. Dip each tofu triangle in the flour mixture, then the egg bowl, and finally plop it straight into the breadcrumb bowl and cover with breading.
  11. I don't do anything daintily so I literally smash the breadcrumbs into the tofu wedge to pack in as much coating as I can.
  12. Spray all sides with cooking spray [top, bottom, and sides] and place on an oil-rubbed baking sheet.
  13. Bake at 400F for 35 minutes, flipping them after the 20 minute mark.

recipes.title: Christmas Goose
recipes.description: Christmas Goose combines bacon, sage, and thyme and is pan-fried for a savory finish.

- 1 goose (12 - 14 lbs)
- salt and pepper
- 2 oranges, rind
- 6 slices bacon, chopped
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cups sliced celery with leaves
- 1/2 cup chopped parsley
- 1 can whole chestnuts, drained and coarsely broken (17 oz)
- 4 cups cooked wild rice (2 cups rice + 3 cups water = 6 cups cooked rice)
- 1 tsp crumbled dried sage
- 1 tsp crumbled dried thyme
- 1 tsp crumbled dried marjoram
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 goose (12 - 14 lbs)
  • salt and pepper
  • 2 oranges, rind
  • 6 slices bacon, chopped
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 2 cups sliced celery with leaves
  • 1/2 cup chopped parsley

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Remove giblets and loose fat from goose. Sprinkle goose inside and out with salt and pepper. Rub with orange rind.
  2. Fry bacon in a skillet until crisp. Add onion, celery and parsley, and sautee for 5 minutes. Stir in chestnuts, rice and herbs. Season to taste with salt.

  4. Do not stuff goose until it is ready to be roasted.

  6. Place goose breast side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.
  7. Roast in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes per pound.
  8. Place goose on serving platter. Garnish with pine sprigs and sliced blood oranges.
recipes.notesHtml:
Goose for Christmas Serves 6

for Dayemi meal I multiplied everything by 10 to serve 60.

recipes.title: Crispy Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy Fried Chicken combines buttermilk and bay leaf and is pan-fried for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp golden fried chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 1/4 cups kosher salt or 1/2 cup plus 2 Tbs table salt
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 2 Tbs paprika
- 3 medium heads garlic, cloves separated
- 3 bay leaves, crumbled
- 2 quarts buttermilk (low fat)
- 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 pounds), giblets discarded, cut into 12 pieces (see illustrations below)
- 4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 3'4 cups refined peanut oil or vegetable shortening
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 1/4 cups kosher salt or 1/2 cup plus 2 Tbs table salt
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 2 Tbs paprika
  • 3 medium heads garlic, cloves separated
  • 3 bay leaves, crumbled
  • 2 quarts buttermilk (low fat)
  • 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 pounds), giblets discarded, cut into 12 pieces (see illustrations below)
  • 4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 3'4 cups refined peanut oil or vegetable shortening
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In large zipper-lock plastic bag, combine salt, sugar, paprika, garlic cloves, and bay leaves.
  2. With rubber mallet or flat meat pounder, smash garlic into salt and spice mixture thoroughly.
  3. Pour mixture into large plastic container or nonreactive stockpot.
  4. Add 7 cups buttermilk and stir until salt is completely dissolved.
  5. Immerse chicken and refrigerate until fully seasoned, 2 to 3 hours.
  6. Remove chicken from buttermilk brine and shake off excess; place in single layer on large wire rack set over rimmed baking sheet.
  7. Refrigerate uncovered for 2 hours. (After 2 hours, chicken can be covered with plastic wrap and refrigerated up to 6 hours longer.)
  8. Measure flour into large shallow dish.
  9. Beat egg, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl; stir in remaining 1 cup buttermilk (mixture will bubble and foam).
  10. Working in batches of 3, drop chicken pieces in flour and shake pan to coat.
  11. Shake excess flour from each piece, then, using tongs, dip chicken pieces into egg mixture, turning to coat well and allowing excess to drip off.
  12. Coat chicken pieces with flour again, shake off excess, and return to wire rack.
  13. Adjust oven rack to middle position, set second wire rack over second rimmed baking sheet, and place on oven rack; heat oven to 200 degrees.
  14. Line large plate with double layer paper towels.
  15. Meanwhile, heat oil (oil should have 2 1/2-inch depth in pan) to 375 degrees over medium-high heat in large 8-quart cast-iron Dutch oven with a diameter of about 12 inches.
  16. Place half of chicken pieces skin-side down in oil, cover, reduce heat to medium, and fry until deep golden brown, 6 to 8 minutes; after about 3 minutes, lift chicken pieces with tongs to check for even browning; rearrange if some pieces are browning faster than others. (Spot-check oil temperature; after first 6 minutes of frying, oil should be about 325 degrees.
  17. Adjust burner if necessary.) Turn chicken pieces over and continue to fry, uncovered, until chicken pieces are deep golden brown on second side, 6 to 8 minutes longer.
  18. Using tongs, transfer chicken to paper towel'lined plate; let stand 2 minutes to drain, then transfer to rack in warm oven.
  19. Replace paper towel'lining on plate.
  20. Return oil to 375 degrees and fry remaining pieces, transferring pieces to paper towel'lined plate to drain, then transferring to wire rack with other chicken pieces.
  21. Cool chicken pieces on wire rack about 5 minutes and serve.
recipes.notesHtml:
Crispy Fried Chicken

Maintaining an even oil temperature is key to the success of this recipe. An instant-read thermometer with a high upper range is perfect for checking the temperature; a clip-on candy/deep-fry thermometer is fine, though it can be clipped to the pot only for the uncovered portion of frying.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Toss shredded cabbage and lime juice together in a small bowl and set aside. The juice will help “cook” the cabbage for flavor and digestion.
  2. Mix together 1 cup flour, 1/4 cup cornstarch, baking powder, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and cayenne in a bowl.
  3. Stir in enough bubble water to make a batter about the consistency of thin pancake batter.
  4. You don't want it too thick, just thick enough to nicely coat a spoon.
  5. In another bowl, mix together remaining 1/4 cup flour and 1/4 cup cornstarch.
  6. Heat oil in a deep pan to 375°F Use a candy thermometer if you need to. Oil in pan should be about 3" to 4" deep.
  7. Cut fish into portion sizes, pat dry and season with salt and pepper.
  8. Dredge the fish in the dry flour/cornstarch mixture.
  9. Shake off any excess.
  10. This allows the batter to stick to the fish.
  11. Dip dredged fish into batter allowing any excess to drip off before carefully adding the fish to the hot oil.
  12. Place fish in a single layer--do not let pieces touch each other.
  13. Cook fish until batter is crispy and golden brown.
  14. Drain on paper towels or better yet, on a cake cooling rack set up over paper towels.
  15. Do not put into an oven to keep them warm.
  16. Put them in a 350 degree oven for 10-15 minutes to reheat.
  17. Heat corn tortillas lightly in a skillet or Mexican comal until they are soft and hot.
  18. To assemble, on each tortilla layer the fish fillet, white sauce, salsa and cabbage. Fold tortilla over to serve and eat.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
  2. Add the chopped onion, celery, and carrots, stir and cook until onions have softened.
  3. Add mushrooms and garlic and continue to cook until the mushrooms have released their liquid, 2 or 3 minutes.
  4. Add wine and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated.
  5. Stir in chopped tomatoes(include liquid), sun-dried tomatoes, and thyme.
  6. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and simmer until thick.
  7. Season with salt and pepper.
  8. To make the white sauce, heat remaining oil in a heavy pan over low heat.
  9. Add flour, whisk constantly until the flour begins to turn a light brown.
  10. Remove pan from heat and whisk in cream.
  11. Season with nutmeg and a pinch of salt.
  12. Remove from heat and set aside.
  13. To assemble, spread 1/2 cup of the mushroom sauce in the bottom of a casserole dish, add one layer of noodles, then another 1/2 cup of mushroom sauce.
  14. Arrange a single layer of the fresh spinach leaves over the sauce and drizzle them with 1/3 cup of the white sauce.
  15. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of the grated Parmesan cheese over the spinach and top with another layer of the noodles.
  16. Repeat 5 times.
  17. In a preheated 375 degree F (190 degrees C) oven bake for 40 minutes. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm.

Fresh Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomato Lasagna

This lasagna uses fresh spinach, plum tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes and a white sauce. Try it when you want a truly unique lasagna. Sourdough or French bread would be a great accompaniment. Recipe makes 8 servings.

  • 1/3 cup fresh oregano, copped

  • 1/3 cup fresh basil, chopped

  • 2 garlic cloves, chopped

  • 1 anchovy fillet

  • 1 Tbs chopped drained capers

  • 1 tsp kosher salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.
  2. On a cutting board, combine the garlic and basil.
  3. Use a knife to roughly chop/combine the garlic and basil together.
  4. Add to a bowl with the butter and parmesan.
  5. Stir in a pinch of salt.
  6. Place the chicken thighs on a roasting pan.
  7. Run your fingers under the skin of each chicken thigh to create a pocket.
  8. Stuff each pocket with about a tablespoon of the butter mixture, gently spreading it underneath the skin and on top of the chicken thigh.
  9. In a small bowl, combine the olive oil, lemon zest, thyme, parsley, oregano, crushed red pepper, and a pinch of salt.
  10. Brush the mixture over the skin of the chicken, reserve any extra for brushing on while cooking.
  11. If desired, scatter a few garlic cloves and bay leaves in between the chicken on the roasting pan.
  12. Roast for 30-40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked throughout and the skin is golden.
  13. I brushed my chicken with the remaining olive oil/lemon sauce half way through cooking.
  14. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, toss the asparagus with the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt and pepper.
  15. Place in a small baking dish and roast for 20 minutes or until tender and lightly charred.
  16. While the chicken is cooking, prepare the salsa verde.
  17. On a baking sheet, toss the lemon slices with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil.
  18. Spread the lemon slices in an even layer and bake for 15 to 20 minutes (you can do this in the same oven with the chicken) or until charred on the bottom.
  19. Transfer to a cutting board and let cool for 5 minutes.
  20. Finely chop the lemon slices into small bite size pieces.
  21. Add to a bowl along with the parsley, oregano, basil, garlic, anchovy, capers and salt.
  22. Add the olive oil.
  23. Stir to combine, taste and adjust salt as needed.
  24. Once the chicken has finished roasting, remove from the oven and plate. Serve alongside the salsa verde. I served my chicken alongside roasted asparagus and a quick risotto.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Garnishes (at least 1 recommended):

  2. Finely sliced green onion
  3. Sesame seeds
  4. Sauce-Marinade: Mix the soy, hoisin, vinegar, chili and sesame oil.
  5. **Marinate Chicken:**Take out 2 tablespoons of Sauce-Marinade and mix with chicken. Add ginger and garlic to chicken, mix, then marinate 30 minutes.
  6. Dust chicken: Add flour/cornstarch mixture into chicken and toss to coat, ensuring pieces are separated so they get fully coated.
  7. **Shake off excess:**Tip into a colander and shake to remove excess mix (or grab handfuls, shake so it falls through your fingers).
  8. **Finish Sauce:**To the remaining Sauce-Marinade (that you made in Step 1), add sugar and corn starch. Mix, then add chicken stock and mix.
  9. Heat oil: Heat 2 cm / 4/5" oil in a deep skillet (or large pot - whatever you’re comfortable with) to 200°C/390°F. To use less, see Note 4.
  10. Fry: Cook chicken 3 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel lined plate.
  11. New / clean skillet: Discard oil, wipe skillet and return to heat. Or use another large skillet.
  12. Stir Fry Sauce: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
  13. Add garlic, ginger, chili flakes, sauté 30 seconds until garlic is light golden.
  14. Add Sauce, bring to simmer and stir occasionally until it thickens enough that you can draw a path across pan base.
  15. Toss! Add chicken, toss to coat quickly - the quicker you are, the crispier the chicken stays!
  16. Transfer to serving plate, garnish and serve immediately with your rice of choice.

  8. Refry chicken until crispy and golden brown.
  9. Drain again and keep hot in oven. [Refrying is optional]
  10. Mix seasoning sauce.
  11. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok over medium heat.
  12. Fry orange rind until golden brown.
  13. Add chili and ginger, stir-frying 20 seconds.
  14. Mix in seasoning sauce and heat to boil, stirring constantly until foam subsides and the sauce thickens slightly and turns to glaze (about 2 minutes or more).
  15. Add fried chicken and green onions, tossing to coat well.
  16. Sprinkle chopped peanuts on top.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a coffee grinder, finely grind cloves and cardamom.
  2. In a bowl, add all ingredients listed except tomatoes, water and garam masala (you will add this at the end) and mix to combine.
  3. Put the goat into a roaster and coat with oil and then rub the spice mixture over all of it.
  4. Put in oven at 400 degrees and cook for 3 hours, stirring the curry every hour or so.
  5. After 3 hours, add tomatoes, garam masala and water. Cook for another hour or until the meat is tender.
  6. You don’t need to add liquid in this recipe until the very end.
  7. The goat meat releases its own liquid!
  8. The reason you don’t want to add water in the beginning is because you want the onions to caramelize in the roaster.
  9. It’ll make for a more tasty masala.
  10. Trust the recipe as written

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat oil in pot. Add cumin, cardamom, cloves, and bay leaves.
  2. Sauté for 1 minute. Add finely chopped onion
  3. Sauté until the onion turns light brown.
  4. Add ginger garlic, chili paste and cook until the raw smell disappears.
  5. Add goat meat and cook for 10 to 15 minutes
  6. Add salt, paprika, turmeric, red chili powder and coriander powder

  3. Submerge the chicken breasts into the brining solution and let sit, at least 15 minutes but no more than 2 hours or the chicken will become mealy.

  10. Place the chicken breasts on the grill and cook, turning every so often, and closing the grill a couple times in between to continue cooking, for about 10-15 minutes, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees F.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Turkey
recipes.description: Herb-Roasted Turkey combines sage, rosemary, and lemon for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden roasted poultry ready for carving
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups table salt
- 1 turkey (12 to 14 pounds gross weight), rinsed thoroughly; giblets and neck reserved for gravy (if making), and tailpiece removed

### Herb Paste

- 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh parsley leaves (roughly chopped)
- 4 tsp minced fresh thyme leaves
- 2 tsp chopped fresh sage leaves (roughly chopped)
- 1 1/2 tsp minced fresh rosemary
- 1 medium shallot , minced (about 3 Tbs)
- 2 medium cloves garlic , minced or pressed through garlic press (about 2 tsp)
- 3/4 tsp grated lemon zest , from 1 lemon
- 3/4 tsp table salt
- 1 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 tsp Dijon mustard
- 1/4 cup olive oil
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups table salt
  • 1 turkey (12 to 14 pounds gross weight), rinsed thoroughly; giblets and neck reserved for gravy (if making), and tailpiece removed

Herb Paste

  • 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh parsley leaves (roughly chopped)
  • 4 tsp minced fresh thyme leaves
  • 2 tsp chopped fresh sage leaves (roughly chopped)
  • 1 1/2 tsp minced fresh rosemary
  • 1 medium shallot , minced (about 3 Tbs)
  • 2 medium cloves garlic , minced or pressed through garlic press (about 2 tsp)
  • 3/4 tsp grated lemon zest , from 1 lemon
  • 3/4 tsp table salt
  • 1 tsp ground black pepper
  • 1 tsp Dijon mustard
  • 1/4 cup olive oil
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. FOR THE TURKEY AND BRINE: Dissolve salt in 2 gallons cold water in large stockpot or clean bucket. Add turkey and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours.
  2. Remove turkey from brine and rinse under cool running water. Pat dry inside and out with paper towels. Place turkey breast side up on flat wire rack set over rimmed baking sheet or roasting pan and refrigerate, uncovered, 30 minutes. Alternatively, air-dry turkey (see note above).
  3. FOR THE HERB PASTE: Process parsley, thyme, sage, rosemary, shallot, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper in food processor until consistency of coarse paste, ten 2-second pulses. Add mustard and olive oil; continue to process until mixture forms smooth paste, ten to twelve 2-second pulses; scrape sides of processor bowl with rubber spatula after 5 pulses. Transfer mixture to small bowl.
  4. TO PREPARE THE TURKEY: Adjust oven rack to lowest position; heat oven to 400 degrees. Line large V-rack with heavy-duty foil and use paring knife or skewer to poke 20 to 30 holes in foil; set V-rack in large roasting pan. Remove turkey from refrigerator and wipe away any water collected in baking sheet; set turkey breast side up on baking sheet. Tuck wings behind back and tuck tips of drumsticks into skin at tail to secure.
  5. Using hands, carefully loosen skin from meat of breasts, thighs, and drumsticks. Using spoon, slip 1 1/2 Tbs paste under breast skin on each side of turkey. Using fingers, distribute paste under skin over breast, thigh, and drumstick meat.
  6. Using sharp paring knife, cut 1 1/2-inch vertical slit into thickest part of each breast. Starting from top of incision, swing knife tip down to create 4- to 5-inch pocket within flesh. Place 1 Tbs paste in pocket of each breast; using fingers, rub in thin, even layer.
  7. Rub 1 Tbs paste inside turkey cavity. Rotate turkey breast side down; apply half remaining herb paste to turkey skin; flip turkey breast side up and apply remaining herb paste to skin, pressing and patting to make paste adhere; reapply herb paste that falls onto baking sheet.
  8. TO ROAST THE TURKEY: Place turkey breast side down on prepared V-rack in roasting pan. Roast 45 minutes.
  9. Remove roasting pan with turkey from oven (close oven door to retain oven heat). Using clean potholders (or wad of paper towels), rotate turkey breast side up. Continue to roast until thickest part of breast registers 165 degrees and thickest part of thigh registers 170 to 175 degrees on instant-read thermometer, 50 to 60 minutes longer. (Confirm temperature by inserting thermometer in both sides of bird.) Transfer turkey to carving board; let rest 30 minutes. Carve turkey and serve.
  10. If roasting a 14- to 18-pound bird, increase all of the ingredients for the herb paste (except the black pepper) by 50 percent; follow the instructions for applying the paste under the skin, in the breast pockets, and in the cavity; use the remaining paste on the skin. Increase the second half of the roasting time (breast side up) to 1 hour, 15 minutes.
  11. If roasting an 18- to 22-pound bird, double all of the ingredients for the herb paste except the black pepper; apply 2 Tbs paste under the skin on each side of the turkey, 1 1/2 Tbs paste in each breast pocket, 2 Tbs inside the cavity, and the remaining paste on the turkey skin. Roast breast side down at 425 degrees for 1 hour, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees, rotate the turkey breast side up, and continue to roast for about 2 hours. Let rest 35 to 40 minutes before carving.
recipes.notesHtml:
Herb Roasted Turkey

Serves 10 to 12. Published November 1, 2005.

If you have the time and the refrigerator space, air-drying produces extremely crisp skin and is worth the effort. After brining, rinsing, and patting the turkey dry, place the turkey breast side up on a flat wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate, uncovered, 8 to 24 hours. Proceed with the recipe. See below for adjustments for different sized turkeys.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3 large bone-in, skinless chicken breasts (2 1/2 to 3 pounds total)
  • 1/2 cup honey
  • 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce
  • 1/4 cup blackberry jam
  • 1/4 cup hoisin sauce
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1/2 cup diced onion
  • 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional)
  • 1 Tbs cornstarch
  • Sliced scallions, for garnish
  • Sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Arrange the chicken breasts in the slow cooker so that they are not overlapping.

  2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the honey, soy sauce, blackberry jam, hoisin, olive oil, garlic, onion and crushed red pepper flakes, and then pour the sauce over the chicken. Cover the slow cooker and cook the chicken on LOW for 4 to 5 hours until the chicken is fully cooked.

  3. Using tongs, remove the chicken from the slow cooker (reserving the liquids) and place it on a cutting board. Remove the bones then use two forks to shred the chicken into smaller pieces. Place the shredded chicken in a large bowl.

  4. In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch with 3 Tbs of cold water to make a slurry.

  5. Transfer the liquids from the slow cooker into a small saucepan set over medium-high heat and whisk in the slurry. Bring the sauce to a boil and cook it until it reduces and has thickened slightly, about 3 minutes. Pour the sauce over the chicken, tossing to combine. Serve the chicken topped with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Hunan Beef with Cumin
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef is stir-fried with cumin, fresh chiles, ginger, garlic, and scallions for a fragrant Hunan-style dish.
recipes.imageAlt: Asian-style beef stir-fry with vegetables
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 Tbs Shaoxing wine or good medium-dry sherry
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 tsp light soy sauce
- 1 tsp dark soy sauce
- 1 Tbs potato starch or flour
- 12 ounces boneless short rib or other beef steak
- 1 ¾ cups peanut oil
- 2 tsp minced ginger
- 1 Tbs finely chopped garlic
- 2 fresh red chilies (tien tsin or Thai red chiles), seeded and finely chopped
- 2 to 4 tsp dried chili flakes
- 2 tsp ground cumin
- 2 scallions, green parts only, finely sliced
- 1 tsp sesame oil
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 Tbs Shaoxing wine or good medium-dry sherry
  • ½ tsp salt
  • 1 tsp light soy sauce
  • 1 tsp dark soy sauce
  • 1 Tbs potato starch or flour
  • 12 ounces boneless short rib or other beef steak

  • 2 tsp minced ginger
  • 1 Tbs finely chopped garlic

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a bowl, mix the wine, salt, soy sauces, potato starch or flour and one Tbs water. Cut the beef across the grain into thin slices and add to marinade.
  2. In a wok, heat peanut oil to about 275 degrees. Add beef and stir gently for two to three minutes, then remove from oil with a slotted spoon and drain well.
  3. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of oil in wok.
  4. Over a high flame, add the ginger, garlic, fresh chilies, chili flakes and cumin and stir-fry briefly, until they are fragrant.
  5. Return beef to the wok and stir well, seasoning with salt to taste.
  6. When beef is sizzling and fragrant,add scallion greens and toss briefly. Remove from heat and stir in sesame oil.

recipes.description: Indian Beef Keema combines garam masala, ginger, and cilantro and is pan-fried for a spicy finish.

- 2 Tbs vegetable oil
- 1 medium yellow onion, finely minced
- 2 cloves garlic, finely minced
- 1 1-inch piece ginger, peeled and finely minced
- 1 serrano chili seeded and minced
- 2 tsp garam masala
- 1 pound ground beef
- 2 medium tomatoes, diced
- 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat in a large, heavy skillet.
  2. Fry the onions, garlic, ginger and chili until translucent, about 5 minutes, then add the garam masala, stir well to coat, and continue cooking for another minute, stirring frequently.
  3. Add the beef, breaking up chunks with a wooden spoon, and cook until no longer pink on the inside.

recipes.title: Indonesian Gado Gado
recipes.description: Indonesian Gado Gado combines peanut butter, ginger, and cayenne for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful vegetable-based main dish
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
### Main Ingredients

- 3 cups brown rice
- 6 cups water
- 1 tsp turmeric, which makes the rice a beautiful yellow
- 1 bunch of fresh spinach
- 1-2 bunches of broccoli (depending on size), cut into small spears and steamed
- 2 cups fresh green beans, lightly steamed
- 1 head cabbage (mixing red and green is nice), very finely shredded, lightly steamed or raw
- 6 large carrots, sliced thin, lightly steamed or raw
- 2 cups Mung bean sprouts
- 1 lb tofu, diced, optionally fried
- 2-3 hardboiled eggs, sliced or chopped

### Peanut Sauce (makes approx 3 1/2 cups)

- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 2 heaping Tbs grated ginger
- 2 heaping Tbs minced garlic
- 1/3 cup brown sugar
- 1 1/2 cups hot water
- 1/2 cup cider vinegar
- 1/2 cup soy sauce
- salt, to taste
- crushed red or cayenne pepper, to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
Main Ingredients

  • 3 cups brown rice
  • 6 cups water
  • 1 tsp turmeric, which makes the rice a beautiful yellow
  • 1 bunch of fresh spinach
  • 1-2 bunches of broccoli (depending on size), cut into small spears and steamed
  • 2 cups fresh green beans, lightly steamed
  • 1 head cabbage (mixing red and green is nice), very finely shredded, lightly steamed or raw
  • 6 large carrots, sliced thin, lightly steamed or raw
  • 2 cups Mung bean sprouts
  • 1 lb tofu, diced, optionally fried
  • 2-3 hardboiled eggs, sliced or chopped

Peanut Sauce (makes approx 3 1/2 cups)

  • 1 cup creamy peanut butter
  • 2 heaping Tbs grated ginger
  • 2 heaping Tbs minced garlic
  • 1/3 cup brown sugar
  • 1 1/2 cups hot water
  • 1/2 cup cider vinegar
  • 1/2 cup soy sauce
  • salt, to taste
  • crushed red or cayenne pepper, to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. An Indonesian extravaganza: yellow rice on a bed of spinach, covered with vegetables, tofu, and hardboiled eggs.
  2. A gingery peanut sauce gets drizzled over the top and crunchy, flavorful toppings add a delightful finishing touch.
  3. Some things to remember.
  4. First, you can easily modify the vegetables (type, quantity, cooked or raw) to your taste.
  5. Second, the peanut sauce is an exercise in taste, adjust, taste, adjust, until you're happy.
  6. This requires patience but it's well worth it!
  7. To arrange the ingredients, place a bed of spinach on the bottom of a large platter.
  8. Make a bed of rice on top of the spinach leaving the beautiful green showing around the edges.
  9. Add vegetables on top of the rice with the sprouts, tofu and eggs going last.
  10. Put everything in a blender and puree until smooth.
  11. The hot water will melt the peanut butter to make it smooth.
  12. If it's too thick, add a little extra water.
  13. Adjust seasonings to taste.
  14. Soy sauce, vinegar, salt and sugar may all need to be adjusted depending on what you like.
  15. No one has ever complained about too much sauce so always make more than you think you need.
  16. Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle over the vegetables.
  17. Toppings:
  18. Tbs. oil
  19. Tbs. sliced fresh ginger, very thin slices cup finely minced onion medium cloves garlic, thinly sliced
  20. Heat 1 Tbs. of oil in a small skillet.
  21. Add ginger and saute over medium heat for a minute or so then transfer to a small bowl.
  22. Repeat with the onion and garlic, sauteing each separately in 1 Tbs. oil for 8 to 10 minutes (onion) and about 20 seconds (garlic).
  23. Place each in a small bowl or mix together if you think everyone will want them all.
  24. Place the toppings on the table so each person can add what they wish.

recipes.title: Kerala-Style Biryani
recipes.description: Indian-inspired Kerala-Style Biryani combines coriander, chile powder, and ginger for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A fragrant rice dish with vegetables and herbs
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups basmati rice
- 3 lbs chicken
- 1 tsp chili powder
- 3 tsp coriander powder
- 10 qty cinnamon
- 10 qty clove
- 8 qty elaichi
- 1 inch ginger
- 8 clove garlic
- 2 -3 stems mint leaves
- 2 -3 stems cilantro (Coriander Leaves)
- 20 qty cashews
- 15 qty raisins
- water

### ghee/oil/butter ' See recipe for quantity

- 3 tsp curd
- 1 tsp lemon juice
- 1 tsp rose essence
- 1 pinch tumeric
- 3 qty tomatoes
- 3 qty onions(Big)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:

ghee/oil/butter ' See recipe for quantity

  • 3 tsp curd
  • 1 tsp lemon juice
  • 1 tsp rose essence
  • 1 pinch tumeric
  • 3 qty tomatoes
  • 3 qty onions(Big)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Basmati Rice :- 2cups, Soak Rice in water and keep for an hour.
  2. Chicken:- 3 pounds, Cut it into big pieces. I make 2 inches piece. Chicken leg etc doesn't need to be cut. Just make some slits on the piece, so that masala will go in.
  3. For frying Chicken:- Chilli powder ' ' tsp, Coriander Powder-1 ' tsp, Turmeric powder-little, black pepper ' little, Garlic-Ginger paste '1/2 tsp, masalapowder- little for taste (I make masalapwdr at home ' with Cinnamon, elaichi, Clove). Mix all this with few (5-6) drops of lemon juice, and chicken and keep for (approximately) an hour. Fry this in oil. Don't Fry the chicken pieces for long time. Otherwise it will become very dry and hard. Purpose of doing this is to make the pieces, little stronger, so that it will not become small pieces, while making curry. Also, chicken will get some more cooking time while making curry for Biriyani.
  4. For making Rice:- Drain water from rice and keep it aside. Warm a thick bottom Vessel (vessel to prepare rice), and when all the water is gone, put 2-3 tsp of ghee. When it is hot, put pieces of cinnamon, clove and elaichi (3-4 pieces of each). After a little while, put the drained rice into it, and fry for some time. I do it for about 10 minutes. Then pour water to it. For 1cup, I use 1 3/4 cup of water. Add little yellow color to it. Add Salt to taste. Put on high heat, and cover with a lid. After a while when water is not visible on top of the rice, bottom rice can get burnt. So, then open the lid, and mix the rice. After water is not seen, don't keep it on stove for long time. If you think, the rice is cooked, just switch off the stove, and keep it closed for a while (about 30mts). It is ok to switch off the stove even before the rice is completely cooked. Because it will get some cook time while baking.
  5. For making Biriyani Gravy:- Heat a vessel, and add, some oil(Ghee is best, or you can mix ghee and oil too. I use oil for health reasons) . When it is hot add ' tsp of Ginger Garlic paste, and 2-3 cut green chillies. Sautee it for sometime, and then add cut onions (3 big onions) to it. Sautee it, and when it is nicely done, add ' tsp, Coriander Powder-1 ' tsp, Turmeric powder-little, black pepper ' little, masalapowder- little for taste. Add Salt to taste. Sautee that again. After a while, add 3 tsp of curd to it. Mix it well. Then add Fried chicken pieces to it. Cover and cook for sometime (10 mts) . Cut 3 tomatoes (big pieces) and add to this. Cover and cook. Stir in between. When the gravy will be like a paste. It should not be dry. But it should not be watery. Check Salt and add more, if needed.
  6. Fry Raisins, Cashews, Cilantro, Mint leaves etc in Ghee and keep aside. Best is to fry this separate. But For easiness I do all in one pan. First Raisin, when it is big balls, add cashew to it.. when cashew is brown, take both out. Then add Leaves to it and fry. If Mint leaves are not there, you can just use Cilantro (I do that most of the time). If you want to reduce amount of ghee used, Don't do this step. It is optional. Add Cashew, Raisin, and leaves for baking as given on the next step, without frying in Ghee.
  7. Baking Biriyani:-
  8. Serving:- Take portions from the baked Biriyani, so that a serving plate will have both rice, and chicken with masala. This goes well with Lime Pickle and raita. I make raita with Onions, Tomato, Green Chilli(optional), Curd and salt.

recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 whole chicken
- Onion and celery, for cooking the chicken (optional)
- 1 large yellow onion, chopped
- 1 medium Anaheim pepper, finely chopped
- Oil, for sautéing
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1/2 cup water
- 1 can cream of mushroom soup
- 1 can diced Rotel tomatoes and green chiles
- Picante sauce, to taste (optional)
- 8 oz or more cheddar cheese, grated
- About 25 corn tortillas
- Nonstick cooking spray
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 whole chicken
  • Onion and celery, for cooking the chicken (optional)
  • 1 large yellow onion, chopped
  • 1 medium Anaheim pepper, finely chopped
  • Oil, for sautéing
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • 1/2 cup water
  • 1 can cream of mushroom soup
  • 1 can diced Rotel tomatoes and green chiles
  • Picante sauce, to taste (optional)
  • 8 oz or more cheddar cheese, grated
  • About 25 corn tortillas

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cook the chicken, optionally with onion and celery. Reserve the broth. When cool enough to handle, remove the bones and chop the meat.
  2. Sauté the chopped onion and Anaheim pepper in a little oil until the onion is translucent.
  3. Add the chicken, taco seasoning, and water. Mix gently and cook until the water is absorbed.
  4. In a large bowl, combine the cream of mushroom soup and Rotel. Add picante sauce if desired.
  5. Heat the oven to 350°F and coat a 9-by-13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Spread a little sauce over the bottom.
  6. Soften the tortillas in the reserved chicken broth, then tear them roughly into quarters.
  7. Layer one-quarter of the cheese, one-third of the chicken mixture, one-third of the sauce, and one-third of the tortillas. Repeat twice, then finish with the remaining cheese.
  8. Bake for 30 to 60 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned. Let rest for 10 to 20 minutes before serving.

### In a bowl, combine and mix

- 2 Tbs. rice wine
- 3 Tbs. rice wine vinegar
- 2 Tbs hoisin sauce

- 1 Tbs. dry sherry
- 2 tsp. sugar

- Other

recipes.title: Lemon Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Lemon Butter Chicken combines smoked paprika, Parmesan, and spinach and is roasted for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
- 1 Tbs smoked paprika
- Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
- 3 Tbs unsalted butter, divided
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup chicken broth
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan
- Juice of 1 lemon
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 2 cups baby spinach, chopped
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
  • 1 Tbs smoked paprika
  • Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
  • 3 Tbs unsalted butter, divided
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 cup chicken broth
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan
  • Juice of 1 lemon
  • 1 tsp dried thyme
  • 2 cups baby spinach, chopped
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
  2. Season chicken thighs with paprika, salt and pepper, to taste.
  3. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large oven-proof skillet over medium high heat.
  4. Add chicken, skin-side down, and sear both sides until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side; drain excess fat and set aside.
  5. Melt remaining tablespoon butter in the skillet.
  6. Add garlic, and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
  7. Stir in chicken broth, heavy cream, Parmesan, lemon juice and thyme.
  8. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, stir in spinach, and simmer until the spinach has wilted and the sauce has slightly thickened, about 3-5 minutes. Return chicken to the skillet.
  9. Place into oven and roast until completely cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165 degrees F, about 25-30 minutes.
  10. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Lemon Chicken combines rosemary, thyme, and lemon and is baked for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 3-4 pounds chicken thighs and legs, skin-on, bone-in
- 2 Tbs lemon zest
- 1/3 cup lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, crushed
- 2 Tbs fresh chopped thyme (or 2 tsp dried)
- 1 Tbs fresh chopped rosemary (or 1 tsp dried)
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 2-3 Tbs melted butter
- Lemon slices for garnish
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3-4 pounds chicken thighs and legs, skin-on, bone-in
  • 2 Tbs lemon zest
  • 1/3 cup lemon juice
  • 2 cloves garlic, crushed
  • 2 Tbs fresh chopped thyme (or 2 tsp dried)
  • 1 Tbs fresh chopped rosemary (or 1 tsp dried)
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp black pepper
  • 2-3 Tbs melted butter
  • Lemon slices for garnish
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Combine lemon juice, peel, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
  2. With the tip of a sharp knife, cut into each chicken piece one or two times by about 1/2 an inch. (This will help the marinade penetrate.) Turn the chicken pieces over in the marinade and let marinate for 2 hours.
  3. Preheat oven to 425F. Place marinated chicken in a single layer in a baking pan, skin side up. Reserve marinade. Brush melted butter on each piece of chicken.
  4. Bake 50 to 55 minutes, until skins are crispy brown, and chicken is cooked through, juices running clear (thighs 175F).
  5. Half-way through baking, baste chicken generously with reserved marinade.
  6. Let rest, covered in foil, for 10 minutes before serving.
  7. Serves 4-6.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Measure 2 Tbs. of oil from tomatoes; set tomatoes aside.

recipes.title: Louisiana Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Louisiana fried chicken is pan-fried for a savory, deeply seasoned result.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp golden fried chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 (3 pound) whole chicken, cut into 6 pieces
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 1 (12 fluid ounce) can evaporated milk
- 2 tsp salt
- 2 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 2 tsp onion powder
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil for frying
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 (3 pound) whole chicken, cut into 6 pieces
  • 2 eggs, beaten
  • 1 (12 fluid ounce) can evaporated milk
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 2 tsp ground black pepper
  • 2 tsp garlic powder
  • 2 tsp onion powder
  • 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil for frying
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a medium size bowl mix together the eggs and milk.
  2. Add ALMOST all of the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder (reserve a dash of each for seasoning the chicken pieces).
  3. Set aside.
  4. Sprinkle a dash of the remaining salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder onto both sides of the chicken pieces.
  5. In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat.
  6. Put the flour in a plastic bag.
  7. One piece at a time, dip the chicken into the egg/milk mixture then add to the plastic bag.
  8. Shake the bag so that the flour is covering each piece of chicken.
  9. You can check to see if the oil is hot enough by sprinkling a little flour in the skillet.
  10. If it fries, it's hot enough!
  11. Place the chicken pieces in the skillet.
  12. After about 5 minutes, turn the chicken over.
  13. Let chicken fry for about 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the juices run clear.
  14. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Mediterranean-Style Chicken
recipes.description: Mediterranean-Style Chicken combines white wine, basil, and thyme and is simmered for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 tsp olive oil
- 2 Tbs white wine
- 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts cubed
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 onion, diced
- 1 28oz can of diced tomatoes
- 1/2 cup white wine
- 2 tsp chopped fresh thyme
- 1 Tbs chopped fresh basil
- 1/2 cup kalamata olives
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
- salt and pepper to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 tsp olive oil
  • 2 Tbs white wine
  • 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts cubed

  • 2 tsp chopped fresh thyme
  • 1 Tbs chopped fresh basil
  • 1/2 cup kalamata olives
  • 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
  • salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat the oil and 2 tablespoons white wine in a large skillet over medium heat.
  2. Add chicken and saute about 4 to 6 minutes each side, until golden.
  3. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
  4. Saute garlic in pan drippings for 30 seconds, then add onion and saute for 3 minutes.
  5. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil.
  6. Lower heat, add 1/2 cup white wine and simmer for 10 minutes.
  7. Add thyme and basil and simmer for 5 more minutes.
  8. Return chicken to skillet and cover.
  9. Cook over low heat until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside.
  10. Add olives and parsley to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
  11. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.

- 1 Tbs ground cumin
- 1 Tbs ground coriander

- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 beef roast (chuck, arm) about 3lbs

  • 1 Tbs ground coriander
  • 1 Tbs chili powder
  • 1 Tbs salt

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cut roast in half horizontally.
  2. Combine cumin, coriander, chili powder, salt and red pepper in small bowl.

- 1 Tbs sesame seeds

### FOR THE SAUCE

recipes.instructionsHtml:

recipes.title: Oven Brisket
recipes.description: Oven Brisket combines chipotle and chile powder and is roasted for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Sliced barbecue beef brisket
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 pounds beef brisket, trimmed
- 2 Tbs chili powder
- 2 Tbs salt
- 1 Tbs garlic powder
- 1 Tbs onion powder
- 1 Tbs ground black pepper
- 1 Tbs sugar
- 2 tsp dry mustard
- 1 tsp ground chipotle pepper
- 1 bay leaf, crushed
- 1 1/2 cups beef or veggie stock

- Note: Adjust dry rub amounts based on weight of brisket
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 pounds beef brisket, trimmed

  • 2 Tbs chili powder

  • 2 Tbs salt

  • 1 Tbs garlic powder

  • 1 Tbs onion powder

  • 1 Tbs ground black pepper

  • 1 Tbs sugar

  • 2 tsp dry mustard

  • 1 tsp ground chipotle pepper

  • 1 bay leaf, crushed

  • 1 1/2 cups beef or veggie stock

  • Note: Adjust dry rub amounts based on weight of brisket
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
  2. Make a dry rub by combining chili powder, salt, garlic and onion powders, black pepper, sugar, dry mustard, chipotle pepper, and bay leaf.
  3. Season the raw brisket on both sides with the rub.
  4. Place brisket on a rack in a roasting pan and roast, uncovered, for 1 hour.
  5. The roast should be raised on a rack to allow the bottom of the roast to be out of the stock, which will be added in next step.
  6. Add beef or veggie stock and enough water to yield about 1/2 inch of liquid in the roasting pan.
  7. Lower oven to 300 degrees F, cover pan tightly and continue cooking for 3 hours, or until fork-tender.

- Salt

- 3/4 cup blue cheese
- 2 cups shredded white cabbage
- 2 cups shredded red cabbage
- 1/2 cup thinly sliced red onion
- 1 Tbs finely chopped parsley leaves
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup masa flour
- Creole seasoning

recipes.description: Rice noodles, shrimp or tofu, and crisp vegetables are tossed in a sweet-sour tamarind and fish sauce glaze, then finished with peanuts and lime.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 ounces fettuccine-width rice stick noodles
- 1/4 cup peanut oil
- 1/4 cup tamarind paste
- 1/4 cup fish sauce (nam pla)
- 1/3 cup honey
- 2 Tbs rice vinegar
- 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, or to taste
- 1/4 cup chopped scallions
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- 2 eggs
- 1 small head Napa cabbage, shredded (about 4 cups)
- 1 cup mung bean sprouts
- 1/2 pound peeled shrimp, pressed tofu or a combination
- 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
- 2 limes, quartered.
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 ounces fettuccine-width rice stick noodles
  • 1/4 cup peanut oil
  • 1/4 cup tamarind paste
  • 1/4 cup fish sauce (nam pla)

  • 2 Tbs rice vinegar

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Put noodles in a large bowl and add boiling water to cover.
  2. Let sit until noodles are just tender; check every 5 minutes or so to make sure they do not get too soft.
  3. Drain, drizzle with one tablespoon peanut oil to keep from sticking and set aside.
  4. Meanwhile, put tamarind paste, fish sauce, honey and vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-low heat and bring just to a simmer.
  5. Stir in red pepper flakes and set aside.
  6. Put remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; when oil shimmers, add scallions and garlic and cook for about a minute.
  7. Add eggs to pan; once they begin to set, scramble them until just done.
  8. Add cabbage and bean sprouts and continue to cook until cabbage begins to wilt, then add shrimp or tofu (or both).
  9. When shrimp begin to turn pink and tofu begins to brown, add drained noodles to pan along with sauce.
  10. Toss everything together to coat with tamarind sauce and combine well.
  11. When noodles are warmed through, serve, sprinkling each dish with peanuts and garnishing with cilantro and lime wedges.
  12. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.description: Peruvian-Style Chicken with Green Sauce combines cumin, lime, and cilantro in a bright sauce.

- 3 Tbs extra virgin olive oil

- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 tsp sugar

- Ingredients For the Green Sauce

- 1/2 cup mayonnaise, best quality such as Hellmann's

- 1/8 tsp freshly ground black pepper

- Instructions For the Chicken
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 3 Tbs extra virgin olive oil

  • 1/4 cup lime juice, from 2 limes

  • 4 large garlic cloves, roughly chopped

  • 1 Tbs kosher salt

  • 2 tsp paprika

  • 1 tsp black pepper

  • 1 Tbs cumin

  • 1 tsp dried oregano

  • 2 tsp sugar

  • 4 pound whole chicken

  • Ingredients For the Green Sauce

  • 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves

  • 2 cloves garlic, roughly chopped

  • 1/2 cup mayonnaise, best quality such as Hellmann's

  • 1/4 cup sour cream

  • 1 Tbs fresh lime juice, from one lime

  • 1/2 tsp salt

  • 1/8 tsp freshly ground black pepper

  • 2 Tbs extra virgin olive oil

  • Instructions For the Chicken
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. 3 jalapeño chili peppers, seeded if desired (I use about half the seeds for a medium-hot sauce), and roughly chopped
  2. Combine all of the ingredients except the chicken in a blender or mini food processor, and blend until smooth.
  3. Remove the giblets from the inside of the chicken and pat the outside of the chicken dry with paper towels; place in a bowl, breast side up with the legs facing you.
  4. Using the handle of a wooden spoon or your fingers, loosen the skin from the flesh over the breasts and legs, being careful not to tear the skin or push all the way through (you want the marinade to stay inside the bird).
  5. Spoon about 2/3 of the marinade evenly underneath the skin, and spread the remaining 1/3 evenly over the skin.
  6. Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours or overnight.
  7. Adjust the oven rack to the lower-middle position, and preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
  8. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil for easy clean-up.
  9. Spray a rack (preferably a v-shape) with non-stick cooking spray and place the chicken on top.
  10. Tie the legs together with kitchen string.
  11. Roast for 20 minutes, until the skin is golden.
  12. Turn the heat down to 375 degrees, and continue to roast for about an hour and ten minutes more, or until the juices run clear when you cut between the leg and thigh. (Keep an eye on it -- if it's browning too quickly, cover it loosely with foil.) Tent the chicken with foil and let rest for about 20 minutes.
  13. Tilt the chicken over the roasting pan to release the juices, then transfer to a cutting board.
  14. Carve the chicken and serve with green sauce.
  15. Instructions For the Green Sauce
  16. Combine all of the ingredients except the olive oil in a blender or food processor and blend into a smooth sauce.
  17. With the motor running, open lid and slowly drizzle in olive oil.
  18. It will seem very runny at this point but, don't worry, it will thicken up as it sits.
  19. Transfer the sauce to a bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

* 8 - 10 chicken thighs and legs
* Adobo all-purpose seasoning powder (salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin)
