* pepper
* fresh rosemary
* fresh oregano
* 1 onion, pureed
* 4 - 5 cloves of garlic, pureed
* 2 Tbs. vinegar

- Smell the chicken mixture and if it doesn't smell spicy enough, add more Adobo seasoning!
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 8 - 10 chicken thighs and legs
  • Adobo all-purpose seasoning powder (salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin)
  • 3 lemons
  • 2 - 3 Tbs. soy sauce
  • pepper
  • fresh rosemary
  • fresh oregano
  • 1 onion, pureed
  • 4 - 5 cloves of garlic, pureed
  • 2 Tbs. vinegar
  • Smell the chicken mixture and if it doesn't smell spicy enough, add more Adobo seasoning!
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Wash the chicken and remove excess (not all) fat/skin and score the meat with deep cuts.
  2. Shake liberal amounts of Adobo seasoning over the chicken making sure each piece is well-covered.
  3. Add pureed onion, pureed garlic, juice of 1 lemon, vinegar, rosemary, oregano, and lots of pepper to the chicken and mix well.
  4. Add enough soy sauce to give it a slightly brownish hue and mix well.

  7. Heat oil for 5 minutes on medium high to high to get it going.
  8. Cook chicken approximately 15 minutes uncovered, making sure it doesn't stick.
  9. Cover and cook another 5 minutes before turning.
  10. Each side should be a dark brown/blackish color (don't burn it!).
  11. Flip chicken and cook another 15 - 20 minutes.
  12. Squeeze 1 lemon over the chicken after 10 minutes on second side.
  13. Remove from skillet and let it drain and cool for 5 minutes before serving. Squeeze last lemon over chicken, serve and eat!

recipes.title: Roast Goose with Wild Rice Stuffing
recipes.description: Roast Goose with Wild Rice Stuffing combines orange zest, bacon, and sage and is pan-fried for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden roasted poultry ready for carving
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 cup wild rice, raw
- 10 lbs goose
- salt and pepper
- 4 Tbs orange zest, grated
- 6 slices bacon, chopped
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 cup celery, sliced (with leaves)
- 1/2 cup Italian parsley, chopped
- 1 (17 ounce) can whole chestnuts, drained and coarsely chopped
- 3 Tbs fresh sage leaves, chopped (or 1 tsp dried sage)
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 tsp dried marjoram
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 cup wild rice, raw
  • 10 lbs goose
  • salt and pepper
  • 4 Tbs orange zest, grated
  • 6 slices bacon, chopped
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 1 cup celery, sliced (with leaves)
  • 1/2 cup Italian parsley, chopped
  • 1 (17 ounce) can whole chestnuts, drained and coarsely chopped
  • 3 Tbs fresh sage leaves, chopped (or 1 tsp dried sage)
  • 1 tsp dried thyme
  • 1 tsp dried marjoram
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cooked wild rice according to package instructions (you should have about 4 cups cooked). Set aside to cool.
  2. Preheat oven to 350'F.
  3. Remove giblets from goose. Remove loose fat from around cavity openings. Discard or reserve for another use.
  4. Prick skin and fat with a skewer in several places, being careful not to pierce meat.
  5. Sprinkle goose inside and out with salt and pepper. Rub with orange zest.
  6. Fry bacon in a skillet until crisp. Add onion, celery and parsley and saut' 5 minutes.
  7. Stir in chestnuts, cooked rice and herbs. Season to taste with salt.
  8. Stuff goose with this mixture. "Sew" cavity shut with skewers and cotton twine. (do not stuff goose until ready to roast).
  9. Place goose breast side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Roast about 20 minutes per pound. (if skin begins to brown too much, cover loosely with foil.).
  10. Remove to cutting board and let rest 15 minutes.
  11. Remove stuffing to a bowl and carve goose. tablespoons of fat from the roasted goose tablespoons flour cups boiled stock or chicken stock (or both)
  12. 1/4 cup dry white wine dash salt dash pepper dash garlic hint of sage and thyme
  13. Heat the goose fat in a saucepan large enough to hold all four cups of stock.
  14. Now add the flour to the goose fat stirring quickly until all of the flour is dampened (this will prevent lumps from forming).
  15. Be sure not to scorch this mixture.
  16. Now add the stock and the wine, bring gravy to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.
  17. Add spices and stir constantly until the gravy thickens.

recipes.title: Salmon Wasabi-Crusted with Orange-Ginger Sauce
recipes.description: Salmon Wasabi-Crusted with Orange-Ginger Sauce combines wasabi, ginger, and soy sauce in a bright sauce.
recipes.imageAlt: A cooked salmon fillet ready to serve
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 Tbs wasabi powder
- 1 Tbs water
- 1 Tbs rice wine vinegar
- 1/4 tsp soy sauce
- 4 (6-ounce) salmon fillet pieces, skin removed
- 1 tsp Emeril's Original Essence, recipe follows
- 1 cup panko crumbs
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- Orange-Ginger Sauce, recipe follows
- 1/4 cup toasted black and white sesame seeds, garnish
- Steamed long-grain white rice, accompaniment
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 Tbs wasabi powder
  • 1 Tbs water
  • 1 Tbs rice wine vinegar
  • 1/4 tsp soy sauce
  • 4 (6-ounce) salmon fillet pieces, skin removed
  • 1 tsp Emeril's Original Essence, recipe follows
  • 1 cup panko crumbs
  • 1/4 cup vegetable oil
  • Orange-Ginger Sauce, recipe follows
  • 1/4 cup toasted black and white sesame seeds, garnish
  • Steamed long-grain white rice, accompaniment
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Place the wasabi in a small bowl.
  2. Slowly add in the water, whisking, to make a paste.
  3. Add the vinegar and soy, and whisk well.
  4. Place the salmon fillets in a glass baking dish and coat evenly on both sides with the wasabi mixture.
  5. Season lightly with the Essence.
  6. Place the panko crumbs in a shallow dish.
  7. Turn both sides of the fillets in the crumbs to coat evenly, pressing to make the crumbs adhere.
  8. Set on a waxed paper lined baking sheet and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
  9. In a large skillet or saut' pan, heat the oil over medium-high heat.
  10. Add the fish and cook until medium-rare, about 3 to 4 minutes per side, depending upon the thickness of the fish.
  11. Divide among 4 serving plates, drizzle with the Orange-Ginger Sauce, and dust with the seeds.
  12. Serve immediately with steamed rice, and pass the remaining sauce at the table.
  13. Essence (Emeril's Creole Seasoning): tablespoons salt tablespoons garlic powder tablespoon black pepper tablespoon onion powder tablespoon cayenne pepper tablespoon dried leaf oregano tablespoon dried thyme
  14. Combine all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight jar or container.
  15. Yield: about 2/3 cup
  16. Recipe from New New Orleans Cooking, by Emeril Lagasse and Jessie Tirsch. Published by William and Morrow, 1993.
  17. Orange-Ginger Sauce:
  18. 1/4 cup minced shallots tablespoon minced ginger tablespoons orange zest cup dry white wine cup fresh orange juice
  19. 1/2 cup heavy cream sticks cold unsalted butter, cut into pieces teaspoon soy sauce
  20. Salt
  21. 1/8 teaspoon wasabi powder
  22. In a medium, heavy saucepan, combine the shallots, ginger, orange zest, wine, and orange juice and bring to a boil.
  23. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced in volume by 2/3.
  24. Add the cream and cook until reduced by 1/2.
  25. Whisking constantly, add the butter a bit at a time, waiting until each is completely incorporated before adding the next piece.
  26. Continue whisking until the sauce is smooth.
  27. Add the soy sauce, salt, to taste, and wasabi.
  28. Serve warm with the Wasabi-Crusted Salmon. (NOTE: If not being served immediately, place in a hot water bath, covered, and stir occasionally.)
  29. Yield: Makes about 1 cup
  30. Yield: 4 servings
  31. Prep Time: 30 minutes
  32. Cooking Time: 20 minutes

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 6 breasts, cut into strips

### or

- 8-10 thighs/drumsticks

### Batter

- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups fine cornmeal
- 2 tsp dried thyme
- 2 tsp kosher salt
- 2 tsp black pepper
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 2 tsp cayenne
- 4 cups buttermilk

### Dash of hot sauce

### Coating

- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 Tbs baking powder
- 3 Tbs black pepper
- 2 Tbs fine sea salt
- 1 Tbs garlic powder
- 1 Tbs onion powder
- 1 Tbs cayenne
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 breasts, cut into strips

or

  • 8-10 thighs/drumsticks

Batter

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 2 cups fine cornmeal
  • 2 tsp dried thyme
  • 2 tsp kosher salt
  • 2 tsp black pepper
  • 2 tsp garlic powder
  • 2 tsp cayenne
  • 4 cups buttermilk

Dash of hot sauce

Coating

  • 3 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 Tbs baking powder
  • 3 Tbs black pepper
  • 2 Tbs fine sea salt
  • 1 Tbs garlic powder
  • 1 Tbs onion powder
  • 1 Tbs cayenne
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Peanut oil, for frying
  2. Prepare the buttermilk batter by combining the flour, corn meal, salt, spices, and herbs in a large bowl.
  3. Slowly whisk in the buttermilk and the hot sauce.
  4. Place the chicken pieces into the buttermilk batter, cover, and refrigerate for ½ hour.
  5. Remove the marinating chicken from the refrigerator 30 minutes prior to frying.
  6. Combine the all-purpose flour, baking powder, and spices in a large bowl.
  7. In a cast-iron skillet, heat 3 inches of peanut oil over medium-high heat to 300 degrees.
  8. Remove the chicken from the buttermilk batter and let excess batter drip off.
  9. Place the chicken pieces into the bowl and coat them well.
  10. Do it in batches to avoid making a mess.
  11. Place the chicken into the hot oil and fry until just golden brown, about 5 minutes, then remove them from the pan and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
  12. Once all of the chicken pieces have been fried at 300 degrees for 5 minutes, heat the oil to 350 degrees, and fry the chicken until cooked through and golden brown, another 5 minutes.
  13. Remove and place on a baking sheet lined with paper towels to absorb excess grease before serving.

recipes.title: Spicy Garlic-Pepper Shrimp
recipes.description: Spicy Garlic-Pepper Shrimp combines cilantro, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes and is pan-fried for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Seasoned shrimp in a savory sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 1/2'Tbs'vegetable oil
- 1/4'cup'water
- 1'cup'shredded cabbage
- 1'Tbs'minced garlic
- 8'large'fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 2'tsp'crushed red pepper flakes
- 2'Tbs'sliced onion
- 1'Tbs'chopped fresh cilantro
- 1'Tbs'soy sauce
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 1/2'Tbs'vegetable oil
  • 1/4'cup'water
  • 1'cup'shredded cabbage
  • 1'Tbs'minced garlic
  • 8'large'fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined
  • 2'tsp'crushed red pepper flakes
  • 2'Tbs'sliced onion
  • 1'Tbs'chopped fresh cilantro
  • 1'Tbs'soy sauce
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over high heat. Add cabbage and 1 tablespoon water stir-fry for 30 seconds. Remove cabbage from skillet and place on a serving platter.
  2. Heat the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons oil in the skillet over high heat.
  3. Place the garlic and shrimp in the skillet and stir until garlic is lightly browned and shrimp turns pink.
  4. Add pepper, onion, cilantro, soy sauce and remaining water to the skillet.
  5. Stir-fry for 10 seconds.
  6. Pour the hot mixture onto the cabbage.
recipes.notesHtml:
Spicy Garlic and Pepper Shrimp

Spicy Thai style shrimp. Chicken, pork, beef, calamari, scallops, or tofu can easily be substituted for shrimp. This makes for a wonderful supper.

Prep Time: 10 Minutes Cook Time: 8 Minutes Ready In: 18 Minutes

recipes.title: Sticky Garlic Chicken Bites
recipes.description: Sticky Garlic Chicken Bites combine hoisin, ginger, and soy sauce and are baked for a sweet-savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Glazed Asian-style chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch chunks
- Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
- 2 large eggs, beaten
- 1 cup Panko crumbs

- Sauce
- 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce
- 1/4 cup honey
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 Tbs hoisin sauce
- 1 Tbs freshly grated ginger
- 1 Tbs Sriracha
- 2 green onions, thinly sliced
- 2 tsp sesame seeds
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch chunks

  • Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

  • 2 large eggs, beaten

  • 1 cup Panko crumbs

  • Sauce

  • 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce

  • 1/4 cup honey

  • 4 cloves garlic, minced

  • 2 Tbs hoisin sauce

  • 1 Tbs freshly grated ginger

  • 1 Tbs Sriracha

  • 2 green onions, thinly sliced

  • 2 tsp sesame seeds
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Lightly oil a 9x13 baking dish or coat with nonstick spray.
  2. Season chicken with salt and pepper, to taste. Working in batches, dip chicken into eggs, then dredge in Panko, pressing to coat.
  3. Add chicken to prepared baking dish. Place into oven and bake until golden brown and crisp, about 15-20 minutes.
  4. In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, combine soy sauce, honey, garlic, hoisin sauce, ginger and Sriracha until slightly thickened, about 1-2 minutes.
  5. Stir in chicken and gently toss to combine.
  6. Serve immediately, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.

recipes.description: Sticky Roasted Chicken combines cayenne and thyme and is roasted for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Tender chicken in a savory pan sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 tsp salt
- 2 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 tsp white pepper
- 1 tsp cayenne pepper
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp garlic powder

- 2 onions quartered
- 2 (4 lb each) whole chickens
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 tsp salt

  • 2 tsp paprika

  • 1 tsp onion powder

  • 1 tsp dried thyme

  • 1 tsp white pepper

  • 1 tsp cayenne pepper

  • 1 tsp black pepper

  • 1 tsp garlic powder

  • 2 onions quartered

  • 2 (4 lb each) whole chickens
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Mix spices together
  2. Remove and discard giblets from chicken. Rinse chicken cavity and pat dry with paper towel
  3. Rub each chicken inside and out with spice mixture. Place one onion inside the cavity of each chicken.
  4. Put chicken in resealable bag or double wrap with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 to 6 hours.
  5. Preheat oven to 250 degrees.
  6. Place chickens in roasting pan. Bake uncovered for 5 hours. Let the chickens stand 10 minutes before carving.
  7. Goes well with greens and smashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Beef Steak Rolls
recipes.description: Stuffed Beef Steak Rolls combine mushrooms and spinach and are baked for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A grilled beef steak sliced for serving
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 Tbs oil
- 3 Tbs chopped garlic
- 2 sweet onions, such as Vidalia, chopped
- 2 cups mushrooms, thinly sliced
- ½ Tbs kosher salt
- ½ Tbs freshly ground black pepper
- 2 pounds flank steak
- Kosher salt
- Freshly ground black pepper
- 1 (4-ounce) package baby spinach
- 9 slices provolone cheese
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs oil
  • 3 Tbs chopped garlic
  • 2 sweet onions, such as Vidalia, chopped
  • 2 cups mushrooms, thinly sliced
  • ½ Tbs kosher salt
  • ½ Tbs freshly ground black pepper
  • 2 pounds flank steak
  • Kosher salt
  • Freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 (4-ounce) package baby spinach
  • 9 slices provolone cheese
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
  2. Heat one tablespoon of the oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
  3. Combine the garlic, onions, mushrooms, salt, and pepper in the pan and cook until almost all of the moisture has evaporated and the onions are caramelizing, 15–20 minutes.
  4. Remove from heat and set aside.
  5. Lay the flank steak on a cutting board.
  6. Spoon the mushroom and onion mixture on top, spreading it evenly across the steak.
  7. Sprinkle the spinach on top, followed by the slices of provolone.
  8. Press down lightly to compress the spinach.
  9. Starting at the bottom of the flank steak, roll it up tightly, making sure the grain of the meat is running horizontally.
  10. Use six toothpicks to secure the steak roll.
  11. Slice the steak roll into six equal rolls.
  12. Heat the remaining oil in a pan over high heat.
  13. Sear the steak rolls on one side for one to two minutes, then flip.
  14. Sear the second side for about one minute, then bake for 10–15 minutes, until medium rare.
  15. Remove the toothpicks, then serve!

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken
recipes.description: Tandoori spices, ginger, green chile, and yogurt season this Indian-inspired grilled chicken.
recipes.imageAlt: Seasoned grilled chicken
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 12 Tbs tandoori spice
- 1 yellow onion, diced fine
- 1 chopped green chili pepper (jalapeno or other)
- 1 Tbs grated fresh ginger
- Fresh garlic pulp
- Chopped cilantro leaves
- 1 lemon, juiced
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 12 Tbs tandoori spice
  • 1 yellow onion, diced fine
  • 1 chopped green chili pepper (jalapeno or other)
  • 1 Tbs grated fresh ginger
  • Fresh garlic pulp
  • Chopped cilantro leaves
  • 1 lemon, juiced
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. 1 - 2 cups plain yogurt or buttermilk, just enough to make a thin paste to cover chicken
  2. Combine all ingredients except yogurt and chicken in a large bowl and mix well.
  3. Add the yogurt 1/2 cup at a time until the mixture is smooth enough to immerse the chicken in but not so lumpy it falls off the chicken.
  4. If using thicker yogurt, you may need to thin the mixture w/ water or milk.
  5. Best judgement will be fine.
  6. Rinse and dry the chicken.
  7. Remove the skin if not skinless and score 1/4 inch deep slices across breasts to maximize the effects of marinating.
  8. Add chicken to bowl and mix well to coat all surface areas of chicken.
  9. Let marinate in the refrigerator for 3 hours or longer.
  10. Overnight marinating works best.
  11. Bake the chicken in any type of dish or pan as long as it has at least 1/4 inch sides at 375 for 30 - 40 minutes.
  12. Grill the chicken on a gas or charcoal grill until lightly charred.
  13. Immediately after removing the chicken from the grill, squirt fresh lemon juice over it, serve and enjoy!
recipes.searchIngredients: - 12 Tbs tandoori spice - 1 yellow onion, diced fine - 1 chopped green chili pepper (jalapeno or other) - 1 Tbs grated fresh ginger - Fresh garlic pulp - Chopped cilantro leaves - 1 lemon, juiced

recipes.title: Thai Fried Quinoa
recipes.description: Thai Fried Quinoa combines curry paste, ginger, and soy sauce for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A fragrant rice dish with vegetables and herbs
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups uncooked quinoa
- 3 organic peppers, different colors
- 12 oz fresh green beans
- 16 oz extra firm tofu, cubed
- 1-2 Tbs fresh ginger, chopped
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- Sesame seeds, optional
- 1/2 cup reduced soy sauce
- 2 Tbs red curry paste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups uncooked quinoa
  • 3 organic peppers, different colors
  • 12 oz fresh green beans
  • 16 oz extra firm tofu, cubed
  • 1-2 Tbs fresh ginger, chopped
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • Sesame seeds, optional
  • 1/2 cup reduced soy sauce
  • 2 Tbs red curry paste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Cook quinoa according to package instructions
  2. In a large skillet, over medium to high heat, add all the ingredients except the cooked quinoa and sauce ingredients.
  3. Cook tofu/veggie mixture for 5-8 minutes until tender stirring occasionally. On the meantime, in a small bowl mix the sauce ingredients. Set aside.
  4. When the tofu/veggie mixture is almost tender add the quinoa and sauce mixture to the skillet. Mix through and cook further for another minute or so stirring constantly.
  5. Turn heat off and serve immediately. You may sprinkle some pepper flakes and sesame seeds if desired before serving.
recipes.notesHtml: If you feel you don't have enough sauce you can increase the amount. I do that sometimes but when my kids are eating it I don't since it may be too spicy for them.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 2 cups uncooked quinoa - 3 organic peppers, different colors - 12 oz fresh green beans - 16 oz extra firm tofu, cubed - 1-2 Tbs fresh ginger, chopped - 2 Tbs olive oil - Sesame seeds, optional - 1/2 cup reduced soy sauce - 2 Tbs red curry paste

recipes.title: Thai Salmon Salad
recipes.description: Thai Salmon Salad pairs fish sauce, lime, and basil in a spicy salad.
recipes.imageAlt: A cooked salmon fillet ready to serve
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 Tbs fish sauce
- 4 Tbs lime juice
- 2 tsp brown sugar
- 4 Thai chiles, chopped
- 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillet
- 1 tsp olive oil
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 1 large tomato, chopped
- 1 cup chopped fresh basil
- 1 head lettuce
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 Tbs fish sauce
  • 4 Tbs lime juice
  • 2 tsp brown sugar
  • 4 Thai chiles, chopped
  • 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillet
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 1 onion, thinly sliced
  • 1 large tomato, chopped
  • 1 cup chopped fresh basil
  • 1 head lettuce
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. 1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
  2. 2 Prepare the dressing by combining the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and chopped chiles in a small bowl; set aside.
  3. 3 Place the salmon filet on a baking tray, and rub olive oil over. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until easily flaked. Let cool for at least 15 minutes.
  4. 4 Place salmon filet into a big bowl; use fork to break salmon meat into big chunks. Add onion, tomato and basil; pour dressing over, and toss lightly until well mixed.
  5. 5 Place mixture on lettuce leaves, and serve immediately.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 lbs flank steak

- Serving Sauce
- 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
- 3 Tbs fish sauce

- 2 Tbs dark sweet soy sauce
- 2 Tbs rice wine vinegar
- 3 shallots, very thinly sliced
- 4 Thai chilies, sliced thinly

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 cup vegetable oil

  • 1/4 cup fresh lime juice

  • 1/4 cup soy sauce

  • 2 lbs flank steak

  • 2 Tbs soy sauce

recipes.title: Vegetarian Moussaka
recipes.description: Greek-inspired Vegetarian Moussaka combines eggplant, feta, and lentils for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful vegetable-based main dish
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 eggplant, thinly sliced
- 1 Tbs olive oil
- 1 large zucchini, thinly sliced
- 2 potatoes, thinly sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 1 clove garlic, chopped
- 1 Tbs white vinegar
- 1 (14.5 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, chopped
- 1/2 (14.5 ounce) can lentils, drained, juice reserved
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 Tbs chopped fresh parsley
- salt and pepper to taste
- 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
- 1 1/2 Tbs butter
- 2 Tbs all-purpose flour
- 1 1/4 cups milk

### black pepper to taste

- 1 pinch ground nutmeg
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 eggplant, thinly sliced
  • 1 Tbs olive oil
  • 1 large zucchini, thinly sliced
  • 2 potatoes, thinly sliced
  • 1 onion, sliced
  • 1 clove garlic, chopped
  • 1 Tbs white vinegar
  • 1 (14.5 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, chopped
  • 1/2 (14.5 ounce) can lentils, drained, juice reserved
  • 1 tsp dried oregano
  • 2 Tbs chopped fresh parsley
  • salt and pepper to taste
  • 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
  • 1 1/2 Tbs butter
  • 2 Tbs all-purpose flour
  • 1 1/4 cups milk

black pepper to taste

  • 1 pinch ground nutmeg
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Sprinkle eggplant slices with salt and set aside for 30 minutes. Rinse and pat dry.
  2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
  3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Lightly brown eggplant and zucchini slices on both sides; drain. Adding more oil if necessary, brown potato slices; drain.
  4. Saute onion and garlic until lightly browned. Pour in vinegar and reduce. Stir in tomatoes, lentils, 1/2 the juice from lentils, oregano and parsley. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 15 minutes.
  5. In a 9x13 inch casserole dish layer eggplant, zucchini, potatoes, onions and feta. Pour tomato mixture over vegetables; repeat layering, finishing with a layer of eggplant and zucchini.
  6. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes.
  7. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine butter, flour and milk. Bring to a slow boil, whisking constantly until thick and smooth. Season with pepper and add nutmeg. Remove from heat, cool for 5 minutes, and stir in beaten egg.
  8. Pour sauce over vegetables and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered, for another 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. This recipe calls for 4 different types of beans. You can choose whatever combination you like or is available. 3 x 15oz cans works great here.
  2. Heat oil in large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the bacon and saute until done. Remove and chop into small pieces.
  3. Sir in the onion, chile, and garlic and cook, stirring for 3 minutes.
  4. Add the black pepper, sage, thyme, cumin, and red pepper flakes and stir to blend.
  5. Add the beans along with the barbecue sauce, stock, and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
  6. Immediately lower the heat and cook at a simmer for 45 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and mixture is very thick.
  7. You may want to start with a lid on and then remove the lid to let more moisture evaporate.
  8. You can cook longer than 45 minutes to get the consistency you want.
  9. Remove and discard bay leaf. Add salt to taste.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Put about 2-3 tablespoons of oil in pan.
  2. Pour in 1 cup of rice (basmati), saute for about 5 min while stirring over medium heat.
  3. If rice is turning white from the translucent state, it's done; if the rice is starting to brown, you're definitly done.

  5. Bring to a good boil uncovered for a few minutes while you stir gently to get all the stuck rice on the bottom loose. Lower the heat to simmer and put on the lid. Do NOT peak :).
  6. After 20 minutes, turn off the heat and leave for another 15 minutes without peeking! Rice is done, toss lightly with a fork.

recipes.title: Broccoli Parmesan Fritters
recipes.description: Broccoli Parmesan Fritters combine red pepper flakes and Parmesan and are simmered for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Crisp fried vegetable bites
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 8 ounces (1 small-to-medium bundle, 225 grams) fresh broccoli (3 cups chopped)
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup (65 grams) all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup (30 grams) finely grated parmesan cheese
- 1 small clove garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp Kosher salt, plus more to taste
- A pinch of red pepper flakes or several grinds of black pepper
- Olive or vegetable oil for frying
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 8 ounces (1 small-to-medium bundle, 225 grams) fresh broccoli (3 cups chopped)
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup (65 grams) all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup (30 grams) finely grated parmesan cheese
  • 1 small clove garlic, minced
  • 1/2 tsp Kosher salt, plus more to taste
  • A pinch of red pepper flakes or several grinds of black pepper
  • Olive or vegetable oil for frying
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Prepare your broccoli: Separate the florets from the biggest stem(s).
  2. Cut the florets into 1-inch chunks.
  3. To prepare the stems, I like to peel them, as the skin can be thick and doesn't cook quickly, then slice them into 1/2-inch lengths.
  4. You should have about 3 cups of chopped broccoli total.
  5. Steam your broccoli until tender but not mushy: Use whatever method you prefer.
  6. My quickie, lazy method is to bring a 1/2-inch or so of water to a boil in a small saucepan, then add the broccoli, place a lid on it and simmer it for 5 to 6 minutes.
  7. Drain the broccoli, then set it aside to cool slightly.
  8. In the bottom of a large bowl, lightly beat your egg.
  9. Add the flour, cheese, garlic, salt and pepper.
  10. Then, add the somewhat cooled broccoli and, using a potato masher, mash the broccoli just a bit.
  11. You're looking to keep the bits recognizable, but small enough (1/4- to 1/2-inch chunks) that you can press a mound of the batter into a fritter in the pan.
  12. Once mashed a bit, stir or fold the ingredients together the rest of the way with a spoon.
  13. Adjust seasonings to taste.
  14. Heat a large, heavy skillet over moderate heat.
  15. Once hot, add a good slick of oil (I usually use a mix of olive and vegetable oil), about 2 to 3 tablespoons.
  16. Once the oil is hot (you can test it by flicking a droplet of water into it; it should hiss and sputter), scoop a two tablespoon-size mound of the batter and drop it into the pan, then flatten it slightly with your spoon or spatula.
  17. Repeat with additional batter, leaving a couple inches between each.
  18. Once brown underneath, about 2 to 3 minutes, flip each fritter and cook on the other side until equally golden, about another 1 to 2 minutes.
  19. Transfer briefly to paper towels to drain, then to a serving plate if you'll be eating them shortly or a baking sheet in a 200 degree oven if you'd like to keep them warm for a while until needed.
  20. Repeat with remaining batter, adding more oil as needed.
  21. Serve with some of the suggestions listed in the head notes, above.
recipes.notesHtml:
There's a lot of broccoli and very little pancake in this fritter. The broccoli is not grated or pureed, but left in small, recognizable bits that are bound lightly, faintly, to their batter of egg, parmesan and flour. And when you cook them right ' that is, to a crisp, in a preheated, heavy, oil-slicked skillet ' they get a fantastic crisp edge to them, like they were coated in frico. I imagine that if you were to roll the pancake in additional parmesan, it would get extra frico, though I haven't tried it yet. Also, I'd like someone to start a band called Extra Frico.

To serve: I like these with a dollop of the garlicky lemon yogurt I share here, roughly 1 cup plain yogurt, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 tiny minced clove of garlic, a bit of zest and salt. It would also be good with this homemade ricotta, with or without additional lemon juice. They're also good simply, with just a squeeze of lemon juice. I think I'd also enjoy them with a little crumbled feta on top. Oh, and of course, you can put a runny fried egg on top of it. But I don't need to tell you that.

- 6 Tbs (3/4 stick) butter
- 1/4 cup finely chopped shallots (about 2 medium)
- 1 garlic clove, chopped

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Bring large pot of salted water to boil.
  2. Add broccolini; stir to separate and cook 2 minutes.
  3. Drain.
  4. Transfer broccolini to paper towels to drain.
  5. Cool.
  6. DO AHEAD: Can be made 1 day ahead.

  9. Add shallots and garlic, then pecans; saut' until shallots are soft, about 3 minutes.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs butter, melted
  • 1 tsp veggie broth, powder

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat over to 375 degrees.
  2. Quarter a whole cabbage and rinse each quarter, keeping them intact.

Buttery Cabbage Wedges

This simple dish is a great and delicious way to enjoy fresh Dayempur cabbage. The cabbage is steamed in the oven in a baking dish until tender. Cabbage generally takes 25 minutes to steam but since the dish is put in the oven cold, it will take some time to start steaming.

recipes.description: Cabbage Stir Fry combines jalapeño and ginger and is pan-fried for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful platter of roasted vegetables
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/8 cup olive oil (grape seed oil, coconut oil, or other healthy oil will do just fine)
- one fat, healthy, inch of diced, not grated, fresh ginger root
- one half of a seeded jalapeno pepper, diced
- 1/8 cup tamari
- 1/8 cup water
- black pepper to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/8 cup olive oil (grape seed oil, coconut oil, or other healthy oil will do just fine)
  • one fat, healthy, inch of diced, not grated, fresh ginger root
  • one half of a seeded jalapeno pepper, diced
  • 1/8 cup tamari
  • 1/8 cup water
  • black pepper to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Say Bismillah.
  2. Chop the cabbage into thick shreds like for slaw.
  3. To a medium-hot wok or cast iron skillet, add oil.
  4. When shimmering, add the prepared ginger and jalapeno.
  5. Stir and fry until the oil is infused with flavor, about a minute to two. (Watch the temp of the flame and turn on the exhaust fan, jalapeno oil droplets are quite irritating to the membranes when inhaled!)
  6. Add cabbage and stir and fry until well coated with oil--you can allow the cabbage to sit in the bottom of the pan at times to get some nice carmelizing action--timing depends on volume of cabbage.
  7. Add some black pepper while your at it.
  8. When the cabbage has had its share of stir frying, quickly sprinkle around tamari and water and clap a lid on.
  9. From here, you allow the cabbage to steam until soft but not mushy.
  10. You may find, with various volumes of cabbage, you may need to stir the cabbage around a little more, add more water, and clap lid on a second or even third time at 5 minute increments or so until the cabbage is no longer crunchy.
  11. Firm is okay, crunchy is more for slaw.
  12. When done, some may like to add more tamari before serving.

  7. Once the potatoes are tender, promptly add the corn kernels, and cook another 30 seconds.
  8. Quickly drain the vegetables in a colander, and fill the saucepan with cold water.
  9. Drop the potatoes and corn into the cold water, and leave them for 5 minutes to stop the cooking.
  10. In a large bowl combine the mustard, lime juice, cilantro, and garlic. Stir with a whisk.
  11. Slowly add the oil while whisking. Add the salt and pepper.
  12. Drain the cooked sweet and white potatoes, and cut them into 1-inch cubes. Add the potatoes and shallots to the vinaigrette. Toss well.
  13. Serve the salad at room temperature or chilled. Toss the peanuts in just before serving.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Prepare all ingredients ahead of time as follows: Wash and rinse the lentils, dice the onion, separate cilantro leaves from stems, finely chop cilantro stems, finely chop the ginger, open can of coconut milk and tomatoes, measure and combine powder spices and ginger, and measure and combine seeds.
  2. Sautee onion in 3+ Tbs ghee until it softens and gets translucent (5 min).

recipes.ingredientsHtml:

  • Salt and pepper to taste
  • 1 Tbs balsamic vinegar
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees.
  2. Trim bottom of brussels sprouts, and slice each in half top to bottom.
  3. Heat oil in cast-iron pan over medium-high heat until it shimmers; put sprouts cut side down in one layer in pan.
  4. Put in garlic, and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
  5. Cook, undisturbed, until sprouts begin to brown on bottom, and transfer to oven.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Cornbread Stuffing
recipes.description: Gluten-Free Cornbread Stuffing combines sage and thyme and is baked for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A bubbling baked vegetable casserole
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 recipe old fashioned gluten free cornbread
- 3 Tbs (42 g) extra virgin olive oil
- 1 Tbs (14 g) unsalted butter
- 1 medium yellow onion peeled and diced
- 1 ½ cups chopped celery hearts (from about 5 stalks)
- 1 ½ tsp kosher salt
- 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
- 1 Tbs ground sage
- 1 Tbs dried thyme
- 2 cups (16 fluid ounces) chicken or vegetable stock
- 3 (150 g (weighed out of shell)) eggs beaten
- Chopped fresh parsley for sprinkling (optional)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 recipe old fashioned gluten free cornbread
  • 3 Tbs (42 g) extra virgin olive oil
  • 1 Tbs (14 g) unsalted butter
  • 1 medium yellow onion peeled and diced
  • 1 ½ cups chopped celery hearts (from about 5 stalks)
  • 1 ½ tsp kosher salt
  • 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 Tbs ground sage
  • 1 Tbs dried thyme
  • 2 cups (16 fluid ounces) chicken or vegetable stock
  • 3 (150 g (weighed out of shell)) eggs beaten
  • Chopped fresh parsley for sprinkling (optional)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat your oven to 400°F. Line an 8-inch square baking pan with parchment paper and set it aside. Grease a medium-size casserole dish and set it aside.
  2. Prepare the cornbread batter according to the recipe instructions, scrape it into the prepared 8-inch square baking dish and smooth the top.
  3. Place in the center of the preheated oven and bake until golden brown on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean (about 22 minutes).
  4. Remove from the oven and allow to cool.
  5. Reduce the oven temperature to 350°F.
  6. In a large skillet, place the olive oil and butter over medium heat.
  7. Once the butter is melted, add the diced onion and chopped celery, and mix to combine. Add the salt and pepper, and mix to combine.
  8. Cover and cook for about 6 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork tender. Uncover and add the sage and thyme and mix to combine.
  9. Remove the skillet from the heat and set it aside to cool briefly.
  10. Remove the cornbread from the baking dish and slice into cubes with a sharp knife.
  11. In a large bowl, place the cornbread cubes, add the cooked vegetables and mix gently to combine.
  12. Beat the stock with the eggs, and pour the mixture into the bowl.
  13. Mix gently again to combine.
  14. Transfer the mixture to the prepared casserole dish and spread into an even layer.
  15. Place in the center of the 350°F oven and bake until the eggs are set and the tops of the cornbread cubes are golden brown (about 25 minutes).
  16. Sprinkle with the optional fresh parsley. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Green Beans Almondine
recipes.description: Green Beans Almondine combines lemon and honey for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of seasoned beans or lentils
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed
- 3 Tbs Butter
- 1/4 c almonds, raw slivered or sliced
- 1 Tbs fresh lemon juice
- 1 Tbs lemon zest
- 2 Tbs minced shallots
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 tb whole-grain mustard
- 1 tb honey
- salt to taste
- pepper to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed
  • 3 Tbs Butter
  • 1/4 c almonds, raw slivered or sliced
  • 1 Tbs fresh lemon juice
  • 1 Tbs lemon zest
  • 2 Tbs minced shallots
  • 1 tsp minced garlic
  • 1 tb whole-grain mustard
  • 1 tb honey
  • salt to taste
  • pepper to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Blanch the green beans in lightly salted boiling water just until tender and bright green, 3-4 minutes. Plunge them into cold water, drain when cool, and set aside.
  2. Meanwhile in a large skillet, melt the butter over medium-low heat until lightly bubbling.
  3. Add the almonds and sauté, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes or until they are starting to turn golden brown.
  4. Reduce the heat to low and add the chopped shallots and garlic.
  5. Sauté for an additional 1 to 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly caramelized.
  6. If using mustard and honey, add them now.
  7. Transfer the blanched green beans to the skillet.
  8. Sauté briefly, gently tossing the green beans with the almond mixture until evenly combined and the green beans are tender.
  9. Add the lemon zest and lemon juice, toss once again, and season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper.
  10. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Hummus
recipes.description: Middle Eastern-inspired Hummus combines tahini, cumin, and lemon and is simmered for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Creamy hummus with olive oil and herbs
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 4 1/5 lbs dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 4 1/2 cups tahini
- 3 3/8 cups lemon juice
- 2 1/4 cups olive oil
- 27-36 garlic cloves, peeled
- 1/3-5/8 cup salt, to taste
- 4 1/2 tsp ground cumin (optional)
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 1/5 lbs dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 4 1/2 cups tahini
  • 3 3/8 cups lemon juice
  • 2 1/4 cups olive oil
  • 27-36 garlic cloves, peeled
  • 1/3-5/8 cup salt, to taste
  • 4 1/2 tsp ground cumin (optional)
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Bring chickpeas and baking soda to boiling then simmer about 1/2 hour or until tender.
  2. Drain chickpeas, reserving liquid.
  3. Let stand until cool enough to handle. (Using warm to hot chickpeas makes it possible to process a softer texture that will then stiffen to a nice, spreadable paste).
  4. Process in blender or food processor in 2-3 batches according to the size/capability of your equipment.
  5. Use enough of the chickpea cooking liquid to get a texture like soft peanut butter.
  6. Mix the batches together in a large bowl.
  7. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. (If you need more garlic return a half batch to the blender, process it smooth, and stir back into the rest).
  8. Tip -- Tahini often separates in the can or jar.
  9. Rather than trying to mix it in the can then measure it just put the whole can/jar into the blender, whip it up, and pour back the excess.

recipes.title: Indian Butter Tofu (Makhani)
recipes.description: Indian Butter Tofu (Makhani) combines cumin, coconut milk, and chile powder and is simmered for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful vegetable-based main dish
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 2 Tbs fresh lemon juice
* 1 Tbs ground cumin
* 1 heaping Tbs plus 1 tsp ground turmeric
* 2 (14-ounce) packages firm tofu
* 8 Tbs ghee or unsalted butter (1 stick)
* 2 yellow onions, peeled and diced
* 1 tsp ground chile powder, such as cayenne
* 3 Tbs peeled and minced fresh ginger
* 4 garlic cloves, minced
* 1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes
* 1 cinnamon stick
* 1 tsp paprika
* 1½ tsp fine sea salt
* 1½ cups heavy cream or full-fat coconut milk
* 3 scallions, thinly sliced on the bias
* ¼ cup cilantro leaves and tender stems
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs fresh lemon juice
  • 1 Tbs ground cumin
  • 1 heaping Tbs plus 1 tsp ground turmeric
  • 2 (14-ounce) packages firm tofu
  • 8 Tbs ghee or unsalted butter (1 stick)
  • 2 yellow onions, peeled and diced
  • 1 tsp ground chile powder, such as cayenne
  • 3 Tbs peeled and minced fresh ginger
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes
  • 1 cinnamon stick
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1½ tsp fine sea salt
  • 1½ cups heavy cream or full-fat coconut milk
  • 3 scallions, thinly sliced on the bias
  • ¼ cup cilantro leaves and tender stems
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Step 1
  2. In a large bowl, whisk the lemon juice, cumin and 1 heaping tablespoon turmeric with 1 tablespoon water to make a thin paste.
  3. Drain and pat the tofu dry then cut it into 1-inch cubes.
  4. Add it to the turmeric marinade, gently stirring to coat.
  5. Set aside at room temperature while you prepare the remaining ingredients, or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day.
  6. Step 2
  7. In a large pot over medium heat, melt the butter.
  8. Add the onions and chile powder, and cook, stirring frequently, until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
  9. Lower the heat, add the ginger and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are starting to brown, about 5 minutes.
  10. Step 3
  11. Add the tomatoes and their juices, gently crushing the tomatoes with your hands as you go.
  12. Add the cinnamon stick, paprika and sea salt along with the remaining 1 teaspoon turmeric.
  13. Cook until the tomatoes and onions break down and the sauce is the consistency of a thick ragù, about 10 minutes.
  14. Blend with an immersion blender, or transfer to a blender and purée until smooth.
  15. Return to the pot.
  16. Step 4
  17. Gently stir in the cream and the tofu and its marinade.
  18. Simmer over low heat, uncovered, until the tofu has taken on the color of the sauce and is flavored all the way through, about 5 minutes.
  19. Stir occasionally but gently, so the tofu doesn’t fall apart.
  20. Transfer the tofu and sauce to a deep platter or large shallow serving bowl and sprinkle with scallions and cilantro.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Chinese-inspired Kung Pao Brussels Sprouts combine ginger, soy sauce, and peanuts and are roasted for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful platter of roasted vegetables
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 pounds Brussels sprouts, halved
- 5 Tbs vegetable oil, divided
- Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
- 1 Tbs cornstarch
- 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped
- 2 Tbs finely chopped peeled ginger
- 2 Tbs hot chili paste (sambal oelek)
- 6 dried chiles de árbol, lightly crushed
- ½ cup soy sauce (or 1/4c reduced sodium soy + 1/4c light broth)
- 3 Tbs sugar
- 2 tsp unseasoned rice vinegar
- ⅓ cup unsalted, roasted peanuts
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 pounds Brussels sprouts, halved
  • 5 Tbs vegetable oil, divided
  • Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 Tbs cornstarch
  • 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped
  • 2 Tbs finely chopped peeled ginger
  • 2 Tbs hot chili paste (sambal oelek)
  • 6 dried chiles de árbol, lightly crushed
  • ½ cup soy sauce (or 1/4c reduced sodium soy + 1/4c light broth)
  • 3 Tbs sugar
  • 2 tsp unseasoned rice vinegar
  • ⅓ cup unsalted, roasted peanuts
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 425°.
  2. Toss brussels sprouts and 4 Tbsp. oil on a rimmed baking sheet; season with salt and pepper.
  3. Roast, tossing once, until softened (but not soft) and browned, 20–25 minutes.
  4. Set aside.
  5. Meanwhile, mix cornstarch and 1 Tbsp. water in a small bowl until smooth.
  6. Heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high.
  7. Add garlic and ginger and cook, stirring often, until garlic is golden brown, about 2 minutes.
  8. Add chili paste and cook, stirring, until darkened, about 2 minutes.
  9. Add chiles, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, and ½ cup water and bring to a boil; stir in cornstarch slurry.
  10. Simmer, stirring, until sauce coats spoon, about 2 minutes.
  11. Let cool slightly.
  12. Toss brussels sprouts with sauce and serve topped with peanuts.

recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: Macaroni and Cheese combines chipotle, cream, and cheddar and is baked for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: Creamy macaroni and cheese in a blue serving bowl
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 Tbs unsalted butter
- 2 Tbs olive oil
- 2 large garlic cloves, finely chopped
- 2 cups coarse fresh bread crumbs

- 2 to 3 Tbs chopped chipotle chiles in adobo
- 1/2 stick unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 3 cups whole milk
- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 Tbs dry mustard
- 1 lb macaroni
- 2 lb extra-sharp Cheddar (preferably white), grated

### Make bread crumbs
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 Tbs unsalted butter

  • 2 Tbs olive oil

  • 2 large garlic cloves, finely chopped

  • 2 cups coarse fresh bread crumbs

  • 2 to 3 Tbs chopped chipotle chiles in adobo

  • 1/2 stick unsalted butter

  • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour

  • 3 cups whole milk

  • 2 cups heavy cream

  • 1 Tbs dry mustard

  • 1 lb macaroni

  • 2 lb extra-sharp Cheddar (preferably white), grated

Make bread crumbs
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Heat butter and oil in a 10-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat until foam subsides, then cook garlic and bread crumbs, stirring, until crumbs are golden.
  2. Transfer to paper towels to drain and season with salt.
  3. Make macaroni:
  4. Preheat oven to 350'F. Chop chipotles.
  5. Melt butter in a 3- to 4-quart saucepan over moderate heat, then add flour and cook, whisking, 1 minute.
  6. Gradually whisk in milk, cream, and mustard and simmer, whisking occasionally, 3 minutes.
  7. Cook macaroni in a 6- to 7-quart pot of boiling salted water until just tender. Drain in a colander and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in white sauce, cheese, and salt to taste.
  8. Fill a 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole with half of macaroni mixture.
  9. Stir chipotles into remaining macaroni.
  10. Spoon into another 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole and sprinkle both with bread crumbs.
  11. Bake casseroles in middle of oven 30 minutes, or until bubbly.
  12. Cook's note:
  13. Macaroni and cheese may be made 2 days ahead, put into casseroles, cooled completely, and chilled, covered.
  14. Do not add bread crumbs until ready to bake. (Baking may take longer than 30 minutes.)
  15. Serves 8 adults plus 10 children as part of a buffet.

recipes.instructionsHtml:

recipes.description: Parmesan gives Potato Wedges Baked its defining flavor before being baked.

- 4 russet potatoes
- 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
- 1/4 tsp sea salt or kosher salt
- 1/4 tsp garlic powder
- 1/4 tsp paprika
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 2 Tbs chopped fresh parsley leaves
- 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 4 russet potatoes

  • 1/4 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/4 tsp paprika
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • 2 Tbs chopped fresh parsley leaves
  • 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 450˚F
  2. Wash & cut potatoes into wedges by cutting lengthwise in half then slice each half into 3 slices.
  3. Place potatoes in a bowl of water with about 2 cups of ice cubes. Let them stand for 30 min then pat dry with paper towels.
  4. Place ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp garlic powder, ¼ tsp paprika and ¼ tsp black pepper in to a large ziplock bag.
  5. Add potatoes and shake them together.
  6. Next add ¼ cup of olive oil to the bag and toss until potatoes are coated.
  7. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Place potatoes on the lined sheet and bake at 450˚F for 30-35 min until the potatoes are cooked through, browned and crispy.
  8. While potatoes are baking, chop 2 tbsp fresh parsley and grate ¼ cup parmesan cheese and place both into a large mixing bowl.
  9. Toss potato wedges in the mixing bowl with parsley and cheese.

recipes.instructionsHtml:

recipes.title: Red Curry Lentils
recipes.description: Red Curry Lentils combine cumin, curry paste, and chile powder and are simmered for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A hearty bowl of seasoned beans or lentils
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 cups red lentils
- 1 large onion, diced
- 1 Tbs vegetable oil
- 2 Tbs curry paste
- 1 Tbs curry powder
- 1 tsp ground turmeric
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp chili powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp white sugar
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 tsp ginger root, minced
- 1 (14.25 ounce) can tomato puree

- While the lentils are cooking: In a large skillet or saucepan, caramelize the onions in vegetable oil.
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups red lentils

  • 1 large onion, diced

  • 1 Tbs vegetable oil

  • 2 Tbs curry paste

  • 1 Tbs curry powder

  • 1 tsp ground turmeric

  • 1 tsp ground cumin

  • 1 tsp chili powder

  • 1 tsp salt

  • 1 tsp white sugar

  • 1 tsp minced garlic

  • 1 tsp ginger root, minced

  • 1 (14.25 ounce) can tomato puree

  • While the lentils are cooking: In a large skillet or saucepan, caramelize the onions in vegetable oil.
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Wash the lentils in cold water until the water runs clear (this is very important or the lentils will get "scummy"), put the lentils in a pot with water to cover and simmer covered until lentils tender (add more water if necessary).
  2. While the onions are cooking, combine the curry paste, curry powder, turmeric, cumin, chili powder, salt, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a mixing bowl.
  3. Mix well.
  4. When the onions are cooked, add the curry mixture to the onions and cook over a high heat stirring constantly for 1 to 2 minutes.
  5. Stir in the tomato puree and reduce heat, allow the curry base to simmer until the lentils are ready.
  6. When the lentils are tender drain them briefly (they should have absorbed most of the water but you don't want the curry to be too sloppy).
  7. Mix the curry base into the lentils and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Rosemary gives Roasted Potatoes its defining flavor before being roasted.
recipes.imageAlt: Golden seasoned potatoes
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1/2 tsp (4g) baking soda
- 4 pounds russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into quarters
- 5 Tbs (75ml) extra-virgin olive oil
- Small handful picked fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped
- 3 medium cloves garlic, minced
- Freshly ground black pepper
- Small handful fresh parsley leaves, minced
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/2 tsp (4g) baking soda
  • 4 pounds russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into quarters
  • 5 Tbs (75ml) extra-virgin olive oil
  • Small handful picked fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped
  • 3 medium cloves garlic, minced
  • Freshly ground black pepper
  • Small handful fresh parsley leaves, minced
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) (or 400°F (200°C) if using convection).
  2. Heat 2 quarts (2L) water in a large pot over high heat until boiling.
  3. Add 2 Tbs kosher salt (about 1 ounce; 25g), baking soda, and potatoes and stir.
  4. Return to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook until a knife meets little resistance when inserted into a potato chunk, about 10 minutes after returning to a boil.
  5. Meanwhile, combine olive oil, duck fat, or beef fat with rosemary, garlic, and a few grinds of black pepper in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat.
  6. Cook, stirring and shaking pan constantly, until garlic just begins to turn golden, about 3 minutes.
  7. Immediately strain oil through a fine-mesh strainer set in a large bowl.
  8. Set garlic/rosemary mixture aside and reserve separately.
  9. Transfer potatoes to a large rimmed baking sheet and separate them, spreading them out evenly.
  10. Transfer to oven and roast, without moving, for 20 minutes.
  11. Using a thin, flexible metal spatula to release any stuck potatoes, shake pan and turn potatoes.
  12. Continue roasting until potatoes are deep brown and crisp all over, turning and shaking them a few times during cooking, 30 to 40 minutes longer.
  13. Transfer potatoes to a large bowl and add garlic/rosemary mixture and minced parsley. Toss to coat and season with more salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.
recipes.searchIngredients: - 1/2 tsp (4g) baking soda - 4 pounds russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into quarters - 5 Tbs (75ml) extra-virgin olive oil - Small handful picked fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped - 3 medium cloves garlic, minced - Freshly ground black pepper - Small handful fresh parsley leaves, minced

recipes.title: Sag Paneer
recipes.description: Indian-inspired Sag Paneer combines garam masala, cumin, and ginger and is pan-fried for a spicy finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A colorful vegetable-based main dish
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 bunches spinach, roughly chopped
- 1 bunch fenugreek leaves, roughly chopped
- 1 Tbs canola oil
- 1/2 pound paneer, cubed
- 2 Tbs canola oil
- 1 tsp cumin seeds
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tomato, diced
- 2 tsp garam masala
- 1/2 tsp ground turmeric
- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
- 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
- salt to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 bunches spinach, roughly chopped
  • 1 bunch fenugreek leaves, roughly chopped
  • 1 Tbs canola oil
  • 1/2 pound paneer, cubed
  • 2 Tbs canola oil
  • 1 tsp cumin seeds
  • 1 onion, thinly sliced
  • 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tomato, diced
  • 2 tsp garam masala
  • 1/2 tsp ground turmeric
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
  • 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
  • salt to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil.
  2. Cook spinach and fenugreek in the boiling water until wilted, about 3 minutes.
  3. Drain well and transfer to a food processor.
  4. Puree until finely chopped, about 5 pulses.
  5. Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry paneer cubes, stirring constantly, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
  6. Heat 2 tablespoons canola oil in the skillet and fry the cumin seeds until lightly toasted and aromatic, about 3 minutes.
  7. Add onion; cook and stir until onion begins to soften, 4 to 5 minutes.
  8. Stir in ginger, garlic, tomato, garam masala, turmeric, and cayenne pepper; cook and stir until tomatoes break down and onions are translucent, about 10 minutes.
  9. Stir in spinach and fenugreek, cream, paneer cubes, and salt to taste. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Sausage Stuffing
recipes.description: Sausage Stuffing combines sage, mushrooms, and pecans and is pan-fried for a bright finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A bubbling baked vegetable casserole
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 2 lb hot sausage
- 3/4 loaf sliced bread
- 1 sour apple, peeled/cored/chopped (do last)
- 2 medium onions, chopped
- 1 tsp thyme
- 3 tsp worcestershire sauce
- 3 tsp hot sauce
- 8 oz. mushrooms, sliced
- 1/2 - 1 cup pecans/walnuts
- 1 - 2 cups celery, chopped
- 2 eggs, whipped
- 1 can chicken stock
- 1 whole lemon, juiced
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 lb hot sausage
  • 3/4 loaf sliced bread
  • 1 sour apple, peeled/cored/chopped (do last)
  • 2 medium onions, chopped
  • 1 tsp thyme
  • 3 tsp worcestershire sauce
  • 3 tsp hot sauce
  • 8 oz. mushrooms, sliced
  • 1/2 - 1 cup pecans/walnuts
  • 1 - 2 cups celery, chopped
  • 2 eggs, whipped
  • 1 can chicken stock
  • 1 whole lemon, juiced
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Fry sausage and drain grease.
  2. Toast bread and break or chop into croutons.
  3. Mix dry ingredients together.
  4. Add chopped apple last.
  5. Beat eggs with worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, and lemon juice.
  6. Add to mixture.
  7. Add enough chicken soup to adjust moisture level until the mixture is moist throughout.

  9. Season again with salt and pepper.
  10. Bake for 1/2 hour in the preheated oven, then sprinkle the Parmesan or Romano cheese over the top.
  11. This will create a semi-hard cheese crust.
  12. Continue baking uncovered for another 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender when tested with a fork.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.description: Indian-inspired Vegetable Biryani combines garam masala, saffron, and coriander and is pan-fried for a savory finish.
recipes.imageAlt: A bowl of seasoned rice
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 2 cups long grained basmati rice
* 6 cups water
* ½ Tbs salt
* ½ Tbs oil

- #### Saffron Milk

* 2 Tbs hot milk
* 10-12 strands crushed saffron

- **Biryani Masala**

* ¼ cup vegetable oil
* ½ inch cinnamon
* 1 bay leaf
* 3 green cardamoms
* 3 cloves
* 1 onion thinly sliced, approximately ¾ cup
* 2-3 green chillies slit lengthwise
* 1 ½ Tbs ginger garlic paste
* 2 tomatoes chopped, approximately ¾ cup
* 3/4 lb mixed vegetables (e.g. cauliflower, peas, carrots, potatoes, French beans)
* ½ cup freshly chopped cilantro
* ½ Cup freshly Chopped Mint Leaves
* 2 tsp Coriander Powder
* 2 tsp Chilli Powder
* ¾ tsp Garam Masala
* ¾ Cup Curd or Greek Yoghurt
* 1 ½ tsp Salt

- #### Rice

- Wash and rinse the rice to get rid of excess starch. Soak the rice for 30 minutes.
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 2 cups long grained basmati rice
  • 6 cups water
  • ½ Tbs salt
  • ½ Tbs oil

  • Saffron Milk

  • 2 Tbs hot milk
  • 10-12 strands crushed saffron
  • Biryani Masala
  • ¼ cup vegetable oil
  • ½ inch cinnamon
  • 1 bay leaf
  • 3 green cardamoms
  • 3 cloves
  • 1 onion thinly sliced, approximately ¾ cup
  • 2-3 green chillies slit lengthwise
  • 1 ½ Tbs ginger garlic paste
  • 2 tomatoes chopped, approximately ¾ cup
  • 3/4 lb mixed vegetables (e.g. cauliflower, peas, carrots, potatoes, French beans)
  • ½ cup freshly chopped cilantro
  • ½ Cup freshly Chopped Mint Leaves
  • 2 tsp Coriander Powder
  • 2 tsp Chilli Powder
  • ¾ tsp Garam Masala
  • ¾ Cup Curd or Greek Yoghurt
  • 1 ½ tsp Salt

  • Rice

  • Wash and rinse the rice to get rid of excess starch. Soak the rice for 30 minutes.
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Bring water to a roaring boil in a large stockpot. Add the soaked basmati rice, salt and oil. Mix to combine.
  2. Cook for 7-8 minutes or until the rice is 85% cooked on medium flame. Drain the water once done and keep the rice aside.

  3. Saffron Milk

  4. Soak saffron strands in hot milk for 10-15 minutes.

  5. Biryani Masala

  6. In a big heavy bottomed pan or kadai, heat oil on a medium flame. Once hot, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and bay leaf. Fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant.
  7. Add the sliced onions and fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown. Add green chillies and ginger garlic paste and sautee for another minute.
  8. Add the vegetables, coriander and mint leaves and roast for 2-3 minutes.
  9. Add the chopped tomatoes, coriander powder, chili powder and salt and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the vegetables are fully cooked.
  10. You should see the oil separating around the edges.
  11. You may add a little water if you feel the masala is sticking to the bottom.
  12. Reduce the flame and add yogurt and garam masala to the cooked veggies and keep stir frying for 2-3 minutes till the yogurt completely disappears.

  13. Assembly

  14. Add the par cooked rice on top of the cooked vegetable masala and tuck it at a few places into the masala underneath. Spread out the remaining rice to cover the pot completely.
  15. Drizzle the saffron milk and ghee over the rice.
  16. Cover the pot with a lid and leave the Biryani to cook on dum for about 15-20 mins. or until the rice is done.
  17. Drizzle with fried onions and serve hot

  18. Notes

  19. While buying basmati rice, make sure you buy rice that’s labelled basmati and not just long grain rice.
  20. Basmati Rice is fragrant and has slightly thinner grains than long grain rice.
  21. Real basmati rice is what gives biryani its distinct flavor and taste.
  22. Using a heavy-bottomed pan distributes heat evenly (vis-a-vis the thin bottomed cooking pans). Therefore, it cooks evenly and prevents the biryani from sticking to the bottom.
  23. Make sure the spices are toasted but don’t burn, because that’ll leave a bitter taste
  24. Don’t underestimate the power of the common mint and coriander leaf, they’re the magicians in this recipe for that restaurant-style taste and key to this recipe
  25. Make sure to cut the veggies to the same size. This ensures they will cook evenly
  26. Soak the rice half an hour before cooking. The grains soak up water and this helps speed up the cooking process
  27. Make sure not to stir the basmati while it boils. Stirring might break up the grains
  28. The final touches of saffron milk and LOADS of ghee amp up the flavours of this veg biryani! Don’t skimp on the oil and ghee - Fat is essential in making sure the biryani is cooked well and tastes great
  29. In the last step of layering and cooking the biryani, all the ingredients are par cooked.Cooking the biryani on a low flame for 15 minutes, steams and cooks everything to doneness.
  30. If you don’t have a heavy-bottomed pot, and are using a regular pot, you can place it on a tava (or flat griddle) and then place it on the stove on a medium flame to avoid burning the veggies at the bottom.
  31. The tava or griddle creates a degree of separation between the flame and the pot and provides the perfect heat source.
  32. Substitute ghee and milk with vegan replacements like vegetable oil or almond milk. #### Rice

recipes.description: Lemon anchors this bright caper brown butter sauce.
recipes.imageAlt: A savory finishing sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 6 Tbs unsalted butter.
* 2 Tbs capers, drained and patted dry.
* 1 Tbs fresh lemon juice, plus a little zest if you want extra lift.
* 1 Tbs finely chopped parsley or chives.
* 1 small garlic clove, lightly smashed or finely minced, optional.

recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 Tbs unsalted butter.
  • 2 Tbs capers, drained and patted dry.
  • 1 Tbs fresh lemon juice, plus a little zest if you want extra lift.
  • 1 Tbs finely chopped parsley or chives.
  • 1 small garlic clove, lightly smashed or finely minced, optional.
  • Pinch of salt, only if needed.
  • Black pepper, optional.
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Set a small skillet or saucepan over medium heat and add the butter.
  2. Cook, swirling or stirring often, until the butter foams, the milk solids turn golden brown, and it smells nutty. Watch closely, because it can go from brown to burnt quickly.
  3. If using garlic, add it for the last 20 to 30 seconds so it perfumes the butter without burning.
  4. A dd the capers and let them sizzle briefly; some recipes let capers fry in the butter for extra texture and flavor.
  5. Remove from heat and stir in the lemon juice.
  6. Finish with parsley or chives, then taste and adjust with salt or pepper only if needed.
  7. Best Practices
    • Use unsalted butter so you control the final seasoning.
    • Dry the capers first if you want a cleaner brown-butter flavor and a little crispness.
    • Keep the heat moderate; brown butter should smell toasted, not bitter.
    • Add lemon off the heat so the sauce stays bright and doesn’t break.
    • Serve immediately, since this sauce is best when warm and glossy.
  13. For Salmon
  14. This sauce is ideal over baked salmon because the butter brings richness, the capers cut through the fat, and the lemon keeps the dish lively.
  15. Spoon it over the salmon just before serving so the fish stays crisp on top and the sauce keeps its shine

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion Gravy
recipes.description: Caramelized Onion Gravy combines sage and white wine in a savory gravy.
recipes.imageAlt: Savory brown gravy
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 6 Tbs unsalted butter
- 1 yellow onion, diced
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 Tbs finely chopped fresh sage
- 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
- 3 cups chicken stock
- Pan drippings from roasted turkey
- 1 cup white wine
- Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 6 Tbs unsalted butter
  • 1 yellow onion, diced
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • 2 Tbs finely chopped fresh sage
  • 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
  • 3 cups chicken stock
  • Pan drippings from roasted turkey
  • 1 cup white wine
  • Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, about 15 minutes.
  2. Add the garlic and sage and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
  3. Sprinkle the flour evenly over the onions and stir until combined. Whisking constantly, slowly pour in the chicken stock.
  4. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Strain if desired. Use immediately, or cool, cover, and refrigerate until ready to finish.
  5. After roasting the turkey, transfer it to a carving board. Place the roasting pan over medium heat, add the wine, and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer for 2 minutes.
  6. Slowly whisk the gravy base into the roasting pan. Simmer until smooth and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Giblet Gravy
recipes.description: Giblet Gravy is a savory finishing gravy for adding concentrated flavor at the table.
recipes.imageAlt: Savory brown gravy
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 giblets from a turkey
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 cube chicken bouillon
- 1 stalk celery, halved
- 1/4 yellow onion
- 1 quart water
- 2 (14.5 ounce) cans chicken broth
- 4 hard-cooked eggs
- 4 Tbs flour
- 1/2 stick butter
- 1/2 cup milk
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 giblets from a turkey
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
  • 1 cube chicken bouillon
  • 1 stalk celery, halved
  • 1/4 yellow onion
  • 1 quart water
  • 2 (14.5 ounce) cans chicken broth
  • 4 hard-cooked eggs
  • 4 Tbs flour
  • 1/2 stick butter
  • 1/2 cup milk
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a 2 quart saucepan, simmer the giblets, salt, pepper, bouillon, celery and onion in 1 quart of water for 40 to 50 minutes.
  2. Discard celery, onion and gizzard.
  3. Chop liver and neck meat and return to pan.
  4. Add chicken broth or if you have a turkey, use drippings (about 1 1/2 cups and 1 can of chicken broth).
  5. Chop eggs and add to broth.
  6. Melt butter in sauce pan on medium heat and slowly add flour stirring constantly.
  7. Add flour or butter until right consistency for a roux.
  8. Cook until flour begins to brown.
  9. Do not burn!
  10. Add roux slowly to broth. Stir well until thickened. Reduce heat to low.

recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:

- 3 1/2 Tbs lemon juice

- 1 cup butter, 2 sticks, melted
- 1/4 tsp salt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:

  • 1/8 tsp Worcestershire sauce

  • 1/4 tsp salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Fill the bottom of a double boiler part-way with water.
  2. Make sure that water does not touch the top pan.
  3. Bring water to a gentle simmer.
  4. In the top of the double boiler, whisk together egg yolks, lemon juice, white pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and 1 Tbs water.
  5. Add the melted butter to egg yolk mixture 1 or 2 tablespoons at a time while whisking yolks constantly.
  6. If hollandaise begins to get too thick, add a teaspoon or two of hot water.
  7. Continue whisking until all butter is incorporated.
  8. Whisk in salt, then remove from heat.
  9. Place a lid on pan to keep sauce warm until ready to serve.
  10. Makes: 1 1/2 cups
  11. Servings Size: 4 Tbs = 1/4 cup

  14. - 28 oz lemon juice
  15. - 8 lbs butter
  16. - 2 tsp worcestershire sauce

recipes.title: Indian Green Chili Oil Spice
recipes.description: Indian Green Chili Oil Spice combines coriander, ginger, and cardamom in a spicy blend.
recipes.imageAlt: A fragrant blend of ground spices
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 10–15 Indian green chilies (such as Jwala or another medium-hot variety), finely chopped
* 8–10 cloves garlic, finely chopped
* A handful of fresh coriander leaves, chopped
* 1 cup neutral cooking oil (canola, avocado, or grapeseed)
* ½-inch piece of ginger, grated
* 1 tsp fennel seeds, crushed
* 1 bay leaf
* 1 star anise
* 2–3 green cardamom pods, slit
* Salt to taste
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 10–15 Indian green chilies (such as Jwala or another medium-hot variety), finely chopped
  • 8–10 cloves garlic, finely chopped
  • A handful of fresh coriander leaves, chopped
  • 1 cup neutral cooking oil (canola, avocado, or grapeseed)
  • ½-inch piece of ginger, grated
  • 1 tsp fennel seeds, crushed
  • 1 bay leaf
  • 1 star anise
  • 2–3 green cardamom pods, slit
  • Salt to taste
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Prepare the aromatics: In a heat-proof bowl, combine the chopped green chilies, garlic, grated ginger, chopped coriander, crushed fennel seeds, and salt.
  2. Infuse the oil: In a small saucepan, heat the neutral oil over medium heat.
  3. Add the bay leaf, star anise, and slit cardamom pods.
  4. Let the spices simmer in the oil for about 5 minutes, until fragrant.
  5. Combine and temper: Carefully pour the hot, infused oil over the mixture of chilies and aromatics in the heat-proof bowl.
  6. The oil will sizzle as it cooks the fresh ingredients.
  7. Stir well to combine all the flavors.
  8. Cool and store: Allow the mixture to cool completely. Once cooled, transfer the green chili oil to a clean, airtight glass jar.
  9. Store: Keep the oil refrigerated, where it will last for up to one month.

  • 1/2 cup dry white wine.
  • 2 Tbs white wine vinegar.
  • 2 Tbs fresh lemon juice.
  • 1 Tbs heavy cream.
  • 8 Tbs cold unsalted butter, cut into small cubes.
  • 1 Tbs finely chopped fresh chives.
  • 1 Tbs finely chopped fresh dill or tarragon.
  • 1 tsp finely chopped parsley.
  • Salt, to taste.White pepper, optional, to taste.
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a small nonreactive saucepan, combine the shallot, white wine, vinegar, and lemon juice.
  2. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat and reduce until you have about 2 to 3 tablespoons of liquid left.
  3. Lower the heat, stir in the cream, and keep the mixture warm but not boiling.
  4. Whisk in the cold butter a few cubes at a time, letting each addition emulsify before adding more.When the sauce is glossy and lightly thickened, remove from heat.
  5. Stir in the chives, dill or tarragon, and parsley.
  6. Taste and adjust with salt and a little white pepper if needed.
  7. Serve immediately.
  8. Best Practices
  9. Keep the butter cold so the emulsion forms more reliably.
  10. Do not let the sauce boil after the butter goes in.
  11. Add herbs at the end for the brightest flavor and cleanest color.If the sauce gets too thick, whisk in a teaspoon of warm water or lemon juice.If you want an extra-smooth finish, strain the reduction before adding butter.
  12. For Salmon
  13. This sauce is especially good with simply baked salmon seasoned with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
  14. Spoon it over the fish just before serving so the sauce stays glossy and the salmon remains the star.

Salt, to taste.White pepper, optional, to taste.

recipes.title: Puttanesca Sauce
recipes.description: Puttanesca Sauce combines red pepper flakes, basil, and tomato in a spicy sauce.
recipes.imageAlt: A rich red sauce
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
* 1/4 cup olive oil
* 1 cup finely chopped onion
* 6 cloves minced garlic
* 2 (28-ounce) cans Roma plum tomatoes, broken into pieces, with juice
* 1 cup tightly packed, pitted, and halved Kalamata olives
* 2 Tbs tomato paste
* 2 Tbs drained capers
* 2 Tbs minced anchovy fillets (about 8 fillets)
* 1/2 tsp dried crushed basil
* 1/2 tsp dried crushed red pepper flakes
* Salt
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1/4 cup olive oil
  • 1 cup finely chopped onion
  • 6 cloves minced garlic
  • 2 (28-ounce) cans Roma plum tomatoes, broken into pieces, with juice
  • 1 cup tightly packed, pitted, and halved Kalamata olives
  • 2 Tbs tomato paste
  • 2 Tbs drained capers
  • 2 Tbs minced anchovy fillets (about 8 fillets)

  • 1/2 tsp dried crushed red pepper flakes
  • Salt
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. In a large pot heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
  2. Add the onion and sautee until soft and lightly caramelized, about 6 minutes.
  3. Add the garlic and cook an additional 2 minutes.
  4. Add the tomatoes and the remaining ingredients and simmer until the sauce is thickened and slightly reduced, about 40 minutes.
  5. Adjust seasoning, to taste, cover and set aside.
  6. Add penne pasta to the pan and toss for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Turkey Gravy
recipes.description: Turkey Gravy combines white wine and thyme in a savory gravy.
recipes.imageAlt: Savory brown gravy
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 Tbs vegetable oil

### reserved turkey giblets and neck

- 1 onion , unpeeled and chopped
- 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth
- 2 cups water
- 2 sprigs fresh thyme
- 8 parsley stems
- 3 Tbs unsalted butter
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup dry white wine
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 Tbs vegetable oil

reserved turkey giblets and neck

  • 1 onion , unpeeled and chopped
  • 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth
  • 2 cups water
  • 2 sprigs fresh thyme
  • 8 parsley stems
  • 3 Tbs unsalted butter
  • 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup dry white wine
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Make the Broth: Heat oil in large saucepan over medium-high heat. Brown turkey giblets and neck for 5 minutes. Cook onion for 3 minutes. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes.
  2. Add chicken broth and water, scrape pan bottom, and bring to boil. Add herbs and simmer, skimming foam from surface, for 30 minutes.
  3. Pour broth through fine-mesh strainer. Reserve and dice heart and gizzard. Refrigerate broth and diced giblets until ready to use.
  4. Make the Roux and Thicken the Broth: Melt butter in large saucepan over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour. Cook, stirring constantly, until nutty brown and fragrant, 10 to 15 minutes. Bring reserved turkey broth to simmer.
  5. Gradually add hot turkey broth to roux. Vigorous and constant whisking at this point is key to avoiding lumps. Reserve 1 cup of broth for deglazing roasting pan (see #9).
  6. Simmer gravy, stirring occasionally and skimming scum from surface with spoon, until thickened, about 30 minutes. Set aside, covered, until turkey is done.
  7. Deglaze the Pan and Add the Drippings To the Gravy: Pour drippings through mesh strainer set over measuring cup. Let liquid settle until fat rises to top. Return vegetables in strainer to roasting pan.
  8. Tilt measuring cup and use wide, shallow soup spoon to skim fat off surface. Reserve defatted drippings. Return gravy in saucepan to simmer.
  9. Place roasting pan over two burners at medium-high heat. Add wine and reserved 1 cup broth and scrape up browned bits in pan. Boil until liquid reduces by half, 5 minutes.
  10. Strain roasting pan liquid into gravy, pressing on solids to extract all liquid. Add defatted drippings to taste. Stir in giblets and serve.
recipes.notesHtml:
Makes about 6 cups. Published November 1, 2009.

This recipe makes enough gravy to accompany a 12- to 14-pound turkey with leftovers. If you are roasting a very large bird and want to double the recipe, prepare the gravy in a Dutch oven. White wine adds a welcome note of acidity to gravy, but in a pinch you can use more chicken broth in its place. Make sure you've added 1 cup each of chopped onions, carrots, and celery along with fresh thyme sprigs and 1 cup of water to the roasting pan before the turkey goes into the oven.

recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. Preheat oven to 350. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Make filling – combine cream cheese and butter in the bowl of an electric mixer. Beat on medium-high speed until well-combined and smooth, about 2-3 minutes. Mix in vanilla. Gradually beat in confectioner’s sugar until totally incorporated. Increase the speed and beat until smooth. Mix in lemon juice. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
  2. In the meantime, whisk together butter, sugars, and egg yolk in a large bowl. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, ginger and salt. Add flour mixture to butter. Stir until combined. Mix in oats, carrots, and raisins.
  3. Drop dough by level Tbs, 2 inches apart, onto prepared baking sheets. Flatten with the palm of your hand. Bake until the edges are crisp, rotating baking sheets halfway through, 15 to 18 minutes. Transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool.
  4. Try to pair up cookies according to size so that they approximately match each other. Flip one of each pair over, bottom side up. Dollop out the cream cheese frosting or pipe onto each flipped over cookie. Top with remaining cookie and press gently to spread the filling to the edges. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
recipes.description: Chess Cake layers the flavors of chocolate and cream cheese in a rich dessert.
recipes.imageAlt: A tender slice of homemade cake
recipes.ingredientsMarkdown:
- 1 package cake mix (regular or chocolate)
- 1 stick butter
- 3 eggs
- 1 package of cream cheese
- 4 tsp. vanilla and/or almond flavoring
- 2 cups confectioner's sugar
recipes.ingredientsHtml:
• 1 package cake mix (regular or chocolate)
  • 1 stick butter
  • 3 eggs
  • 1 package of cream cheese
  • 4 tsp. vanilla and/or almond flavoring
  • 2 cups confectioner's sugar
recipes.instructionsHtml:
1. To make the cake begin by melting the butter in a saucepan.
  2. Once melted, add the cake mix and stir well.
  3. Beat 1 egg and add it to the mixture along with 2 tsp. of flavoring.
  4. Almond flavoring in the cake and vanilla in the filling works nicely.
  5. Spray cooking spray on the bottom of a cooking pan then sprinkle some (no more than 1/2 cup) confectioner's sugar to coat the bottom.
  6. Pour the cake mixture into the pan and press it evenly across the bottom and make slight walls around the outside to hold the filling.
  7. To make the filling begin by softening the cream cheese in the microwave so it's very soft and spreadable.
  8. Mix cream cheese and remaining confectioner's sugar until creamy.
  9. Add 2 eggs and beat well.
  10. Add 2 tsp. vanilla or almond flavoring and mix.
  11. Pour filling onto the cake mixture in the pan and bake at 325 degrees for 25 - 35 minutes.
  12. It should be a little jiggly in the middle when removed.
